analyzed: bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ nāgāḥ ca asurāḥ rākṣasāḥ grahāḥ sarve te vyapagacchantu balituṣṭāḥ yathā tatham devānām ca dvijānām ca sthānam samyak karomi aham vāsudevasya devasya sarva bhūta ātmakasya ca iti maṃtram udīrayan astra mantreṇa saṃsiddhān siddhārthān sarvatas vikīrya tatrasūtrāṇi nipātya sūtra saṃdhiṣu śaṃkūn saṃsthāpya

original: tasmin tamāvāhya pañcopaniṣadā ghṛtena āhutīnāṃ sahasraṃ śataṃ vā apāmārga śamīkhādirāṇāṃ samidbhiśca tāvat hutvā|agniṃ yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācānām pūrvoktābhiḥ samidbhiḥ pūrvokta saṃkhyayā svayaṃ hutvā| tataḥ mūlamaṃtrābhyāṃ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ vāstunāthamaṃtreṇa caruṇā āhutīnāṃ śataṃ ca hutvā| pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā| agnisthaṃ udvāsya|

analyzed: aṣṭāsu dikṣu indra ādīnām sva sva mantreṇa baliṃdadyāt iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyām kriyākairava candrikāyām bhū parīkṣā vidhiḥ nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ dāna pālanayoḥ madhye dānāt śreyaḥ anupālanam dānāt svargam avāpnoti pālanāt acyutam padam sva dattām para dattām vā yaḥ hareta vasuṃdharām ṣaṣṭi varṣa sahasrāṇi viṣṭayā jāyate kṛmiḥ

original: anantaram ācāryaḥ vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā halena bhūmiṃvilikhet|yajamānaḥ brāhmaṇaścet anaṅvāhau gauravarṇau|yadikṣatriyaḥ lohitau| yadi vaiśyaḥpītau| yadi śūdraḥ mecakau| uktavarṇānāṃ alābhe kapilau gaurau raktau vā| tau mahāntaubalaśālinau vṛṣabhau kṣālayitvā|

analyzed: khura śṛṅga ādīni kanaka mayaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣayet brāhmaṇaḥ yajamānaḥ ced yugam halam ca pālāśam kṣatriyaḥ yadi naiyagrodham yadi vaiśyaḥ plākṣam sarveṣām varṇānām naiyagrodha paippale vā syātām sarveṣām kauśikaḥ sauvarṇāḥ yoktram rājatam tāmram vākuśāḥ dhanujryāḥ vīraṇyaḥ kāśāḥ ca yathāvarṇam kramāt rajjuḥ

original: halabhūtamadhyauekayonike|sarvaṃ evaṃ kṛtvā| tataḥ snātaḥ navāṃbaradharaḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaḥ ācāryaḥ pādauprakṣālya| ācamya| prāṇānāyamya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā| brāhmaṇaiḥ anujñātaḥ mantrajñaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥsaha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| tajjalena sarvaṃ dravyajātaṃ ātmānaṃ ca prokṣya| mūlamantreṇavṛṣaskandhe yugaṃ saṃyojya|

original: tenaiva mantreṇa halaṃ yuge saṃyojya| sumuhūrte bherī paṭaha śaṅkhādivādyaghoṣapurassaraṃ śākuna sūktādi vedaghoṣasahitaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ guruḥ hṛdayakamale nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyan|pālāśādi daṇḍaṃ pravahaṇaṃ kṛtvā| tataḥ todanaṃ ādāya| huṃphaḍādinā āpīḍya| prāṅmukhaḥmūlavidyayā prathamaṃ karṣayet|

original: pauruṣeṇa sūktena dvitīyaṃ, viṣṇusūktena tṛtīyaṃ, viṣṇu gāya rtyāturīyam, nārāyaṇānuvākena pañcamam, pañcopaniṣanmaṃtraiḥ ṣaṣṭam, bhūsūktena saptamam karṣaṇam| sarvaṃ prādakṣiṇya krameṇa| dakṣiṇottarataśca evaṃ karṣayet| tatkāle nimittāni parīkṣet|ācāryasyamanastuṣṭiḥ mandira yajamānayoḥ śarmaṇe bhavet |
analyzed: pauruṣeṇa sūktena dvitīyam viṣṇusūktena tṛtīyam viṣṇu gāya rtyā turīyam nārāyaṇānuvākena pañcamam pañca upaniṣad maṃtraiḥ ṣaṣṭam bhūsūktena saptamam karṣaṇam sarvam prādakṣiṇya krameṇa dakṣiṇa uttaratas ca evam karṣayet tad kāle nimittāni mandira yajamānayoḥ śarmaṇe bhavet

original: tadviparyayaśca asukhāya|anaḍuhoḥ śayane, yoktrādibhedane, vyatyāsabhramaṇe, anyanimittodaye ca sarva doṣaśāntyarthaṃpañcopaniṣadā sarpiṣā śatamāhutīnāṃ juhuyāt| tataḥ ācāryaḥ yajamānaśca brāhmaṇāntoṣayitvā|tāṃ bhuvaṃ mahatāyatnena samīkṛtya, pṛthak pṛthak ālavālāni jalakulyāyutānikārayitvā| toyena āsicya| tatra śālī mudga yavādi bījāni vāpayet|
analyzed: tad viparyayaḥ ca asukhāya anaḍuhoḥ śayane yoktra ādi bhedane vyatyāsa bhramaṇe anya nimitta udaye ca sarva doṣa śānti artham pañca upaniṣadā sarpiṣā śatam āhutīnām juhuyāt tatas ācāryaḥ yajamānaḥ ca brāhmaṇān toṣayitvā tām bhuvam mahatā ayatnena samīkṛtya pṛthak pṛthak ālavālāni jala kulyā yutāni kārayitvā toyena āsicya tatra śālī mudga yava ādi bījāni vāpayet

original: tadabhivṛddhyarthaṃpratidinaṃ mahatājalena saṃsicya| paripākāvasānikaṃ rakṣet|tataḥ phalāni pakvāni lūtvā|phalarahitaṃ kṣetraṃ gāḥ samānīya cārayet| sasya bhūriphale taddhāma dīrghakālaṃ bhaviṣyati|alpe tu alpataraṃ kālam| hareḥ sannidhānaṃ ca pūrvavadeva| phalahīneprakṣīṇadhanadhānyakam|tatra sahasraṃ śataṃ vā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā|
analyzed: tad abhivṛddhi artham pratidinam mahatā jalena saṃsicya paripāka avasānikam rakṣet tatas phalāni pakvāni lūtvā phala rahitam kṣetram gāḥ samānīya cārayet sasya bhūri phale tat dhāma dīrgha kālam bhaviṣyati alpe tu alpataram kālam hareḥ sannidhānam ca pūrvavat eva phala hīne prakṣīṇa dhana dhānyakam tatra sahasram śatam vā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā

original: tebhyaśca go dhanādidakṣiṇān vitīrya| pañcagavyena pañcopaniṣadā tatkṣetraṃ saṃprokṣya| kuddālaiḥ khanitraiḥ vā, yāvaṃbaḥtāvat bhūmiṃ khanet|

original: prācīna garte parvatamṛdutpalakanda manaśśilā vajraśāli hiraṇyāni,dakṣiṇe tīrthamṛda kanda haritāla vaidūrya nīvāra rājatāni, paścime nadīmṛtmaratakanīlotpalakandāñjanakaṅgu tāmrāṇi, uttare hradamṛtkaśeru kanda puṣyarāga priyaṅgvayāṃsi,āgneyekulīrāśaya mṛtsīsa sphaṭikamāṣatrapūṇi, naiṝte valmīkamṛtsaurāṣṭra mauktikatilakāṃsyāni, mārute halamṛttikā
analyzed: prācīna garte parvata mṛd utpala kanda manaśśilā vajraśāli hiraṇyāni dakṣiṇe tīrtha mṛda kanda haritāla vaidūrya nīvāra rājatāni paścime nadī mṛd marataka nīlotpala kanda añjana kaṅgu tāmrāṇi uttare hrada mṛd kaśeru kanda puṣyarāga priyaṅgu ayāṃsi āgneya ekulīra āśaya mṛd sīsa sphaṭika māṣatrapūṇi naiṝte valmīka mṛd saurāṣṭra mauktika tila kāṃsyāni mārute halamṛttikā mṛd saurāṣṭra mauktika tila kāṃsyāni mārute halam

original: rocanācandrakānta mudga sauvarṇa kūrmapratikṛtīḥ, aiśānedantidantamṛttikā mahānīlagairika veṇudhānya sauvarṇa śaṅkhān, brahmapade vṛṣaviṣāṇāgramṛttikā padmakanda padmarāga pāradayava sauvarṇa cakrāṇi ca mūlamantreṇa vinyasya| tatpadmaṃviṣṇugāya rtyā abhyarcya| kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā agniṃ vidhivat upasamidhya|
analyzed: rocanā candrakānta mudga sauvarṇa kūrma pratikṛtīḥ aiśānedantidantamṛttikā mahānīlagairika veṇudhānya sauvarṇa śaṅkhān brahmapade vṛṣaviṣāṇa agramṛttikā padma kanda padmarāga pārada yava sauvarṇa cakrāṇi ca mūlamantreṇa vinyasya tat padmam viṣṇugāya ṛtyā abhyarcya kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vā agnim vidhivat upasamidhya

original: samidbhiḥsarpiṣā ca viṣṇuṣaḍakṣareṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| pātrāntare saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya| caruṇānṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥhutvā|
analyzed: samidbhiḥ sarpiṣā ca viṣṇu ṣaṣ akṣareṇa aṣṭottaraśata āhutīḥ hutvā pātra antare saṃpāta ājyam saṃgṛhya caruṇā anṛsūktena ṣoḍaśa āhutīḥ hutvā

analyzed: anantaram tila ājya miśra caruṇā indra ādi lokapālebhyaḥ bhuvanebhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ samudrebhyaḥ ādityebhyaḥ vasubhyaḥ marudbhyaḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ vedebhyaḥ sarva śāstrebhyaḥ purāṇebhyaḥ pātālebhyaḥ digbhyaḥ nāgebhyaḥ gaṇebhyaḥ sarva bhūtebhyaḥ narendrebhyaḥ nakṣatrebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ grahebhyaḥ iti praṇava ādi svāhā antam hutvā

original: pūrvagṛhītasaṃpātājyena garbhabhājanaṃ’‘oṃ dhīṃ namaḥ parāya lohitavarṇāya sparśatanmātrātmane’‘ itisaṃsicya| pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā| rajanyāṃ sumuhūrte saveda vādyaghoṣaṃ tadbhājanamādāya| devāgāraṃpradakṣiṇī kṛtya| garbhageham praviśya| dvārasya antarmukhasya dakṣiṇa pāśrvaṃ tribhāgī kṛtya|bhāgadvayaṃ visṛjya|
analyzed: pūrva gṛhīta saṃpāta ājyena garbha bhājanam om dhīṃ namaḥ parāya lohita varṇāya sparśa tanmātra ātmane iti saṃsicya pūrṇāhutim hutvā rajanyām su muhūrte vādya ghoṣam tat bhājanam ādāya devāgāram pradakṣiṇīkṛtya garbha geham praviśya dvārasya antarmukhasya tri bhāgī kṛtya bhāga dvayam visṛjya

original: dvāranikaṭasyekabhāge pādapāśrve devānāṃ paṭṭikāyāṃ brāhmaṇaḥyajamānaścet,rājā cet kumudopari, vaiśyaḥ yadi kumudādhaḥ, śūdraḥ yadi jagatau garbhanyāsaṃ kuryāt|uktaviparyayanyāse mahān doṣaḥ bhavati| tasmāt sthānabhraṃśaṃ na kārayet|tadā ācāryaḥ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ saparvata dvīpa samudradiggajaṃ śeṣaphaṇīndra phaṇāmaṇḍalasthitaṃdhyātvā|
analyzed: dvāra nikaṭasya eka bhāge pādapa aśrve devānām paṭṭikāyām brāhmaṇaḥ yajamānaḥ ced rājā ced kumuda upari vaiśyaḥ yadi kumuda adhas śūdraḥ yadi jagatau garbhanyāsam kuryāt ukta viparyaya nyāse mahān doṣaḥ bhavati tasmāt sthāna bhraṃśam na kārayet tadā ācāryaḥ bhū maṇḍalam sa parvata dvīpa samudra diggajam śeṣa phaṇi indra phaṇā maṇḍala sthitam dhyātvā

original: dvibhujaṃ śyāmāṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitāṃ ṛtusnātāṃ vasudhāṃ ātmānamapisarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ keśavaṃ dhyātvā|garbhabhājana sthānagartaṃ gomūtreṇa anulipya|sarvabhūtadhare kānte parvatastana maṇḍite|samudraparidhānīye devī garbhaṃ samāśraya| ‘‘iti mantreṇa tasmin garte garbhabhājanam vinyasya| vidhānena pidhāya|sudhayā dhṛḍhīkṛtya|
analyzed: dvi bhujam śyāmām sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitām ṛtusnātām vasudhām ātmānam api sarva bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitam keśavam dhyātvā garbha bhājana sthāna gartam go mūtreṇa anulipya sarva bhūta dhare kānte parvata stana maṇḍite samudra paridhānīye devī garbham samāśraya iti mantreṇa tasmin garte garbha bhājanam vinyasya vidhānena pidhāya sudhayā dhṛḍhīkṛtya

original: samantataḥ rakṣāṃ kuryāt| tadā garbhasya skhalane durnimitte ca pūrvavatprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt| garbha nyāsam akṛtvā grāmaṃ prāsādaṃ vā kuryāt yadi, tadā nacirādevaubhaukṣayaṃ yāyātām|tadānīṃ yajamānaḥ gurave pūrvokta saṃkhyayā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| iti garbhanyāsa vidhiḥnāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: samantataḥ rakṣām kuryāt tadā garbhasya skhalane durnimitte ca pūrvavat prāyaścittam kuryāt garbha nyāsam a kṛtvā grāmam prāsādam vā kuryāt yadi tadā yāyātām tadānīm yajamānaḥ gurave pūrvokta saṃkhyayā dakṣiṇām dadyāt iti garbhanyāsa vidhiḥ nāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ

analyzed: ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ

original: mūrdheṣṭakāvidhiḥ ucyate |
analyzed: mūrdheṣṭakā vidhiḥ ucyate

original: pūrve maṇḍapaṃ prapāṃ vā madhye vedikādvayena saha kalpayitvā| madhyavedikāyāṃ pūrvavat vrīhiśāli taṇḍula tilaiḥ savastrācchādanaṃ staṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| tasmin pūrvokta lakṣaṇayutānnavakumbān puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ saṃsthāpya| iṣṭakādhivāsārthaṃ dvitīya vedikāyāṃ ca sthaṇḍilaṃpūrvavat kṛtvā| darbhān āstīrya| mūrdheṣṭakā śuddhyarthaṃ snapanakarmakariṣye|
analyzed: pūrve maṇḍapam prapām vā madhye vedikā dvayena saha kalpayitvā madhya vedikāyām pūrvavat vrīhi śāli taṇḍula tilaiḥ sa vastra ācchādanam staṇḍilam kṛtvā tasmin pūrva ukta lakṣaṇa yutān nava kumbān puṇyāha pūrvakam saṃsthāpya iṣṭakā adhivāsa artham dvitīya vedikāyām ca sthaṇḍilam pūrvavat kṛtvā darbhān āstīrya mūrdha iṣṭakā śuddhi artham snapana karma kariṣye

original: iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| tatra navakalaśān salakṣaṇān saṃsthāpya| tān ca pūrvoktaviśeṣeṇaviśiṣṭān vidhāya|brahmādi īśānāntaṃ pūrvavat ghṛtādi dravyaiḥ āpūrya| teṣu pūrvavattadadhidaivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya| napuṃsakeṣṭakāḥ catasraḥ saṃgṛhya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya| teṣu vāsudevādīn āvāhya abhyarcya| pīṭhe saṃsthāpya|
analyzed: iti saṃkalpya puṇyāham vācayitvā tatra nava kalaśān sa lakṣaṇān saṃsthāpya tān ca pūrva ukta viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭān vidhāya brahma ādi īśāna antam pūrvavat ghṛta ādi dravyaiḥ āpūrya teṣu pūrvavat tad adhidaivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya napuṃsaka iṣṭakāḥ catasraḥ saṃgṛhya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya teṣu vāsudeva ādīn āvāhya abhyarcya pīṭhe saṃsthāpya

original: navakalaśaiḥ tattanmantreṇa tāḥkrameṇa pṛthak abhiṣicya| sadarbha nava vāsobhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak saṃveṣṭya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya|pūrvakṛta dvitīyavedikā sthaṇḍilopari tāḥ śāyayitvā|pūrvavat dvāratoraṇa kumbhānsaṃsthāpya|tattaddaivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya|madhyavedikākumbheṣu madhye paramātmānaṃupakumbhāṣṭake viṣṇvādīn āvāhya abhyarcya|pāyasānnaṃ
analyzed: nava kalaśaiḥ tad tad mantreṇa tāḥ krameṇa pṛthak abhiṣicya sa darbha nava vāsobhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak saṃveṣṭya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya pūrva kṛta dvitīya vedikā sthaṇḍila upari tāḥ śāyayitvā pūrvavat dvāra toraṇa kumbhān saṃsthāpya tad tad daivatāni āvāhya abhyarcya madhya vedikā kumbheṣu madhye paramātmānam upa kumbha aṣṭake viṣṇu ādīn āvāhya abhyarcya pāyasa annam abhyarcya pāyasa annam abhyarcya pāyasa annam abhyarcya pāyasa

original: nivedya|vedikāyāṃ catasṛṣu dikṣuadhivāsahomaṃ dhāmnaḥ aṣṭasu dikṣu śānti homaṃ ca kṛtvā|saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya|tenasparśamantreṇa tāḥ spṛṣṭvā|pūrvavat saṃkalpādi pūrvasūtraiḥ pratisaraṃ badhnīyāt|tataḥpañcaviṃśatikalaśasnapana karmakariṣye|iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya|pūrvāyatāni daśaudakāyatāni tāvanti sūtrāni nipātayet|tadākṛte
analyzed: nivedya vedikāyām catasṛṣu dikṣu adhivāsa homam dhāmnaḥ aṣṭasu dikṣu śānti homam ca kṛtvā a saṃpāta ājyam saṃgṛhya tena sparśa mantreṇa tāḥ spṛṣṭvā pūrvavat saṃkalpa ādi pūrva sūtraiḥ pratisaram badhnīyāt tatas pañcaviṃśati kalaśa snapana karma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya pūrva āyatāni daśa audaka āyatāni tāvanti sūtrāni nipātayet tadā kṛte

original: ekottarāśīti padāni bhavanti|teṣumadhyapada navake kumbha navakaṃ tatparitaḥ dvedve paṅktiṃ vīdhyarthaṃ parimājrya| tadbahiḥpūrvādisomāntaṃ dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi āgneyādīśānāntaṃ ekaikaṃ kumbhānāṃ vrīhi taṇḍulatilakṛtasthaṇḍilopari vinyasya|
analyzed: eka uttara aśīti padāni bhavanti teṣu madhya pada navake kumbha navakam tad paritas dve dve paṅktim vīdhi artham tad bahis pūrva ādi soma antam dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi āgneya ādi īśāna antam ekaikam kumbhānām vrīhi taṇḍula tila kṛta sthaṇḍila upari vinyasya

original: madhyakumbhanavakaṃ ghṛtoṣṇodaka navaratna phalasaptalohamārjana gandhākṣata yavaiḥbrahmādīśānāntaṃ krameṇa āpūrya|pūrvādi diksthamadhya kumbhāncaturaḥ krameṇa pādya arghya ācamana paṃcagavyaiḥ āgneyādi koṇasthitāncaturaḥ dadhikṣīra madhukaṣāyaiḥ pāśrvasthita kumbhāṣṭakaṃ śuddhodakena ca āpūrya|pūrvokta viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭān ādhāya|dravyakumbheṣu
analyzed: madhya kumbha navakam ghṛta uṣṇa udaka navaratna phala sapta loha mārjana gandha akṣata yavaiḥ brahma ādi īśāna antam krameṇa āpūrya pūrva ādi diś stha madhya kumbhān caturaḥ krameṇa pādya arghya ācamana paṃcagavyaiḥ āgneya ādi koṇa sthitān caturaḥ dadhi kṣīra madhu kaṣāyaiḥ pāśrva sthita kumbha aṣṭakam śuddha udakena ca āpūrya pūrva ukta viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭān ādhāya dravya kumbheṣu

original: paravāsudevādi dāmodarāntān śuddhodaka kumbheṣu nārāyaṇaṃ caāvāhya|abhyarcya| tataḥ yajamānaḥ ācāryaḥ snātvā vastrāṅgulīyakādibhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣitaḥupoṣitaḥ| tatra darbhān āstīrya|
analyzed: para vāsudeva ādi dāmodara antān śuddha udaka kumbheṣu nārāyaṇam ca āvāhya abhyarcya tatas yajamānaḥ ācāryaḥ snātvā vastra aṅgulīyaka ādi bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣitaḥ upoṣitaḥ tatra darbhān āstīrya

original: paramapuruṣaṃ dhyāyan śāyīta|śvabhūte sumuhūrte kṛtakṛtyaḥguruḥ iṣṭakāḥ pañcaviṃśatikalaśaiḥ mūlamantreṇa mahākumbhatoyena ca snāpayitvāabhyarcya|mūlena jalaiḥ vāsobhiḥ veṣṭayitvā| sarvālaṅkṛtānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ mūdhrni vinyasya|savedavādyaghoṣaṃ dhāmapradakṣiṇī kṛtya|vimānoparitale iṣṭakāḥ āropya|
analyzed: paramapuruṣam dhyāyan śāyīta aśva bhūte su muhūrte kṛtakṛtyaḥ guruḥ iṣṭakāḥ pañcaviṃśati kalaśaiḥ mūlamantreṇa mahākumbha toyena ca snāpayitvā abhyarcya mūlena jalaiḥ vāsobhiḥ veṣṭayitvā sarva alaṅkṛtānām ṛtvijām mūdhrni vinyasya sa veda vādya ghoṣam dhāma pradakṣiṇī kṛtya vimāna upari tale iṣṭakāḥ āropya

original: puṇyāhaṃvācayitvā|ācāryaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ hṛdayakamale nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyan pūrvādi dikrameṇa praṇavenaiṣṭakāḥ sthāpayet| tadānīṃ pāparogayutān pratilomajān api bahiḥ nirvāsayet|tadanuyajamānaḥ śirasā guruṃ praṇamya|go bhū hiraṇya bhūṣaṇadāsīdāsa vāhana chatra cāmarapādukādīn mahādakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyāt|rathakāraṃ ca tathā vastrānnadhanadānyādibhiḥ
analyzed: puṇyāham vācayitvā ācāryaḥ prāc mukhaḥ hṛdaya kamale nārāyaṇam dhyāyan pūrva ādi di krameṇa praṇavena aiṣṭakāḥ sthāpayet tadānīm pāpa roga yutān pratiloma jān api bahis nirvāsayet tadanu yajamānaḥ śirasā gurum praṇamya go hiraṇya bhūṣaṇa dāsī dāsa vāhana chatra cāmara pādukā ādīn mahā dakṣiṇām ca dadyāt rathakāram ca tathā vastra anna dhana dānya ādibhiḥ

original: toṣayet|atra sthūpikākīla vidhiḥ ucyate |sauvarṇa rājataṃ tāmraṃ vā dārujaṃ vā vakra granthi varjitaṃ sthūpikā kīlaṃ mūrdhabhūmyaṅaghri pramāṇavistārāyāmaṃ bhavet|tadagramaṅgulī pramāṇaṃ vimāna kaṇṭhatulya pramāṇaṃ adhyardha pramāṇaṃ dviguṇapramāṇaṃ vā vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ pañcāśraṃ vā kalpayet |
analyzed: toṣayetatra sthūpikākīla vidhiḥ ucyate sauvarṇa rājatam tāmram vā dārujam vā vakra granthi varjitam sthūpikā kīlam mūrdha bhūmi aṅaghri pramāṇa vistāra āyāmam bhavet tad agram aṅgulī pramāṇam vimāna kaṇṭha tulya pramāṇam adhyardha pramāṇam dviguṇa pramāṇam vā vṛttam caturaśram pañcāśram vā kalpayet

original: vṛttāyate caturaśrāyate ca vimānesthūpikākīlāni yugmāni syuḥ;itareṣu vimāneṣuayugmāni|viṃśati yāvatyugmāni;ekonaviṃśatiṃ yāvatayugmāni caturaśra ṣaḍaśrāṣṭāśra vṛtteṣu dhāmasu sthūpikākīlaṃevamevasyāt evaṃ kīlaṃ kṛtvā|

original: tadadhaḥ nālaṃ dvyaṃgulavistāraṃ, tatrapāśrvayoḥardhāṃgulāyāmavistāra nimnayutaṃ kṛtvā| anyat sūtrapātāt bahiḥ sthitaṃ śeṣeṇa hitvā|galādhovaśiṣṭāṃśaṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃvā kalpayitvā| galamadhye tṛtīyabhāga saṃmitaṃvistārāyāmasamaṃ gādha sadṛśaṃ gartaṃ vṛttaṃ vā kṛtya|garta bāhyaṃ tredhā vidhāya| prathamavalayedalāṣṭakaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: tad adhas nālam dvi aṃgula vistāram kṛtvā anyat sūtra pātāt bahis sthitam śeṣeṇa hitvā gala adhas vaśiṣṭa aṃśam vṛttam caturaśram vā kalpayitvā gala madhye tṛtīya bhāga saṃmitam vistāra āyāma samam gādha sadṛśam gartam vṛttam vā kṛtya garta bāhyam tredhā vidhāya prathama valaye dala aṣṭakam kṛtvā

original: madhyāṃśaṃ caturdhā vibhajya| ādyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalaṃ tasya bahiḥ nemimaṇḍalasyamadhye, maṇḍaladvayaṃ ca ekī kṛtya| tasmin ṣaṭ vā daśa vā indīvaradalavat arāṇikalpayitvā| avaśiṣṭena ekabhāgena nemi maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya|tatkoṇeṣu caturṣu śaṃkhān kṛtvā|bahiḥ mekhalāṃ yavonnatāṃ kṛtvā| caturyavapramāṇena gartaṃ ārabhya|agrāntaṃ sarpiṣaḥ vivaraṃkṛtvā|
analyzed: madhya aṃśam caturdhā vibhajya ādyam nābhi maṇḍalam tasya bahis nemi maṇḍalasya madhye maṇḍala dvayam ca ekīkṛtya tasmin ṣaḍ vā daśa vā indīvara dala vat arāṇi kalpayitvā avaśiṣṭena eka bhāgena nemi maṇḍalam nirmāya tad koṇeṣu caturṣu śaṃkhān kṛtvā bahis mekhalām yava unnatām kṛtvā catur yava pramāṇena gartam ārabhya agra antam sarpiṣaḥ vivaram kṛtvā

original: tatpṛṣṭha bhāgaṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhasadṛśaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhasadṛśaṃvā caturaśraṃ vidhāya| ādhāraṃvinā antyaṃvalayatrayāṅkitaṃ vṛttaṃ caturaśraṃ aṣṭāśraṃ vā kṛtvā|tadagraṃ ca yathāpuraṃ kamalākāraṃ kalpayet|sruvasya tu daṇḍaṃ hastamānaṃ kṛtvā| tadagraṃ dvyaṃgula vistāraṃ tanmadhye nāsikāpuṭavatardhāṃgulavistārāyāmaṃ vṛttaṃ gartadvayamāpādya|
analyzed: tad pṛṣṭha bhāgam kamaṭha pṛṣṭha sadṛśam kūrma pṛṣṭha sadṛśam vā caturaśram vidhāya ādhāram vinā antyam valaya traya aṅkitam vṛttam caturaśram aṣṭāśram vā kṛtvā tad agram ca yathāpuram kamala ākāram kalpayet sruvasya tu daṇḍam hasta mānam kṛtvā tad agram dvi aṃgula vistāram tad madhye vṛttam garta dvayam āpādya

original: tadadhaḥ gartadvayasya madhye rekhikāṃ yavonnatāṃtayoḥparitaśca avaśiṣṭena ekāṃgulena galaṃ ca vidhāya|pariśiṣṭena golāṃgulākṛtiṃ kṛtvā|mūlaṃ dvyaṃgula vistīrṇaṃ kārayet|maṇḍapasya dvārāṇāṃ catuṣṭayepi prāgādikrameṇa aśvattha, udumbara,plakṣa,vaṭavṛkṣaiḥ teṣu ekena vāyathoktālābhe candanadrumeṇa vā toraṇāni kuryāt|
analyzed: tad adhas garta dvayasya madhye rekhikām yava unnata aṃtayoḥ paritas ca avaśiṣṭena eka aṃgulena galam ca vidhāya pariśiṣṭena gola aṃgula ākṛtim kṛtvā mūlam dvi aṃgula vistīrṇam kārayet maṇḍapasya dvārāṇām catuṣṭaye pi prāc ādi krameṇa aśvattha udumbara plakṣa vaṭa vṛkṣaiḥ teṣu ekena vā yathā ukta alābhe candana drumeṇa vā toraṇāni kuryāt

original: tatpādān saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vāayugmaiḥhastaiḥ āyatān dvāviṃśāṃgulaghanān vṛttān caturaśrān vā kṛtvā|tadupari tadardhena āyatāḥ tādṛśānāhayutāḥ tathāvidhāśca paṭṭikāḥ kalpayitvā| prati paṭṭikaṃdvitālamānāni aṣṭāṃgulānāhayutāni trīṇi trīṇi kīlāni ca nidhāya|
analyzed: tad pādān saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vā ayugmaiḥ hastaiḥ āyatān dvāviṃśa aṃgula ghanān vṛttān caturaśrān vā kṛtvā tad upari tad ardhena āyatāḥ tādṛśa ānāha yutāḥ tathāvidhāḥ ca paṭṭikāḥ kalpayitvā prati paṭṭikam dvi tāla mānāni aṣṭa aṃgula ānāha yutāni trīṇi trīṇi kīlāni ca nidhāya

original: toraṇānāṃ pādeṣupūrṇakumbha dakṣiṇāvartaśaṅkha cakra dhvaja paṭaha kārmukanāgān ca citrayet|atha aṣṭa maṅgala vidhiḥyathāvibhavaṃ hemādi lohajāni vā yājñīya vṛkṣajāni vā krameṇa dvāviṃśāṅgula tadadrdhadvayaṅgulaiḥ āyāmavistṛti ghanayutāni sapīṭhāni phalakāni kalpayitvā|teṣu śrīvatsapūrṇakumbha bherī darpaṇamaṇḍala matsyayugma śaṅkhacakrāṇi,
analyzed: toraṇānām ca aṣṭa maṅgala vidhiḥ yathāvibhavam hema ādi loha jāni vā yājñīya vṛkṣa jāni vā krameṇa dvāviṃśa aṅgula tad adrdha dvayaṅgulaiḥ āyāma vistṛti ghana yutāni sa pīṭhāni phalakāni kalpayitvā teṣu śrīvatsa pūrṇa kumbha bherī darpaṇa maṇḍala matsya yugma śaṅkha cakrāṇi

original: padmāsanasthitaṃ garuḍaṃca,dvāviṃśāṅgula mānena kalpayitvā| teṣāṃ pāśrvayoḥ mūrdhani ca cāmara pradīpa chatrāṇilāñchayet|
analyzed: padmāsana sthitam garuḍam ca dvāviṃśa aṅgula mānena kalpayitvā teṣām mūrdhani ca cāmara pradīpa chatra aṇi lāñchayet

original: biṃbapramāṇānuguṇyena auduṃbarasnānapīṭhaṃ nayanonmīlanapīṭhajalādhivāsanāsanādīn ca ācārya mūrtipāsana pādukāḥ ca upakumbha kalaśa karakamaṇikadīpastambha ghṛtādi snapanadravya candanādi sugandha vividhavastu samit puṣpa kuśa vividhadhānya suvarṇādiloha ratna savatsagoprabhṛtīn anyān ca saṃbhārān pūrvaṃ saṃpādya|
analyzed: biṃba pramāṇa ānuguṇyena auduṃbara snāna pīṭham nayana unmīlana pīṭha jala adhivāsana āsana ādīn ca ācārya mūrtipāsana pādukāḥ ca upakumbha kalaśa karaka maṇika dīpa stambha ghṛta ādi snapana dravya candana ādi sugandha vividha vastu samidh puṣpa kuśa vividha dhānya suvarṇa ādi loha ratna sa vatsa go prabhṛtīn anyān ca saṃbhārān pūrvam saṃpādya

original: tadanuācāryaḥ yathāvidhi pratiṣṭhāmārabhet|iti kriyākairavacandrikāyāṃ pratiṣṭhā upakaraṇa vidhiḥnāma daśamaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: tadanu ācāryaḥ yathāvidhi pratiṣṭhām ārabha iti kriyākairavacandrikāyām pratiṣṭhā upakaraṇa vidhiḥ nāma daśamaḥ paricchedaḥ

analyzed: ekādaśa paricchedaḥ

pūrvaṃ śilpibhiḥ śāstrokta vatrmanā bimbe māna-unmānapramāṇaparimāṇaupamānalambamānābhidhalakṣaṇayute nirmite, sthūlasūkṣmeṣu pratiṃmāṅgeṣu sukṛteṣu, karmārcā pīṭhikāyāṃ ratnādi nyāsaṃ kṛtvā| śilpinaiva nayaneca unmīlite,tataḥ guruḥ yajamānena saha rathakāraṃ śilpinaḥ ca ābharaṇa vastrādyaiḥ vastubhiḥ toṣayet|
analyzed: pūrvam śilpibhiḥ śāstra ukta vatrmanā bimbe māna aunmāna pramāṇa parimāṇa aupamāna lambamāna abhidha lakṣaṇa yute nirmite sthūla sūkṣmeṣu su kṛteṣu karma arcā pīṭhikāyām ratna ādi nyāsam kṛtvā śilpinā eva nayane ca unmīlita itatas guruḥ yajamānena saha rathakāram śilpinaḥ ca ābharaṇa vastra ādyaiḥ vastubhiḥ toṣayet

original: teṣu ca nirgateṣu sadanamantarbahiḥ ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya, darbhapuñjaiḥprajvālitaiḥ paryagnikaraṇaṃ ca kṛtvā| prākāra gopura maṇḍapāni ca mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya| pañcagavyaiḥ pavamānādi sūktaiḥ samprokṣya| goghṛtena sarvata bahūn dīpān uddīpya| kālāgaruprabhṛta dhūpadravyaiḥ sarvataḥ dhūpayitvā|
analyzed: teṣu ca nirgateṣu sadanam antar bahis ca mārjana ālepana ādibhiḥ saṃśodhya darbha puñjaiḥ prajvālitaiḥ paryagnikaraṇam ca kṛtvā prākāra gopura maṇḍapāni ca mārjana ālepana ādibhiḥ saṃśodhya pañcagavyaiḥ pavamāna ādi sūktaiḥ samprokṣya go ghṛtena sarvatas bahūn dīpān uddīpya kālāgaru prabhṛta dhūpa dravyaiḥ sarvatas dhūpayitvā

original: dūrvākṣata sudhācūrṇaiḥ dhāma salaṃkṛtya| tataḥ aparāṅgha samaye, guru bimbasya’‘mānādinyūnātireka śāntyarthaṃ śānti homaṃ kariṣye’‘iti saṃkalpya|puṇyāhama vācayitvā| vidhivat agniṃ saṃskṛtya|
analyzed: dūrvā akṣata sudhā cūrṇaiḥ dhāma salaṃkṛtya tatas aparāṅgha samaye guru bimbasyamāna ādi nyūna atireka śānti artham śānti homam kariṣye iti vācayitvā vidhivat agnim saṃskṛtya

original: sākṣataiḥ śamīpallavaiḥ’‘ oṃbhūsvāhā’‘ ‘‘oṃbhuvasvāhā’‘ , ‘‘oṃ suvaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ mahaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ janaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ tapaḥsvāhā’‘,’‘oṃ satyaṃsvāhā’‘,iti pratyekaṃ śatamāhutīḥ caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśāhutīḥ ca,’‘oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥ parāyaparameṣṭyātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāyapuruṣātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ vāṃ namaḥ
analyzed: sa akṣataiḥ śamī pallavaiḥ om bhū svāhā om bhuvaḥ svāhā om suvar svāhā om mahaḥ svāhā om janaḥ svāhā om tapaḥ svāhā om satyam svāhā iti pratyekam śatam āhutīḥ caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśa āhutīḥ ca om ṣauṃ namaḥ parāya parameṣṭi ātmane svāhā om yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣa ātmane svāhā om rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane svāhā om vām namaḥ

original: parāyanivṛtyātmane svāhā’‘,’‘oṃ lāṃnamaḥ parāyasarvātmane svāhā’‘,itipratimāsannidhau hutvā tadanu namastubhyaṃ bhagavate jāta vedasvarūpiṇe| nārāyaṇāya havyasya kavyasya ca yathātatham| bhoktre yaṣṭavyadevānāṃ ātmane paramātmane| sannidhatsva ciraṃ deva pratimāyāṃ hitāya naḥ| iti mantreṇa,adhokṣajamagnisthaṃ devaṃ devaṃ prāñjaliḥ san upasthāya|
analyzed: parāya nivṛti ātmane svāhā om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarva ātmane svāhā iti pratimā sannidhau hutvā tadanu namaḥ tubhyam bhagavate jāta veda svarūpiṇe nārāyaṇāya havyasya kavyasya ca yathātatham bhoktre yaṣṭavya devānām ātmane paramātmane sannidhatsva ciram deva pratimāyām hitāya naḥ iti mantreṇa adhokṣajam agni stham devam devam prāñjaliḥ san upasthāya

original: agniṃ praṇipatya | sadarbhena navena vāsasā mūlamantreṇa pratimāmācchādya|tenaiva uttarīyaṃ ca vitīrya| viṣṇu gāya rtyā aghrya pādyācamanīya gandha puṣpadhūpadīpādyaiḥ abhyarcya|śrī bhūmyostu oṃ śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ, oṃ hrīṃ bhūmyai namaḥ iti tattanmantraiḥ vastrācchādanādi dīpāntaiḥ abhyarcya | brahmādi parivārāṇāṃ ca svasva mantreṇa tathā kṛtvā|
analyzed: agnim praṇipatya sa darbhena navena vāsasā mūlamantreṇa uttarīyam ca vitīrya pādya ācamanīya gandha puṣpa dhūpa dīpa ādyaiḥ abhyarcya śrī bhūmyoḥ tu om śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ om hrīṃ bhūmyai namaḥ iti tad tad mantraiḥ vastra ācchādana ādi dīpa antaiḥ abhyarcya brahma ādi parivārāṇām ca sva sva mantreṇa tathā kṛtvā

original: chāyādhivāsa siddhyarthaṃ rakṣā bandhana karmakariṣye, iti saṅkalpya | suvarṇādi pātre, khāridroṇa taṇdulavati ṣaṣṭyuttarakramuka taccaturguṇa nāgavāllīdala tadardha kadalyādi phalayute, niṣphapramāṇa svarṇa sūtrāṇi yadvā saptabhiḥ,pañcabhiḥ vā tantubhiḥ kṛtāni kṣaumamayāni kārpāsamayāni vā sūtrāṇi nidhāya| ahatena vāsasā ācchādya|
analyzed: chāyā adhivāsa siddhi artham rakṣā bandhana karma kariṣye iti saṅkalpya suvarṇa ādi pātre khāri droṇa taṇdulavati ṣaṣṭi uttara kramuka tad caturguṇa nāgavāllī dala tad ardha kadalyādi phala yute niṣpha pramāṇa svarṇa sūtrāṇi yat vā saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vā tantubhiḥ kṛtāni kṣauma mayāni kārpāsa mayāni vā sūtrāṇi nidhāya ahatena vāsasā ācchādya

original: tat paricāraka mūdhrni vinyasya| cāmara vyajanachatranṛttagīta bṛhaddīpaiḥ sākam dhāmāvaraṇāni grāmaṃ vā pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| bimbasya purataḥ caturaśraṃ bhūmiṃ gomayena anulipya| tatra dhānyabhāreṇa pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā|tadupari tatpātraṃ nidhāya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| sahasrāra huṃ phaṭ iti mantreṇa sūtrāṇi saptavāramabhi mantya| saṃpūjya|
analyzed: tat paricāraka mūdhrni vinyasya cāmara vyajana chatra nṛtta gīta bṛhat dīpaiḥ sākam dhāma āvaraṇāni grāmam vā pradakṣiṇī kṛtya bimbasya puratas caturaśram bhūmim gomayena anulipya tatra dhānya bhāreṇa pīṭham kṛtvā tad upari tat pātram nidhāya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya sahasrāra hum phaṭ iti mantreṇa sūtrāṇi sapta vāram abhi mantya saṃpūjya

original: biṃbaṃ sampūjya| hastayoḥ aṅguṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ tāni gṛhītvā| tryaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ| urvārukamiva bandhanāt mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya māmṛtā iti mantreṇa candanakṣodena anulipya|
analyzed: biṃbam sampūjya hastayoḥ aṅguṣṭa anāmikābhyām tāni gṛhītvā tryaṃbakam yajāmahe sugandhim puṣṭi vardhanam urvārukam iva bandhanāt mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya mā amṛtā iti mantreṇa candana kṣodena anulipya

original: viśvettāte savaneṣu pravācyā yācakarthamaghavannindrasunvate pārāvataṃ yat purasaṃbhṛtaṃ vaśvapāvṛṇoccharabhāya ṛṣi bandhave iti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇavā devasya dakṣiṇe, devyāḥ vāme ca haste baddhvā| astramantraṃ śatavāraṃjaptvā | yo brahmābrahmaṇa ujjahāra iti ghṛtasūktena abhimantya | bṛhatsāmakṣatrabhṛt eiti dhūpapātra bhasmanā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: viśvā ittāte savaneṣu pravācyāḥ yācaka artha maghavan indra sunvate pārāvatam yat pura saṃbhṛtam iti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇa vā devasya dakṣiṇe devyāḥ vāme ca haste baddhvā astramantram śata vāram japtvā yaḥ brahma abrahmaṇaḥ ujjahāra iti ghṛta sūktena abhimantya bṛhatsāma kṣatrabhṛt dhūpa pātra bhasmanā rakṣām kṛtvā

original: arghyādibhiḥ deva devyau ca abhyarcya| mahāpūpaṃ nivedya| ācāryaḥ svasyadakṣiṇa haste kautukaṃ baddhvā| devaṃ dviṣaṭkākṣara vidyayāpraṇamya| saṃstutya| devasya purataḥ bhūmau chāyādhivāsārthaṃ dhānyapīṭhe suvarṇādi lohajāṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vā jaladroṇīṃ tādṛśaṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya| gālitena gandhodakena āpūrya| darbhaiḥ paristīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|

analyzed: om ṭhaṃ namaḥ parāya vāma ūru madhya ātmane svāhā om ḍaṃ namaḥ parāya vāma jānu ātmane svāhā om ḍhaṃ namaḥ parāya vāma jānu ātmane svāhā om ṇaṃ namaḥ parāya vāma pāda ātmane svāhā om taṃ namaḥ parāya dakṣiṇa bhuja mūla ātmane svāhā om thaṃ namaḥ parāya dakṣiṇa bhuja madhya ātmane svāhā om daṃ namaḥ parāya dakṣiṇa bhuja sandhyā ātmane svāhā

original: kuṇḍasthānapi upariṣṭāttantrapūrvakaṃ devasya hṛdaye samāropya| mahākuṃbhopakuṃbhān aṣṭama’lāni ca uddhṛtya| vahadbhiḥ mūrtipaiḥ saha ācāryaḥ svayaṃ karakaṃ gṛhītvā| avicchinnagalantinirgalitavāridhārayā agre mārgaṃ siñcan gehaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya, garbhamandiraṃ praviśya| tatra dhānya pīṭhe kuṃbhān krameṇa saṃsthāpya|

original: punaḥ śayyāvedistha devanikaṭaṃ āsādya| brāhmaṇānujñānupūrvakaṃ devaṃ hastābhyāṃ ‘uttiṣṭa brahmaṇaspate’‘ityutthāpya| chatra dhvaja patākādyaiḥ akhila vādyaghoṣaiḥ brahmaghoṣaiḥ anūcānaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ adhīyānaiḥ mūrtipaiśca sākaṃ ācāryaḥ ṣaḍa’nyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā| gehaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| mūlamandiraṃ praviśya|
analyzed: punar śayyā vedi stha deva nikaṭam āsādya brāhmaṇa anujñā anupūrvakam devam hastābhyām uttiṣṭa brahmaṇaspate iti utthāpya chatra dhvaja patākā ādyaiḥ akhila vādya ghoṣaiḥ brahmaghoṣaiḥ anūcānaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ vaiṣṇavaiḥ adhīyānaiḥ mūrtipaiḥ ca sākam ācāryaḥ ṣaḍanyāsa ādikam kṛtvā geham pradakṣiṇīkṛtya mūlamandiram praviśya

original: tatra garbhagṛhadvāri devaṃ arghyādibhiḥ saṃpūjya| antaḥ praveśya| piṇḍikāṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| sumuhūrte ‘pratiṣṭhāsi’ iti sāma ‘ātvāhārṣaṃ’ iti, ‘dhruvādyauḥ’ iti mantrān gurvanujñayā| mūrtipeṣu paṭhatsu| ācāryaḥ devasya purataḥsthitvā| ‘‘oṃ lāṃ namaḥparāya sarvātmane namaḥ’‘itimantreṇa piṇḍikāyāṃ devaṃ saṃsthāpya|
analyzed: tatra garbhagṛha dvāri devam arghya ādibhiḥ saṃpūjya antar praveśya piṇḍikām pradakṣiṇī kṛtya su muhūrte pratiṣṭhā asi iti sāma iti dhruvāt yauḥ iti mantrān guru anujñayā mūrtipeṣu paṭhatsu ācāryaḥ devasya puratas sthitvā om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ iti mantreṇa piṇḍikāyām devam saṃsthāpya

original: devasya sthite samatāṃ ūrdhva laṃbita sūtreṇa niścitya| piṇḍikānālarandraṃ lākṣāsarjarasasikta kuruvindaguggulu gairika guḍataila dṛḍapeṣaṇa janitena aṣṭabandhanena dṛḍhīkṛtya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| anantaraṃ devaṃ āvāhayet| āvāhayāmi taṃ devaṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam| ānandaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ parātparam|
analyzed: devasya sthite samatām sūtreṇa niścitya piṇḍikā nāla randram lākṣā sarja rasa sikta kuruvinda guggulu gairika guḍa taila dṛḍa peṣaṇa janitena aṣṭabandhanena dṛḍhīkṛtya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya anantaram devam āvāhayet āvāhayāmi tam devam tamasaḥ param avyayam ānandam sarvagam nityam vyoma atītam parātparam

original: marīci cakramadhyasthaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum| ‘‘iti dhyātvā| dviṣaṭkamanunā devamāvāhya| brahmarandhreṇa pratimāṃ praviṣṭaṃ dhyātvā| kumbhasthaṃ devaṃ pratimāyāṃ mūlena saṃyojya| devasya tenaiva nyāsaṃ kṛtvā| sānnidhyaṃ prāthrya| pūrvoktavidhānena parivāra kalpane ca vidhāya| devaṃ arghyādibhiḥabhyarcya| pāyasānnaṃ nivedya|
analyzed: marīci cakra madhya stham vāsudevam ajam vibhum iti dhyātvā dvi ṣaṭka manunā devam āvāhya brahmarandhreṇa pratimām praviṣṭam dhyātvā kumbha stham devam pratimāyām mūlena saṃyojya devasya tena eva nyāsam kṛtvā sānnidhyam prāthrya pūrva ukta vidhānena parivāra kalpane ca vidhāya devam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya pāyasa annam nivedya

original: pratyagraiḥ vasanaiḥ kambalai rvā ‘‘yuvā suvāsāḥ’‘iti mantreṇa pariveṣṭya| dinatrayaṃ garbhamandira dvāraṃ kavāṭena bandhayet| tadā brāhmaṇānapi vitta go bhojanādibhiḥ toṣayet| caturthe ahani prāpte prātareva kavāṭaṃ udghāṭya| devasya snapanaṃ yathāvidhi kṛtvā| taddine dhvajārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā| ayaṃ vidhiḥ ekaberamātrameva kāryaḥ|
analyzed: pratyagraiḥ vasanaiḥ kambalaiḥ rvā yuvā su vāsāḥ iti mantreṇa pariveṣṭya dina trayam garbhamandira dvāram kavāṭena bandhayet tadā brāhmaṇān api vitta go bhojana ādibhiḥ toṣayet caturthe ahani prāpte prātar eva kavāṭam udghāṭya devasya snapanam yathāvidhi kṛtvā tad dine dhvaja ārohaṇam kṛtvā ayam vidhiḥ eka bera mātram eva kāryaḥ

original: bahubheravidhāne tu bimbaṃ citrādikaṃ cet ratnanyāsaḥśūlasthāpana velāyāmeva kāryaḥ| pratiṣṭhā samaye garbhagehaṃ praviśya| mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya| tatra candanādrrāni sūtrāṇi prāgudaṅmukhāni aṣṭau aṣṭau nipātya|teṣu ekonapañcāśatkoṣṭheṣu madhyabhāgaḥ brāhmaḥ| dvitīyaḥ daivaḥ,tṛtīyaḥ mānuṣaḥ,turyaḥpaiśācaḥ|
analyzed: bahu bhera vidhāne tu bimbam citra ādikam ced ratna nyāsaḥ śūla sthāpana velāyām eva kāryaḥ pratiṣṭhā samaye garbhageham praviśya mārjana ālepana ādibhiḥ saṃśodhya tatra sūtrāṇi prāc udak mukhāni aṣṭau aṣṭau nipātyateṣu ekonapañcāśat koṣṭheṣu madhya bhāgaḥ brāhmaḥ dvitīyaḥ daivaḥ tṛtīyaḥ mānuṣaḥ turyaḥ paiśācaḥ

original: brāhme arcanāpīṭhaḥ,daive sthitiḥ, mānuṣe parivāraḥ,paiśāce āyudhāni, kiṃcit mānuṣāśritya daive āsanaṃ, divya mānuṣayoḥśayyā, paiśāce yānaṃ daive devyaḥ, āsīne deve āsīnāḥ, sthite sthitāḥ pāśrve,śayāne yānārūḍhe ca deve devyaḥ yathābhimataṃ kalpanīyāḥ| yadvā udaṅmukhāni daśa prāṅmukhāni tāvanti sūtrāṇi nipātya|
analyzed: brāhme arcanā pīṭhaḥ daive sthitiḥ mānuṣe parivāraḥ paiśāce āyudhāni kiṃcid mānuṣa āśritya daive āsanam divya mānuṣayoḥ śayyā paiśāce yānam daive devyaḥ āsīne deve āsīnāḥ sthite sthitāḥ pāśrveśa yāne yāna ārūḍhe ca deve devyaḥ yathā abhimatam kalpanīyāḥ yat vā udak mukhāni daśa prāc mukhāni tāvanti sūtrāṇi nipātya

original: teṣu ekottarāśīti koṣṭheṣu madhyamaḥ bhāgaḥ brāhmaḥ dvitīyaḥ daivaḥ,tṛtīyaḥ paitṛkaḥ, turīyaḥ mānuṣaḥ,pañcamaḥ paiśācaḥ,iti bhāgān kṛtvā| ekaberasya brāhmo bhāgaḥ, bahubherasya daivikaḥ, daiva mānuṣayoḥ āsanaṃ, daivamānuṣa paitṛkeṣu śayanaṃ, mānuṣa paiśācayoḥ yānaṃ iti vā kuryāt| uktasthānaviparyaye rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati|
analyzed: teṣu ekottara aśīti koṣṭheṣu madhyamaḥ bhāgaḥ brāhmaḥ dvitīyaḥ daivaḥ tṛtīyaḥ paitṛkaḥ turīyaḥ mānuṣaḥ pañcamaḥ paiśācaḥ iti bhāgān kṛtvā ekaberasya brāhmaḥ bhāgaḥ bahubherasya daivikaḥ daiva mānuṣayoḥ āsanam daiva mānuṣa paitṛkeṣu śayanam mānuṣa paiśācayoḥ yānam iti vā kuryāt ukta sthāna viparyaye rāja rāṣṭram vinaśyati

original: tasmāt yathāśāstraṃ sādhayet| napuṃsaka śilāyāṃ pūrvavat ratna nyāsaḥ| sthitasya pādamūle ca anyeṣāṃ āsanādīnāṃ pūrvaṃ ratnāni bhājane adhivāsya| pṛṣṭataḥ eva ratna nyāsaṃ kuryāt| karmādyarcāḥ tu mahākumbhopakumbhakarakaiḥ sākaṃ samuddhṛtya mūtrtipaiḥ sākaṃ svayaṃ ācāryaḥ karakaṃ gṛhītvā|
analyzed: tasmāt yathāśāstram sādhayet napuṃsaka śilāyām pūrvavat ratna nyāsaḥ sthitasya pādamūle ca anyeṣām āsana ādīnām pūrvam ratnāni bhājane adhivāsya pṛṣṭataḥ eva ratna nyāsam kuryāt karma ādi arcāḥ tu mahākumbha upakumbha karakaiḥ sākam samuddhṛtya mūtrtipaiḥ sākam svayam ācāryaḥ karakam gṛhītvā

original: sa veda vādyaghoṣaṃ devasya agre avicchinnayā galantikāgalata vāridhārayā mārgaṃ siñcan svasya biṃbasya ca antarā pathi kaścidapi yathā na gacchet| tathā devāgāraṃ prādakṣiṇyena praviśya| tatra dvāridevaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| antaḥ praviśya| karmārcāṃ arcanāpīṭhe nṛsūktena niveśya| utsavādyartha bimbāni ca tatpāśrvayoḥ niveśya|
analyzed: sa veda vādya ghoṣam devasya agre avicchinnayā vāri dhārayā mārgam siñcan svasya biṃbasya ca antarā pathi kaścid api yathā na gacchet tathā devāgāram prādakṣiṇyena praviśya tatra dvāri devam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya antar praviśya karma arcām arcanā pīṭhe nṛsūktena niveśya utsava ādi artha bimbāni ca tad pāśrvayoḥ niveśya

original: dhārāvaśiṣṭaṃ galantikodakaṃ śarāve nikṣipya| śalākikā mātrayā dhārayā mūlamantreṇa biṃbānāṃ pariṣecanaṃ kṛtvā| devasyāgre dhānyarāśiṣu kumbhān nikṣipya| vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā āvāhayet| ācāryaḥ sumuhūrte mūlaberasya purataḥ sthitvā| padmāsanam baddhvā| prāṇānāyamya| sanātanaṃ brahmam dhyāyet| vāsudevamajaṃ śāntaṃ ujjvalaṃ santatoditam|
analyzed: dhārā avaśiṣṭam galantikā udakam śarāve nikṣipya śalākikā mātrayā dhārayā mūlamantreṇa biṃbānām pariṣecanam kṛtvā devasya agre dhānya rāśiṣu kumbhān nikṣipya vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā āvāhayet ācāryaḥ su muhūrte mūlaberasya puratas sthitvā padmāsanam baddhvā prāṇān āyamya sanātanam brahmam dhyāyet vāsudevam ajam śāntam ujjvalam santata uditam

original: anādimadhyanidhanaṃ ekaṃ vyāpyācalaṃ sthiram| cidganaṃ paramānandaṃ tamasaḥ paramavyayam| jñānaśakti balaiśvarya vīryatejassamanvitam| apādapāṇi aspṛśyaṃ acakṣuśśravaṇādikam| sarvatra karavākpādaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham| sadāgativinirmuktaṃ ravikoṭi samaprabham| caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ vyomātītaṃ tadadbhutam|
analyzed: an ādi madhya nidhanam ekam vyāpya acalam sthiram parama ānandam tamasaḥ param avyayam jñāna śakti bala aiśvarya vīrya tejaḥ samanvitam a pāda pāṇi a spṛśyam a cakṣuḥ śravaṇa ādikam sarvatra kara vāc pādam sarvatas akṣi śiraḥ mukham sadāgati vinirmuktam ravi koṭi sama prabham caitanyam sarvagam nityam vyoma atītam tat adbhutam

original: citsāmānyaṃ jagatyasmin mūlamantrātmakaṃ param| evaṃ vidhaṃ sadāviṣṇuṃ āhlādaṃ praṇavātmakam||evaṃ samyak dhyātvā| sadāviṣṇuṃ mahāviṣṇau niyojya|mahāviṣṇau viṣṇau niyojya| viṣṇuṃ svahṛdayakamale,’‘oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣātmane namaḥ’ ‘ityāvāhya| añjaliṃkṛtvā| añjalimadhye padmāsanaṃ vicintya| tadbhadrāsanaṃ dhyātvā|
analyzed: cit sāmānyam jagati asmin mūlamantra ātmakam param evaṃvidham sadāviṣṇum āhlādam praṇava ātmakam evam samyak dhyātvā sadāviṣṇum mahāviṣṇau niyojya mahāviṣṇau viṣṇau niyojya viṣṇum sva hṛdaya kamale om yām namaḥ parāya puruṣa ātmane namaḥ iti āvāhya añjalim kṛtvā añjali madhye padmāsanam vicintya tat bhadrāsanam dhyātvā

original: tasmin svahṛdayakamala sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ ‘‘oṃ rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane namaḥ’‘ityāvāhya|taṃ añjalisthaṃ ‘‘oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛtyātmane namaḥ’‘iti pratimāyāṃ brahmarandramārgeṇa praviṣṭaṃ vicintya| ‘‘oṃ lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ’‘iti biṃbaṃ sarvataḥ vyāpya sthitaṃ smṛtvā|
analyzed: tasmin sva hṛdaya kamala sthitam viṣṇum om rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane namaḥ iti añjali stham om yāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛti ātmane namaḥ iti pratimāyām brahmarandra mārgeṇa praviṣṭam vicintya om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ iti biṃbam sarvatas vyāpya sthitam smṛtvā

original: mahākumbhagatāṃ śaktiṃ, kumbhāvāhita bālakautuka śaktiṃ, mūrtikumbhagatāḥ śaktiśca tattatkumbhagata jalasthitakūrcaiḥ mūlena devena saṃyojya| bimbabrahmarandhraṃ praṇavena pidhāya| āvāhana sthāpana mudre pradaśrya| ‘jitaṃ te’ iti stutvā| pratimāmudrāṃ pradaśrya| devaṃ ātmanaḥ abhimukhaṃ dhyātvā| praṇamya utthāya|
analyzed: mahākumbha gatām śaktim kumbha āvāhita śaktim mūrti kumbha gatāḥ śaktiḥ ca tad tad kumbha gata jala sthita kūrcaiḥ mūlena devena saṃyojya bimba brahmarandhram praṇavena pidhāya āvāhana sthāpana mudre pradaśrya jitam te iti stutvā pratimā mudrām pradaśrya devam ātmanaḥ abhimukham dhyātvā praṇamya utthāya

original: sannidhāna sannirodhana, sāmmukhya, prārthanāmudrāḥ pradaśrya| ‘svāgataṃbhagavataḥ’ ityuktvā svāgatamudrāṃ pradarśya | devasya mūlamantreṇa yathāvidhi nyāsaṃ kuryāt| sthitau sthitinyāsaḥ, āsane sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ saṃhāra śayane saṃhṛtinyāsaḥ,sṛṣṭiśayane sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ, bhogaśayane yogaśayane viśvarūpe ca sthitinyāsaḥ| yānārūḍhe nyāsatrayam|
analyzed: sannidhāna sannirodhana sāmmukhya prārthanā mudrāḥ pradaśrya svāgatam bhagavataḥ iti uktvā svāgata mudrām pradarśya devasya mūlamantreṇa yathāvidhi nyāsam kuryāt sthitau sthiti nyāsaḥ āsane sṛṣṭi nyāsaḥ saṃhāra śayane saṃhṛti nyāsaḥ sṛṣṭi śayane sṛṣṭi nyāsaḥ bhoga śayane yoga śayane viśvarūpe ca sthiti nyāsaḥ yāna ārūḍhe nyāsa trayam

original: yadvā āsanādiṣu sarvatra sthitinyāsaḥ eva kāryaḥśyādidevīnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca mahākumbhajalena svasvanāma mantreṇa prokṣya| śayyādīnāṃ ṣaḍaṅga nyāsaṃ, brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ rudrasya saṃhāranyāsaṃ ca kuryāt| caṇḍapracaṇḍa garuḍa viṣvaksenādi sarva parivārān sve sve sthāne saṃsthāpya| ācāryaḥ svayameva mahākumbhaṃ gṛhītvā|
analyzed: yat vā āsana ādiṣu sarvatra sthiti nyāsaḥ eva kāryaḥ śyā ādi devīnām brahma ādīnām ca mahākumbha jalena sva sva nāma mantreṇa prokṣya śayyā ādīnām ṣaḍaṅga nyāsam brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭi nyāsaḥ rudrasya saṃhāra nyāsam ca kuryāt caṇḍa pracaṇḍa garuḍa viṣvaksena ādi sarva parivārān sve sve sthāne saṃsthāpya ācāryaḥ svayam eva mahākumbham gṛhītvā

original: tajjalena kūrcena caṇḍādi parivārāṇāṃ praṇavādi namontena sva sva mantreṇa tatkṣaṇe eva prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā| avaśiṣṭaṃ mahākumbhajalaṃ balipīṭhe saṃsicya| mahānasāgni kuṇḍe adhiśrapaṇe ca gārhapatyāgniṃ saṃsthāpya| ācāryaḥ yajamānena saha devasya pārśvaṃ āsādya| praṇamya| utthāya| añjaliṃ baddhvā| imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet|

original: tataḥ aparāhṇasamaye mānādīnāṃ nyūnātireka doṣaśāntyarthaṃ prāsādāgre yathāvidhi śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā| ‘ namastubhyaṃ bhagavate’‘ iti upasthāya| sadarbhaiḥ navavastraiḥ mūlamantreṇa prāsādāntargata pratimāḥ ācchādya| uttarīyaṃ ca datvā| viṣṇugāyartyā, arghyādibhiḥ saṃpūjya|
analyzed: tatas aparāhṇa samaye māna ādīnām nyūna atireka doṣa śānti artham prāsāda agre yathāvidhi śānti homam kṛtvā namaḥ tubhyam bhagavate iti upasthāya sa darbhaiḥ nava vastraiḥ mūlamantreṇa prāsāda antargata pratimāḥ ācchādya uttarīyam ca da tvā arghya ādibhiḥ saṃpūjya

original: chāyādhivāsārthaṃ vimānasya tadgatadevatānāṃ svasya ca rakṣābandhanaṃ kṛtvā vimānaṃ dvādaśākṣareṇa abhyarcya| tasyapurataḥ chāyādhivāsārthaṃ vrīhi,taṇḍula tilaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā|tasmin svarṇādiloha nirmitaṃ kaṭāhaṃ, tādṛśīṃ jaladroṇīṃ vā saṃsthāpya| gandhodakena āpūrya|puṇyāhaṃvācayitvā| dvāratoraṇa kumbhān saṃsthāpya| jalasya śoṣaṇādi kṛtvā|
analyzed: chāyā adhivāsa artham vimānasya tad gata devatānām svasya ca rakṣā bandhanam kṛtvā vimānam dvādaśa akṣareṇa abhyarcya tasya puratas chāyā adhivāsa artham vrīhi taṇḍula tilaiḥ sthaṇḍilam kṛtvā tasmin svarṇa ādi loha nirmitam kaṭāham tādṛśīm jala droṇīm vā saṃsthāpya gandha udakena āpūrya puṇyāham vācayitvā dvāra toraṇa kumbhān saṃsthāpya jalasya śoṣaṇa ādi kṛtvā

original: kṣīrārṇavaṃ dhyātvā| tasmin ādhārādi padmāntaṃ pīṭhaṃ kalpayitvā| aṣṭāviṃśati darbhakṛtakūrcaṃ mūlavidyayā vimānaṃ āvāhya| abhyarcya| ācāryaḥ saṃhārakramaṃ smaran| tasmin taṃ prākchirasaṃ śāyayitvā| cakramudrāṃ pradaśrya| vimānagatadevatānāṃ api dvāviṃśatidarbhakṛtakūrca dvārā pṛthak pṛthak svasvapurataḥ bhājaneṣu yathāvidhi chāyādhivāsaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: kṣīrārṇavam dhyātvā tasmin ādhāra ādi padma antam pīṭham kalpayitvā aṣṭāviṃśati darbha kṛta kūrcam mūlavidyayā vimānam āvāhya abhyarcya ācāryaḥ saṃhāra kramam smaran tasmin tam prāc śirasam śāyayitvā cakra mudrām pradaśrya vimāna gata devatānām api dvāviṃśati darbha kṛta kūrca dvārā pṛthak pṛthak sva sva puratas bhājaneṣu yathāvidhi chāyā adhivāsam kṛtvā

original: pūrvasthāpita jaladroṇyāḥ yāmyāyāṃ diśi yathoktadhānyakṛtasthaṇḍile salakṣaṇaṃ sakarakopakumbhāṣṭakaṃ samsthāpya| paristīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā,prokṣya| madhyakumbhe brahmāṇaṃ karake sudarśanaṃ upakumbhāṣṭake indrādīn ca āvāhya abhyarcya pratyekaśaḥ sarvāṃgīṇaiḥ navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ vimānaṃ tadgatapratimāśca ācchādya|
analyzed: pūrva sthāpita jala droṇyāḥ yāmyāyām diśi yathā ukta dhānyakṛta sthaṇḍile sa lakṣaṇam sa karaka upakumbha aṣṭakam samsthāpya paristīrya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya madhya kumbhe brahmāṇam karake sudarśanam upakumbha aṣṭake indra ādīn ca āvāhya abhyarcya pratyekaśaḥ sarvāṃgīṇaiḥ navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ vimānam tad gata pratimāḥ ca ācchādya

original: ‘rakṣohaṇa’ itimantrena sarvataḥ siddhārthān vikīrya digbandhanaṃ kṛtvā dīpān uddīpya| catasṛṣu dikṣu,vedān udghoṣya dvāresudarśanaṃ āvāhyaabhyarcya| cakramudrāṃ pradaśrya| prādakṣiṇyena sadanāt niṣkramya| ācāryaḥsarvālaṃkārayutaḥ mūrtipaiḥ vedavidbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ sākaṃ pūrvoktamaṇḍape, yathāvidhi pūrvavat vāstuhomaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: rakṣaḥ haṇaḥ iti mantrena sarvatas siddhārthān vikīrya digbandhanam kṛtvā dīpān uddīpya catasṛṣu dikṣu vedān udghoṣya dvāre sudarśanam āvāhya abhyarcya cakra mudrām pradaśrya prādakṣiṇyena sadanāt niṣkramya ācāryaḥ sarva alaṃkāra yutaḥ mūrtipaiḥ veda vidbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ sākam pūrva ukta maṇḍape yathāvidhi pūrvavat vāstu homam kṛtvā

original: tataḥ maṇḍapaṃ mārjanālepanādibhiḥ saṃśodhya| vitānastaṃbhaveṣṭana muktādāma srakdarbhamālā toraṇa phalapuṣpabahudīpāgarudhūpa patākānārikela kadalībhiḥ alaṅkhṛtya| dvāratoraṇa dhvajakumbhān samsthāpya| yathāvidhi vastrādyaḥ saṃyuktān vidhāya tataḥ guruḥ antaḥ praviśya chāyādhivāsitān devān vimānaṃ ca udvāsya| vimānasthitavastrādīni apanīya|
analyzed: tatas maṇḍapam mārjana ālepana ādibhiḥ saṃśodhya vitāna staṃbha veṣṭana muktā dāma sraj darbha mālā toraṇa phala puṣpa bahu dīpa agaru dhūpa patākā nārikela kadalībhiḥ alaṅkhṛtya dvāra toraṇa dhvaja kumbhān samsthāpya yathāvidhi vastra ādyaḥ saṃyuktān vidhāya tatas guruḥ antar praviśya chāyā adhivāsitān devān vimānam ca udvāsya vimāna sthita vastra ādīni apanīya

original: teṣu yathāvidhi pūrvoktavatrmanā nayanāni unmīlya| tataḥ saptadaśakalaśaiḥ ghṛtādidravyayutaiḥ haridrācūrṇaiśca, vimānasya digdevatānāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak tathaiva mṛdālepanapūrvakaṃ sarvaṃ snapanakalāpaṃ sakūrce darpaṇe kṛtvā| punaḥ āvāhya| vimānādikaṃ navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ ācchādya pratiṣṭhāvidhivat madhyavedikopari śayyāṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: teṣu yathāvidhi nayanāni unmīlya tatas saptadaśa kalaśaiḥ ghṛta ādi dravya yutaiḥ haridrā cūrṇaiḥ ca vimānasya digdevatānām ca pṛthak pṛthak tathā eva mṛd ālepana pūrvakam sarvam snapana kalāpam sa kūrce darpaṇe kṛtvā punar āvāhya vimāna ādikam navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ ācchādya pratiṣṭhā vidhivat madhya vedikā upari śayyām kṛtvā

original: tasyāṃ kūrcadvāreṇa vimānadevatāḥ āvāhya| śāyayitvā, tatra vrīhyādidhānya kalpita sthaṇḍilopari, svarṇādi lohajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā sasūtraveṣṭanaṃ sakarakopakumbhāṣṭakaṃ mahākumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya| gandhodakaiḥ āpūrya tānsaratnaloha vastra kūrcapippala dalāpidhānānkṛtvā puṇyāhaṃvācayitvā| dvāratoraṇa dhvaja kumbheṣu yathākramaṃ tattaddevatāḥ āvāhya|
analyzed: tasyām kūrca dvāreṇa vimāna devatāḥ āvāhya śāyayitvā tatra vrīhi ādi dhānya kalpita sthaṇḍila upari svarṇa ādi loha jam mṛṇmayam vā sa sūtra veṣṭanam sa karaka upakumbha aṣṭakam mahā kumbham saṃsthāpya gandha udakaiḥ āpūrya tān sa ratna loha vastra kūrca pippala dala apidhānān kṛtvā puṇyāham vācayitvā dvāra toraṇa dhvaja kumbheṣu yathākramam tad tad devatāḥ āvāhya

original: abhyarcya| mahākumbhe ādhārādipadmāntaṃ pīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya| tasmin, sahasraśīrṣaṃ puruṣaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasrapam| sahasrakuntalopetaṃ sahasramakuṭānvitam| sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ sahasrendunibhānanam| sahasravāhanaiḥ yuktaṃ sarva diṅnāsikānvitam| śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ sarva praharaṇānvitam| prāsādarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ dhyātvaivāvāhayet guruḥ|| ‘‘iti dhyātvā|
analyzed: abhyarcya mahākumbhe ādhāra ādi padma antam pīṭham saṃkalpya tasmin sahasra śīrṣam puruṣam sahasra akṣam sahasrapam sahasra kuntala upetam sahasra makuṭa anvitam sahasra āditya saṃkāśam sahasra indu nibha ānanam sahasra vāhanaiḥ yuktam sarva diś nāsikā anvitam śaṃkha cakra gadā pāṇim sarva praharaṇa anvitam prāsāda rūpiṇam devam dhyātvā eva āvāhayet guruḥ iti dhyātvā

original: ‘oṃ namobhagavate vimānādhidaivatāya nārāyaṇāya āgacchāgaccha’ ityāvāhya abhyarcya| karake sudarśanaṃ upakumbhāṣṭake viṣṇvādimūrtīṃśca āvāhya abhyarcya| vimānaṃ ca tathā dhyātvā| abhyarcya| caturvidhaṃ annaṃ nivedya| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| āśiṣaḥ vācayitvā| tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇāṃ vitīrya| kuṇḍeṣu agniṃ yathāvidhi upasamidhya|
analyzed: om namaḥ bhagavate vimāna adhidaivatāya nārāyaṇāya āgaccha āgaccha iti āvāhya abhyarcya karake sudarśanam upa kumbha aṣṭake viṣṇu ādi mūrtīn ca āvāhya abhyarcya vimānam ca tathā dhyātvā abhyarcya caturvidham annam nivedya brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā āśiṣaḥ vācayitvā tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇām vitīrya kuṇḍeṣu agnim yathāvidhi upasamidhya

original: purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ mūrtihomādikaṃ kṛtvā| dhāma hemādinirmitaṃ ratnakhacitaṃ dhyātvā| ‘tatra jīvamapi dhyāyet vyāpakaṃ tadupādikam| buddhiṃ ca piṇḍikāṃ pādān ahakāraṃ tathaiva ca| pādau pāda śilā jaṃghe garbhagehaṃ tathodaram| stambhān bāhūn kaṭiṃ cāpi tathaiva kaṭimekhalām| jihvāṃ varṇāṃ tathā netraṃ pratīpadvāśca mehanam|
analyzed: purastāt tantra pūrvakam mūrti homa ādikam kṛtvā dhāma hema ādi nirmitam ratna khacitam dhyātvā tatra jīvam api dhyāyet vyāpakam tad upādikam buddhim ca piṇḍikām pādān ahakāram tathā eva ca pādau pāda śilā jaṃghe garbhageham tathā udaram stambhān bāhūn kaṭim ca api tathā eva kaṭimekhalām jihvām varṇām tathā netram pratīpa dvār ca mehanam

original: apānaṃ jalaniryāṇaṃ nāsikāṃ nāsikāṃ tathā| gavākṣamakṣi grīvāṃ ca grīvaṃ skandhaṃ kapolakau| śiraśca kalaśaṃ māṃsaṃ pralepaṃ sparśanaṃ sudhām| asthīni ca śilāstasthāḥ snāyuṃ dāruśikhādhvajān| keśaromāṇi kūrcaṃ ca dhyātvā dhāma purākṛtiṃ | ‘ iti vimānaṃ puruṣākṛtiṃ dhyātvā|
analyzed: apānam jala niryāṇam nāsikām nāsikām tathā gavākṣam akṣi grīvām ca grīvam skandham kapolakau śiraḥ ca kalaśam māṃsam pralepam sparśanam sudhām asthīni ca śilāḥ tasthāḥ snāyum dāru śikhā dhvajān keśa romāṇi kūrcam ca dhyātvā dhāma purākṛtim iti vimānam puruṣa ākṛtim dhyātvā

original: tadanu jīva tatvahomaṃ praṇavādi svāhāntaṃ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ aṣṭāviṃśati aṣṭau vā ājyena hutvā| saṃpātājyaṃ saṃgṛhya| vimānasya tattadaṅgeṣu tattanmantraireva saṃspṛśet| ‘‘oṃ maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikābhāsāya jīvatatvātmane svāhā’’ dhāmani ‘oṃ bhaṃ namaḥparāyasitavarṇāya prakṛtyātmane svāhā’‘,dhāmani |
analyzed: tadanu jīva tatva homam praṇava ādi svāhā antam pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatam aṣṭāviṃśati aṣṭau vā ājyena hutvā saṃpāta ājyam saṃgṛhya vimānasya tad tad aṅgeṣu tad tad mantraiḥ eva saṃspṛśet om maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭika ābhāsāya jīva tatva ātmane svāhā dhāmani om bhaṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya prakṛti ātmane svāhā dhāmani

original: ‘ oṃ baṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikābhāsāya buddhi tatvātmane svāhā’‘,dhāmani | ‘oṃ phaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭalavarṇāya ahaṃkārātmane svāhā’‘,piṇḍikāyāṃ| ‘oṃ paṃ namaḥ parāya sitavarṇāya manastatvātmane svāhā’‘,piṇḍikāyāṃ | ‘oṃ naṃ namaḥ parāya śuklavarṇāya śabdatanmātrātmane svāhā’‘,kṣudranāsikāyāṃ|
analyzed: om baṃ namaḥ parasmai sphaṭika ābhāsāya buddhi tattva ātmane svāhā dhāmani om phaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭala varṇāya ahaṃkāra ātmane svāhā piṇḍikāyām om paṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya manaḥ tattva ātmane svāhā piṇḍikāyām om naṃ namaḥ parāya śukla varṇāya śabda tanmātra ātmane svāhā kṣudra nāsikāyām

original: ‘oṃ dhaṃ namaḥ parāya lohitavarṇāya sparśatanmātrātmane svāhā’‘,sudhālepe| ‘oṃ daṃ namaḥ parāya jyotirvarṇāya rūpatanmātrātmane svāhā’‘,gavākṣe| ‘oṃ thaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṇḍaravarṇāya rasatanmātrātmane svāhā’‘,varṇe| ‘oṃ taṃ namaḥ parāya sitavarṇāya gandhatanmātrātmane svāhā’‘ mahānāsikāsu|
analyzed: om dhaṃ namaḥ parāya lohita varṇāya sparśa tanmātra ātmane svāhā sudhā lepe om daṃ namaḥ parāya jyotiḥ varṇāya rūpa tanmātra ātmane svāhā gavākṣe om thaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṇḍara varṇāya rasa tanmātra ātmane svāhā varṇe om taṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya gandha tanmātra ātmane svāhā mahā nāsikāsu

original: ‘oṃ ṇaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭalavarṇāya śrotrendriyātmane svāhā’‘ ,pāśrvanāsikāsu| ‘oṃ ḍhaṃ namaḥ parāya hemavarṇāya tvagindriyātmane svāhā’‘,sudhālepe| ‘ oṃ ḍaṃ namaḥ parāya kṛṣṇavarṇāya netrendriyātmane svāhā’‘,gavākṣe| ‘oṃ ṭhaṃ namaḥ parāya gaura varṇāya jihvendriyātmane svāhā’‘,varṇe|
analyzed: om ṇaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭala varṇāya śrotra indriya ātmane svāhā pāśrva nāsikāsu om ḍhaṃ namaḥ parāya hema varṇāya tvac indriya ātmane svāhā sudhā lepe om ḍaṃ namaḥ parāya kṛṣṇa varṇāya netra indriya ātmane svāhā gavākṣe om ṭhaṃ namaḥ parāya gaura varṇāya jihvā indriya ātmane svāhā varṇe

original: ‘oṃ ṭaṃ namaḥ parāya sitavarṇāya ghrāṇendriyātmane svāhā’‘,mahānāsāsu| ‘oṃ ñaṃ namaḥ parāya sitavarṇāya vāgindriyātmane svāhā’‘,varṇe| ‘oṃ jhaṃ namaḥ parāya raktavarṇāya pāṇīndriyātmane svāhā’‘,pādeṣu| ‘oṃ jaṃ namaḥ parāya raktavarṇāya pādendriyātmane svāhā’‘,pādaśilāyāṃ| ‘oṃ chaṃ namaḥ parāya raktavarṇāya apānendriyātmane svāhā’‘,jalaniryāṇe|
analyzed: om ṭaṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya ghrāṇa indriya ātmane svāhā mahānāsāsu om ñaṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya vāc indriya ātmane svāhā varṇe om jhaṃ namaḥ parāya rakta varṇāya pāṇi indriya ātmane svāhā pādeṣu om jaṃ namaḥ parāya rakta varṇāya pāda indriya ātmane svāhā pāda śilāyām om chaṃ namaḥ parāya rakta varṇāya apāna indriya ātmane svāhā jala niryāṇe

analyzed: om caṃ namaḥ parāya hema varṇāya mehana indriya ātmane svāhā mehane om kaṃ namaḥ parāya jalada varṇāya nirākārāya ākāśa tatva ātmane svāhā nāsikā ādi śikhā kumbha antam om khaṃ namaḥ parāya dhūmra varṇāya vedikā ākārāya vāyu tatva ātmane svāhā garbha geha ādi nāsā antam om gaṃ namaḥ parāya lohita varṇāya trikoṇa ākārāya agni tatva ātmane svāhā garbha gehe

original: ‘oṃ ghaṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikavarṇāya ardhacaṃdrākārāya aptatvātmane svāhā’‘,upapīṭhādi jalaniryāṇāntam| ‘oṃ ṅaṃ namaḥ parāya pītavarṇāya caturaśrāya pṛthivītatvātmane svāhā’‘,upapīṭhapādeṣu| evaṃ tatva nyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā| tataḥ śaktihomaṃ nyāsaṃ ca kuryāt|
analyzed: om ghaṃ namaḥ parasmai sphaṭika varṇāya ardhacandra ākārāya ap tatva ātmane svāhā upapīṭha ādi jala niryāṇa antam om ṅaṃ namaḥ parasmai pīta varṇāya caturaśrāya pṛthivī tatva ātmane svāhā upapīṭha pādeṣu evam nyāsam ca kṛtvā tatas śakti homam nyāsam ca kuryāt

original: ‘oṃ prakṛtyai svāhā, apāne,’oṃ śāntyai svāhā, jagatyāṃ,’oṃ pṛthivyai svāhā, kumude,’oṃ vāgīśvaryai svāhā,gale,’oṃ ratyai svāhā, paṭṭikāyām| evaṃ pañcā’yukta vimāne|

analyzed: svāhā vedyām om śriyai svāhā dhāmni iti śakti homam nyāsam ca kuryāt anantaram pūrvavat śānti homam sparśa homam ca tadanu diṅmūrtīnām tatva homam nyāsam ca pṛthak pṛthak kṛtvā sahasram śatam vā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇām da tvā

original: vimānasya pratiṣṭhārthaṃ pañcaviṃśati tantubhiḥ paṭṭikāyāṃ diṅmūrtīnāṃ sauvarṇena ca rakṣābandhanaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā| tadanu palala rajanīcūrna lāja dadhi saktubhiḥ balyantaṃ samyojya|tena, ādyāśca karmajāścaiva ye bhūtāḥ prāgdiśisthitāḥ| prasannāḥ parituṣṭāste gṛhṇantu balikāṃkṣiṇaḥ|| vṛkṣeṣu parvatāgreṣu ye vidikṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ|
analyzed: vimānasya pratiṣṭhā artham pañcaviṃśati tantubhiḥ paṭṭikāyām diṅmūrtīnām sauvarṇena ca rakṣā bandhanam vidhivat kṛtvā tadanu ādyāḥ ca karma jāḥ ca eva ye bhūtāḥ prāc diśi sthitāḥ prasannāḥ parituṣṭāḥ te gṛhṇantu bali kāṃkṣiṇaḥ vṛkṣeṣu parvata agreṣu ye vidikṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ

analyzed: bhūmau vyomni sthitāḥ ye ca balim gṛhṇantu te api ca vināyakāḥ kṣetrapālāḥ ye ca anye bali kāṃkṣiṇaḥ pūṣa ādyāḥ pārṣadāḥ ca eva gṛhṇantu balim adya te iti mantraiḥ sarvatas dikṣu bali dānam kṛtvā tadanu prabhāte su muhūrte sarva alaṃkāra yutaḥ guruḥ mahākumbha mūrtikumbhān samādāya

original: agre galantikāgalat vāridhārayā pariṣiñcan dhāmapradakṣiṇī kṛtya|vimānāgre dhānyakṛtasthaṇḍile tān nidhāya| ācāryaḥ udaṅmukhassan mahākumbhasyaśaktiṃ vimāne mūlamantreṇa mūrtikumbhagataśśaktīḥ mūrtipeṣu ca vinyasya| vimānaṃ sahasraśīrṣaṃ puruṣaṃ dhyātvā| mahākumbhaṃ samādāya|
analyzed: agre vāri dhārayā pariṣiñcan dhāma pradakṣiṇī kṛtya vimāna agre dhānya kṛta sthaṇḍile tān nidhāya ācāryaḥ udak mukhaḥ san mahākumbhasya śaktim vimāne mūlamantreṇa mūrti kumbha gataḥ śaktīḥ mūrtipeṣu ca vinyasya vimānam sahasra śīrṣam puruṣam dhyātvā mahākumbham samādāya

analyzed: pūrvavat vedikām nirmāya ālaya viśodhana ādi dhyāna antam sakalam karma jālam vimāna pratiṣṭhā ukta vidhinā kṛtvā ācāryaḥ maṇḍapam viśvakarmīyam sarva ratna pariṣphṛtam sauvarṇaiḥ bahubhiḥ stambhaiḥ nava ratna virājitaiḥ uttaṃbhitam sarva śakti mayam dhyāyet gaḥ uruḥ svayam iti dhyātvā vidhivat agnim purastāt tantra pūrvakam saṃskṛtya

analyzed: brāhmyai svāhā stambha pāda śilāyām om vaiṣṇavyai svāhā stambhe om kamalāyai svāhā kapote om śāntyai svāhā uttare om padmāyai svāhā tulāyām om aiśānyai svāhā sopāna paṅktiṣu caturṣu maṇḍapa dvāra toraṇeṣu adhas om śāntyai svāhā dakṣiṇa śākhāyām om vāgdevyai svāhā upari om śriyai svāhā uttara śākhāyām om ratyai svāhā iti

analyzed: saṃpātena nyasya śānti homa avasānikam sarvam karma pūrvavat nirvartya tatas prabhāte su muhūrte guruḥ svayam mahākumbham samādāya pūrva uktāḥ śaktīḥ sva sva mantreṇa namaḥ ntaiḥ āgaccha pada saṃyuktaiḥ maṇḍape pūrva ukta sthāneṣu nyasya vyāpaka rūpeṇa vicintya tatrasthāni citrāṇi citra ābhāsāni ca kumbha stha vāriṇā kūrcena sva sva mantreṇa yathāpūrvam prokṣayet

original: tadanu yajamānaśca pūrvavat gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| āsthāna maṇḍapapratiṣṭhā āsthānamaṇḍapādīnāma tu maṇḍapaśodhana paryagnikaraṇa pañcagavya prokṣaṇa vāstuhoma puṇyāhavācana balikumbhasthāpanādikaṃ kṛtvā| ekasmin kuṇḍe āhutīśca hutvā| ācāryaḥ sumuhūrte mahākumbha jalena pūrvavat prokṣayet| sarvamapi karma sadyaḥ vā kuryāt|

original: gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| gopurapratiṣṭhā gopurapratiṣṭhāṃ vimānapratiṣṭhāvat kuryāt| prākārapratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu aṅkurārpaṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ vidhāya| guruḥ varmamantreṇa prākāraṃ prokṣayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| dvāraśākhākavāṭapratiṣṭhe tāvat ādau eva ukte| atrāpi tathaiva kuryāt|

original: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ maṇḍapa āsthāna maṇḍapa gopura prākāra dvāraśākhā kavāṭa pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma .dvāviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
