original: yathā pūrvābhimukhe deve pratyaṅmukhaḥ, paścimābhimukhe deve pūrvābhimukhaḥ, sarvaṃ saṃsthāpya| ācāryaḥ vāstuhomāṅkurāvāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ śāntihomāvasānikaṃ mandirasya iva kṛtvā| tataḥ prabhāte sumuhūrte mūlavidyayā mahākumbhajalena pīṭhaṃ kūrcena samprokṣya|
analyzed: yathā pūrva abhimukhe deve pratyak mukhaḥ paścima abhimukhe deve pūrva abhimukhaḥ sarvam saṃsthāpya ācāryaḥ vāstu homa aṅkura āvāpana ādikam sarvam kriyā kalāpam śānti homa avasānikam mandirasya iva kṛtvā tatas prabhāte su muhūrte mūlavidyayā mahākumbha jalena pīṭham kūrcena samprokṣya

original: tasmin prācyāṃ vighnarājāya namaḥ,dakṣiṇe oṃ īśānāya namaḥ,paścime oṃ pakṣirājāya namaḥ,uttare oṃ durgāyai namaḥ, madhyakarṇikāyāṃ oṃ sarvebhyaḥ viṣṇupārṣadebhyaḥ namaḥ iti prokṣya| aṣṭāsvapi dikṣu kumudādigaṇeśān svaiḥ svaiḥ anucaraiḥ saha, svasvamantreṇa āvāhyasānnidhyaṃ prāthrya| teṣu nityaṃ baliṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: tasmin prācyām vighnarājāya namaḥ dakṣiṇe om īśānāya namaḥ paścime om pakṣirājāya namaḥ uttare om durgāyai namaḥ madhya karṇikāyām om sarvebhyaḥ viṣṇu pārṣadebhyaḥ namaḥ iti prokṣya aṣṭāsu api dikṣu kumuda ādi gaṇa īśān svaiḥ svaiḥ anucaraiḥ saha sva sva mantreṇa āvāhya sānnidhyam teṣu nityam balim dadyāt

original: yajamānaḥ yathāśakti brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaḥ dakṣiṇāṃ vitīrya| ācāryāya śataniṣphāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt| atha mahānasa pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ācāryaḥ tatra vāstuhomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā|dhānyarāśau salakṣaṇaṃ kumbhaṃ ekaṃ vinyasya| tasmin mūlena āvāhya, abhyarcya| agniṃ saṃsādhya| samidājya carupāyasaiḥ pratidravyaṃ mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā|
analyzed: yajamānaḥ yathāśakti brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ dakṣiṇām vitīrya ācāryāya śataniṣphām dakṣiṇām dadyāt atha mahānasa pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ācāryaḥ tatra vāstu homa ādikam sarvam kṛtvā dhānya rāśau sa lakṣaṇam kumbham ekam vinyasya tasmin mūlena āvāhya abhyarcya agnim saṃsādhya samidh ājya caru pāyasaiḥ pratidravyam mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśata āhutīḥ hutvā

original: tatrasthānāṃ devānāṃ caṇḍapracaṇḍa kṣetrapālarudra gaṇeśa jṛṃbhala maṇibhadra śibhikuṇḍala dharma adharma dhātṛvidhātṛ lakṣmyādyānāṃ homapūrvaṃ tatvanyāsādikaṃ karma kṛtvā| cullīṣu ‘‘agnimīle iti mantreṇa agniṃ nidadhīta| tatra pāyasādīnāṃ haviṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ paricārakāḥkuryuḥ|nityahomārthaṃ kuṇḍe agniṃ purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ yathāvidhi sthāpayitvā|
analyzed: tatrasthānām devānām caṇḍa pracaṇḍa kṣetrapāla rudra gaṇeśa jṛṃbhala maṇibhadra śibhi kuṇḍala dharma adharma dhātṛ vidhātṛ lakṣmī ādyānām homa pūrvam tatva nyāsa ādikam karma kṛtvā cullīṣu agnimīle iti mantreṇa agnim nidadhīta tatra pāyasa ādīnām haviṣām śrapaṇam paricārakāḥ kuryuḥ nitya homa artham kuṇḍe agnim purastāt tantra pūrvakam yathāvidhi sthāpayitvā

original: tadanu mahākumbhajalena caṇḍādīnāṃ nyasanaṃ kuryāt| mahānasa dvāre oṃ caṇḍāya namaḥ, oṃ pracaṇḍāya namaḥ, dakṣiṇa pārśve oṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ,oṃ īśvarāya namaḥ,uttare oṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ,oṃ jṛṃbhalāya namaḥ,paścime oṃ maṇibhadrāya namaḥ, oṃ śibikuṇḍalāya namaḥ, anyeṣu dvāreṣu satsu, prāsādadvāravat lakṣmyādīnāṃ kalpanaṃ caret|
analyzed: tadanu mahākumbha jalena caṇḍa ādīnām nyasanam kuryāt mahānasa dvāre om caṇḍāya namaḥ om pracaṇḍāya namaḥ dakṣiṇa pārśve om kṣetrapālāya namaḥ om īśvarāya namaḥ uttare om gaṇapataye namaḥ om jṛṃbhalāya namaḥ paścime om maṇibhadrāya namaḥ om śibikuṇḍalāya namaḥ anyeṣu dvāreṣu satsu prāsāda dvāra vat lakṣmī ādīnām kalpanam caret

original: culyāḥ vāme oṃ dharmāya namaḥ,oṃ adharmāya namaḥ,pṛṣṭhataḥoṃ dhātre namaḥ,agreoṃ vidhātre namaḥ, tatraiva cullyābhimukhaṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ, dīrghaculyāstu ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ,dharmā’dharmau kalpayet|sarvān tān abhyarcya| tatra sthāni sakalāni pātrāṇi kumbhajalena śrīsūktena prokṣayet|gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat|
analyzed: culyāḥ vāme om dharmāya namaḥ om adharmāya namaḥ pṛṣṭhatas om dhātre namaḥ agre om vidhātre namaḥ tatra eva cullyā abhimukham mahālakṣmyai namaḥ dīrgha culyāḥ tu ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ dharma adharmau kalpayet sarvān tān abhyarcya tatra sthāni sakalāni pātrāṇi kumbha jalena śrīsūktena prokṣayet gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat

original: dhānyāgāra pratiṣṭhā dhānyāgāra dhanāgāra sārasvatagṛha majjanaśālā puṣpavāṭikāsadana tāṃbūlakalpana gṛhataila sthānādīnāṃ dhāmnām śilpibhiḥ kalpitānāṃ ācāryaḥ śāstroktena vidhinā vāstuhomādi prokṣaṇāntaṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍapasya iva kuryāt| dakṣiṇāca yathāvasu deyā|
analyzed: dhānyāgāra pratiṣṭhā dhānyāgāra dhanāgāra sārasvatagṛha majjana śālā puṣpa vāṭikā sadana tāṃbūla kalpana gṛha taila sthāna ādīnām dhāmnām śilpibhiḥ kalpitānām ācāryaḥ śāstra uktena vidhinā vāstu homa ādi prokṣaṇa antam sarvam maṇḍapasya iva kuryāt dakṣiṇā ca yathāvasu deyā

original: atha vāpīkūpa taṭākapratiṣṭhā teṣāṃ bhāge paścime caturhastāyāmaṃ ekahastocchritāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā| suvarṇena alpakāyaṃ jalādhidaivataṃ nirmāya| suvarṇādilohajān mṛṇmayān vā kalaśān saratna lohakūrcāpidhānān nava dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya|yathāvidhi āvāhya abhyarcya| taiḥ jalādhidaivataṃ vidhivat snāpayitvā|
analyzed: atha vāpī kūpa taṭāka pratiṣṭhā teṣām bhāge paścime catur hasta āyāmam eka hasta ucchritām vedikām kalpayitvā suvarṇena alpa kāyam jala adhidaivatam nirmāya suvarṇa ādi loha jān mṛṇmayān vā kalaśān sa ratna loha kūrca apidhānān nava dhānya rāśau saṃsthāpya yathāvidhi āvāhya abhyarcya taiḥ jala adhidaivatam vidhivat snāpayitvā

original: tadanu vedikāyāṃ salakṣaṇāyāṃ śāyayitvā| tatra mahākumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya| tasmin jalādhidaivataṃ āvāhya abhyarcya| caturṣu kuṇḍeṣu ekasmin vā agniṃ upasamidhya|tatra taṃ āvāhya| taddaivatyaiḥ mantraiḥ samidājya carubhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ hutvā| bhūsuraiḥ vāruṇasūktāni pāṭhayitvā| tataḥ prabhāte sulagne puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| vāpyādīn prokṣya|
analyzed: tadanu vedikāyām sa lakṣaṇāyām śāyayitvā tatra mahākumbham saṃsthāpya tasmin jala adhidaivatam āvāhya abhyarcya caturṣu kuṇḍeṣu ekasmin vā agnim upasamidhya tatra tam āvāhya tad daivatyaiḥ mantraiḥ samidh ājya carubhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśata āhutīḥ hutvā bhūsuraiḥ vāruṇa sūktāni pāṭhayitvā tatas prabhāte su lagne puṇyāham vācayitvā vāpī ādīn prokṣya

original: ācāryaḥ amṛtavāribhiḥ pūritān vicintya| tataḥ suvarṇādi lohakṛtāni matsyakūrmādīni jalādhidevatāpratimāṃ mahākumbhaṃ ca vāpyādiṣu nikṣipya|tatra gaṅgādisarvasaritaḥ svasvamantraireva āvāhayet| yajamānaḥ gurave yathāvasu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā| tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā| tebhyaḥ api yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: ācāryaḥ amṛta vāribhiḥ pūritān vicintya tatas suvarṇa ādi loha kṛtāni matsya kūrma ādīni jala adhidevatā pratimām mahā kumbham ca vāpī ādiṣu nikṣipya tatra gaṅgā ādi sarva saritaḥ sva sva mantraiḥ eva āvāhayet yajamānaḥ gurave yathāvasu dakṣiṇām da tvā tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ api yathāśakti dakṣiṇām dadyāt

original: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃbalipīṭhanirmāṇa tatpratiṣṭhā mahānasadhānyāgāravāpīkūpa taṭākapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma trayoviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyām kriyākairava candrikāyām bali pīṭha nirmāṇa tad pratiṣṭhā mahānasa dhānyāgāra vāpī kūpa taṭāka pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma trayoviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ

original: caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ

original: prabhāpratiṣṭhā |
analyzed: prabhā pratiṣṭhā

original: atha prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate kālāṃtare cet prabhādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhā, jalādhivāsādyakhilaṃ karma yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā| guruḥ jvālāmālāsahasrāḍyāṃ vidyutsaṃghātasannibhāṃ prabhāṃ dhyātvā| saṃspṛśya| agnausamidājyacarubhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| sarpiṣā śānti homaṃ ca hutvā| saṃpātena prabhāṃ saṃspṛśya|
analyzed: atha prabhā ādīnām pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate kāla aṃtare ced prabhā ādīnām pratiṣṭhā jala adhivāsa ādi akhilam karma yathāpūrvam kṛtvā guruḥ jvālā mālā sahasra āḍyām vidyut saṃghāta sannibhām prabhām dhyātvā saṃspṛśya agnau samidh ājya carubhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pratyekam aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām hutvā sarpiṣā śānti homam ca hutvā saṃpātena prabhām saṃspṛśya

original: prabhāte kumbhavāriṇā mūlenaprokṣya| prabhāṃ sumuhūrte devena saṃyojya| mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat| pīṭhasthāpanam|pīṭhasthāpane tu guruḥ tatra pīṭham samsthāpya| yogāsanamantraiḥ ādhārādi padmāntaiḥ agnau hutvā| saṃpātena pīṭhaṃ saṃspṛśya padma pīṭhaṃ sumuhūrte devena yojayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat|
analyzed: prabhāte kumbha vāriṇā mūlena prokṣya prabhām su muhūrte devena saṃyojya mahā utsavam kuryāt gurave dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat pīṭha sthāpanam pīṭha sthāpane tu guruḥ tatra pīṭham samsthāpya yoga āsana mantraiḥ ādhāra ādi padma antaiḥ agnau hutvā saṃpātena pīṭham saṃspṛśya padma pīṭham su muhūrte devena yojayet dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat

original: atha ghaṇṭā pratiṣṭhā ucyate ghaṇṭāṃ pañcagavyena pañcavāruṇikaiḥ mantraiḥ saṃsnāpya| navavāsasā āveṣṭya| śālitaṇḍulatilaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tadūdhrve navavastraṃ sadarbhaṃ vinyasya| tatra ghaṇṭāṃ tanmantreṇa śāyayitvā| navena vāsasā ācchādya| tatrasalakṣanaṃ kumbhaṃ ekaṃ samsthāpya|
analyzed: atha ghaṇṭā pratiṣṭhā ucyate ghaṇṭām pañcagavyena pañca vāruṇikaiḥ mantraiḥ saṃsnāpya nava vāsasā āveṣṭya śāli taṇḍula tilaiḥ sthaṇḍilam kṛtvā tad ūdhrve nava vastram sa darbham vinyasya tatra ghaṇṭām tad mantreṇa śāyayitvā navena vāsasā ācchādya tatra salakṣanam kumbham ekam samsthāpya

original: tasmin’‘śabdabrahmasvarūpiṇyai oṃ ghaṇṭāyai namaḥ’‘ iti āvāhya abhyarcya| kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā tanmantreṇa samidādibhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ, caruṇā nṛsūktena ṣoḍaśa ca hutvā| tāṃ śabdabrahmamayīṃ dhyātvā| śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā| saṃpātena ghaṇṭāṃ samspṛśya| prabhāte kumbhatoyena prokṣya|
analyzed: tasmin śabdabrahma svarūpiṇyai om ghaṇṭāyai namaḥ iti āvāhya abhyarcya kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vā tad mantreṇa samidh ādibhiḥ pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām caruṇā nṛ sūktena ṣoḍaśa ca hutvā tām śabdabrahma mayīm dhyātvā śānti homam kṛtvā saṃpātena ghaṇṭām samspṛśya prabhāte kumbha toyena prokṣya

original: tataḥ ghaṇṭāṃ devasya sarvakarmasu cālayet|gurave dakṣiṇā pūrvavat| dhūpa dīpapratiṣṭhā dhūpadīpayostu pūrvavat sarvaṃ karma kṛtvā| ‘‘oṃ dhūpapātrādhidaivatāya pāvakāya namaḥ’‘ iti dhūpaṃ, oṃ dīpapātrādhidaivatāya bhāskarāya namaḥ’‘ iti dīpaṃ ca homānantaraṃ mahākumbha jalenaprokṣayet| dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat|
analyzed: tatas ghaṇṭām devasya sarva karmasu cālayet gurave dakṣiṇā pūrvavat dhūpa dīpa pratiṣṭhā dhūpa dīpayoḥ tu pūrvavat sarvam karma kṛtvā om dhūpa pātra adhidaivatāya pāvakāya namaḥ iti dhūpam om dīpa pātra adhidaivatāya bhāskarāya namaḥ iti dīpam ca homa anantaram mahākumbha jalena prokṣayet dakṣiṇā ca pūrvavat

original: bheryādi pratiṣṭhābheryādīnāṃ pañcagavyena śuddhiṃkuryāt| rathādīnāṃ chatrādīnāṃ ca pratiṣṭhā rathādiyānānāṃ tu śuddhiṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā| svasvadevatāmantreṇa mahākuṃbhajalena prokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt| chatrādīnāmapi pūrvavat sarvatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā puṇyāhapūrvakaṃ yathāvidhi sarvaṃ karmakuryāt| yajamānaśca gurave vittānusārataḥ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: bherī ādi pratiṣṭhā bherī ādīnām pañcagavyena śuddhim kuryāt ratha ādīnām chatra ādīnām ca pratiṣṭhā ratha ādi yānānām tu śuddhim pūrvavat kṛtvā sva sva devatā mantreṇa mahākuṃbha jalena prokṣaṇam kuryāt chatra ādīnām api pūrvavat sarvatra brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā puṇyāha pūrvakam yathāvidhi sarvam karma kuryāt yajamānaḥ ca gurave vitta anusārataḥ dakṣiṇām dadyāt

original: akṣamalā pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ atha akṣamālāpratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate suvarṇa rajata tāmra trapu sīsa kāṃsyāyasphaṭika sūryakānta candropala putra jīvendrākṣī vibhītikā niṃba padma sitaaṃbhoja kamalākṣa rudrākṣa śaṅkha jalaja kuśagrantyādiṣu japtuḥ abhimata karmānuguṇān maṇīn aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyākān tadardhān saptaviṃśati saṃkhyākān vā akṣāsthi tulyān
analyzed: akṣamalā pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ atha akṣamālā pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate suvarṇa rajata tāmra trapu sīsa kāṃsya āyasphaṭika sūryakānta candropala putra jīvendrākṣī vibhītikā niṃba padma sita aṃbhoja kamalākṣa rudrākṣa śaṅkha jalaja kuśa granti ādiṣu japtuḥ abhimata karma anuguṇān maṇīn aṣṭottaraśata saṃkhyākān tad ardhān saptaviṃśati saṃkhyākān vā akṣa asthi tulyān

original: dhātrīphalāsthisadṛśān badarāsthi samānān vā saṃpādya tān doṣavarjitān nirīkṣya| pañcavāruṇikaiḥ pañcopaniṣat mantraiśca pañcagavyaiḥ saṃkṣālya| tān hemai rājate vā sūtre triguṇīkṛte keśādi doṣavarjite kārpāsasūtre vā pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhaṃ mukhena mukhaṃ parasparaṃ yathā na saṃbadhyeta| tathā antarāṃtarā suvarṇena vā sūtreṇavā madhyabandhayutān āropya|
analyzed: dhātrī phala asthi sadṛśān badara asthi samānān vā saṃpādya tān doṣa varjitān nirīkṣya pañca vāruṇikaiḥ pañca upaniṣad mantraiḥ ca pañcagavyaiḥ saṃkṣālya tān rājate vā sūtre triguṇīkṛte keśa ādi doṣa varjite kārpāsa sūtre vā pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭham mukhena mukham parasparam yathā na saṃbadhyeta tathā antarā antarā suvarṇena vā sūtreṇa vā madhya bandha yutān āropya

original: tāṃ mālāṃ kaṭakākāraṃ kṛtvā| tanmālaumahattaraṃ anyaṃ maṇiṃ nidhāya| evaṃ akṣamālikāṃ kṛtvā| tāṃ puṇyāhajalena prokṣya| padmadalesaṃsthāpya| kuṃkumādyaiḥvilipya| śālitaṇḍulaiḥ, bhārādipramāṇayutaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā| tatra cakrapadmaṃ vilikhya| kuśaiḥ navavastraiśca ācchādya| hemavastrayutaṃ mahākumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhe nikṣipya|
analyzed: tām mālām kaṭaka ākāram kṛtvā tad mālau mahattaram anyam maṇim nidhāya evam akṣamālikām kṛtvā tām puṇyāha jalena prokṣya padma dale saṃsthāpya kuṃkuma ādyaiḥ vilipya śāli taṇḍulaiḥ bhāra ādi pramāṇa yutaiḥ sthaṇḍilam kṛtvā tatra cakra padmam vilikhya kuśaiḥ nava vastraiḥ ca ācchādya hema vastra yutam mahā kumbham dhānya pīṭhe nikṣipya

original: tasmin ‘oṃ namo akṣamālikādhi daivatāya mantrapuruṣāya namaḥ’‘ iti mantreṇa āvāhya abhyarcya kuṇḍesthaṇḍile vā agniṃ upasamidhya| samiccarughṛtaiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tasyāḥ śoṣaṇādi kṛtvā| tāṃ aṇḍamayīṃ dhyātvā|tanmadhyepuruṣaṃ dhyāyet baddhāñjalimavasthitam| caturbhujaṃ valarkṣābhaṃ varadābhayahastakam|
analyzed: tasmin om namaḥ akṣa mālikā adhi daivatāya mantrapuruṣāya namaḥ iti mantreṇa āvāhya abhyarcya kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vā agnim upasamidhya samidh caru ghṛtaiḥ tad mantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām hutvā tasyāḥ śoṣaṇa ādi kṛtvā tām aṇḍa mayīm dhyātvā tad madhye puruṣam dhyāyet baddhāñjalim avasthitam caturbhujam vala ṛkṣa ābham varada abhaya hastakam

original: akṣamālāṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ śikhāgre kaṭakākṛtim| iti dhyātvā|tadanu śāntihomānantaraṃ saṃpātena tāṃ saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte tasyāṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tatvāni vinyasya| ācāryaḥ svahṛdayakamale mantrarūpiṇīṃ abhinnāṃ tejasā ādityasaṃkāśāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃśaktiṃ dhyātvā| tāṃ brahmarandhrāt akṣamālikāyāṃ tanmantreṇa āvāhya| mahākumbha jalena prokṣya|
analyzed: akṣamālām ca bibhrāṇam śikhā agre kaṭaka ākṛtim iti dhyātvā tadanu śānti homa anantaram saṃpātena tām saṃspṛśya su muhūrte tasyām sṛṣṭi krameṇa tatvāni vinyasya ācāryaḥ sva hṛdaya kamale mantra rūpiṇīm abhinnām tejasā āditya saṃkāśām vaiṣṇavīm śaktim dhyātvā tām brahmarandhrāt akṣamālikāyām tad mantreṇa āvāhya mahākumbha jalena prokṣya

original: sannidhattāṃ bhavān deva mantramūrte janārdana| japākṣamālāvalaye bhaktānugrahakāmyayā|| iti gāthāṃ udīrya, tatra mantravigrahaṃ akṣamālāṃ bibhrāṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ valakrṣābhaṃ devaṃ dhyātvā| abhyarcya| guruḥ yajamānāya dadyāt| pūrvaṃ guruḥ akṣamālāyāṃ yaṃ mantraṃ sthāpitavān tameva gaṇayet| yathāvittaṃ gurave dakṣiṇā deyā|
analyzed: sannidhattām bhavān deva mantra mūrte janārdana japa akṣa mālā valaye bhakta anugraha kāmyayā iti gāthām udīrya tatra mantra vigraham akṣamālām bibhrāṇam caturbhujam valakrṣa ābham devam dhyātvā abhyarcya guruḥ yajamānāya dadyāt pūrvam guruḥ akṣamālāyām yam mantram sthāpitavān tam eva gaṇayet yathāvittam gurave dakṣiṇā deyā

original: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ prabhāpīṭha ghaṇṭādhūpadīpabheryādivādya rathādiyāna chatrādiparibarhākṣamālāpratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyām kriyākairava candrikāyām prabhā pīṭha ghaṇṭā dhūpa dīpa bherī ādi vādya ratha ādi yāna chatra ādi paribarha akṣamālā pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ nāma caturviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ

original: pañcaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ |
analyzed: pañcaviṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ

original: gṛhārcāpratiṣṭhā |
analyzed: gṛha arcā pratiṣṭhā

original: atha gṛhārcā pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyatesuvarṇādilohajāṃ,yadvā candanā’garu devadāru bilva sarala tamāla cūta badarī panasa kṣīriṇī saptalājāti spandana timiśa kadaṃba kuravaka tilaka madhūkāsana jaṃbū punnāga kanada khadira niṃba vibhītika śālmalyādi vṛkṣajāṃ yajamānābhīṣṭa karmānurūpāṃ brāhmaṇasya cet hastamānamitāṃ, kṣatriyasyacet ekaviṃśāṅgulamānāṃ
analyzed: atha gṛha arcā pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate suvarṇa ādi loha jām yat vā candana agaru devadāru bilva sarala tamāla cūta badarī panasa kṣīriṇī saptalā jāti spandana timiśa kadaṃba kuravaka tilaka madhūka āsana jaṃbū punnāga kanada khadira niṃba vibhītika śālmalyādi vṛkṣa jām yajamāna abhīṣṭa karma anurūpām brāhmaṇasya ced hasta māna mitām kṣatriyasya ced ekaviṃśa aṅgula mānām

original: vaiśyasya cet ekonaviṃśāṅgulāṃ, śūdrasya saptaviṃśāṅgulāṃ, lohajāṃ cet brāhmaṇasya dvādaśāṅgulamānena, kṣatriyasya navāṅgulamānena, viśaḥ saptāṅgulamānena, śūdrasya pañcāṅgulena kṛtāṃ pratimāṃ ratnajāṃ maṇijāṃ vā śrībhūmibhyāṃ śriyāvā yutāṃ kevalāṃ vā prabhā pīṭhādiyutāṃ salakṣaṇāṃ saṃhāraśayanamātrarahitāṃ yathāvidhi śilpinā kārayitvā|
analyzed: vaiśyasya ced ekonaviṃśa aṅgulām śūdrasya saptaviṃśa aṅgulām loha jām ced brāhmaṇasya dvādaśa aṅgula mānena kṣatriyasya nava aṅgula mānena viśaḥ sapta aṅgula mānena śūdrasya pañca aṅgulena kṛtām pratimām ratna jām maṇi jām vā śrī bhūmibhyām śriyāvā yutām kevalām vā prabhā pīṭha ādi yutām salakṣaṇām saṃhāra śayana mātra rahitām yathāvidhi śilpinā kārayitvā

original: gṛhasya mārutyāṃ diśi sthāpayet| tatpratiṣṭhārthaṃ sarvān saṃbhārānsaṃbhṛtya| yajamānaḥsvayaṃ ācāryavaraṇaṃ kṛtvā | aṃgaṇe nadītīre vā, yadvā supūjite kṣetre prapāṃ samadhyavedikāṃ sacatuṣphuṇḍāṃ saikakuṇḍeṃ vā nirmāya, ācāryeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayet| ācāryaḥ pūrvaṃ aṅkurān arpayitvā|
analyzed: gṛhasya mārutyām diśi sthāpayet tad pratiṣṭhā artham sarvān saṃbhārān saṃbhṛtya yajamānaḥ svayam ācārya varaṇam kṛtvā aṃgaṇe nadī tīre vā yat vā su pūjite kṣetre prapām sa madhya vedikām sa catuṣphuṇḍām vā nirmāya ācāryeṇa pratiṣṭhām kārayet ācāryaḥ pūrvam aṅkurān arpayitvā

original: tadanu jalādhivāsa nayanonmīlana pādyādi dravyakalaśasnapana śayanādhivāsa kumbhāvāhanādikaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmiva kṛtvā| kuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| purastāttantrapūrvakaṃ tatvahomādi śāntihomāvasānikaṃ hutvā| pūrvavat saṃpātena saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte pratimāsthāpanasthāne ratnanyāsaṃ kṛtvā| tatra yathāvidhi saṃsthāpya|
analyzed: tadanu jala adhivāsa nayana unmīlana pādya ādi dravya kalaśa snapana śayana adhivāsa kumbha āvāhana ādikam yathāpūrvam pratiṣṭhāyām iva kṛtvā kuṇḍe agnim upasamidhya purastāt tantra pūrvakam tatva homa ādi śānti homa avasānikam hutvā pūrvavat saṃpātena saṃspṛśya su muhūrte pratimā sthāpana sthāne ratna nyāsam kṛtvā tatra yathāvidhi saṃsthāpya

original: āvāhanādikaṃ karma kuryāt| jaṅghamasya cet āvāhanādikaṃ abhipreta vedikāyāṃ kṛtvā| tadanu sthāne sthāpayet| dvāre caṇḍa pracaṇḍa kṣetrapāla vighneśa vāstunātha durgā guha viṣvaksena śaṅkha padmanidhīśca āvāhya abhyarcayet|tadanu yajamānaḥ ca ācāryācoditaḥ bhūmau daṇḍavat praṇamya imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| ‘ dāsosmi tava deveśa saputragaṇabāndhavaḥ|
analyzed: āvāhana ādikam karma kuryāt ced āvāhana ādikam abhipreta vedikāyām kṛtvā tadanu sthāne sthāpayet dvāre caṇḍa pracaṇḍa kṣetrapāla vighneśa vāstunātha durgā guha viṣvaksena śaṅkha padmanidhīḥ ca āvāhya abhyarcayet tadanu yajamānaḥ ca ācārya ācoditaḥ bhūmau daṇḍa vat praṇamya imām gāthām udīrayet dāsaḥ asmi tava deveśa sa putra gaṇa bāndhavaḥ

original: sannidhatsva gṛhe yāvat anvavāyo mahācyuta| pūjāṃ mayāṃ yathāśakti vihitāṃ vikalāmapi| gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan bhaktajanānugraha kāmyayā| ‘‘ itthaṃ ācāryasannidhau bhagavantaṃ yācayitvā| gurave mūrtipebhyaśca yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ vitīrya| brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: sannidhatsva gṛhe yāvat anvavāyaḥ mahā acyuta pūjām mayā yathāśakti vihitām vikalām api gṛhṇīṣva bhagavan bhakta jana anugraha kāmyayā ittham ācārya sannidhau bhagavantam yācayitvā gurave mūrtipebhyaḥ ca yathāśakti dakṣiṇām vitīrya brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tebhyaḥ api dakṣiṇām dadyāt

original: śrīvatsapratiṣṭhāḥ atha śrīvatsapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate śrīvatsaṃ agre śālibhāre saśāṭike niveśya| puṇyāhādipūrvakaṃ sarvaṃ karma kṛtvā|tatvāni vinyasya| kumbhe ca āvāhya abhyarcya| padmakuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| śrīvatsamantreṇa samidājya carubhiḥ pratyekaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| tatvahomaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca kṛtvā|saṃpātena spṛṣṭvā|
analyzed: śrīvatsapratiṣṭhāḥ atha śrīvatsapratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate śrīvatsam agre śālibhāre sa śāṭike niveśya puṇyāha ādi pūrvakam sarvam karma kṛtvā tatvāni vinyasya kumbhe ca āvāhya abhyarcya padma kuṇḍe agnim upasamidhya śrīvatsa mantreṇa samidh ājya carubhiḥ pratyekam aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām hutvā tatva homam śānti homam ca kṛtvā a saṃpātena spṛṣṭvā

original: kumbhajalena prokṣya| sumuhūrte viṣṇoḥ vakṣasi niveśayet|gurave dakṣiṇāca pūrvavat| kaustubha pratiṣṭhāḥ kaustubhaṃ tu yathāpūrvam svamantreṇa sthaṇḍile sthāpayitvā| suvarṇa pratimāṃ kaustubhākāreṇa kārayitvā| mahākumbhe vinyasya pūrvavat sarvaṃ karma kuryāt|
analyzed: kumbha jalena prokṣya su muhūrte viṣṇoḥ vakṣasi niveśayet gurave pūrvavat kaustubha pratiṣṭhāḥ kaustubham tu yathāpūrvam sva mantreṇa sthaṇḍile sthāpayitvā suvarṇa pratimām kaustubha ākāreṇa kārayitvā mahākumbhe vinyasya pūrvavat sarvam karma kuryāt

original: vanamālā pratiṣṭhāḥ vanamālāṃ suvarṇamayīṃ nānāratna pariṣphṛtāṃ pūrvoktavidhānena svamantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya sumuhūrte viṣṇoḥkaṇṭhe laṃbayet| atha kirīṭa pratiṣṭhāḥ śuddhakārtasvaramayaṃ ratnacitaṃ vā kirīṭaṃ bhagavadyogyaṃ kṛtvā| pādyādi ghṛtāntaiḥ saptadaśakalaśaiḥkirīṭamantreṇa saṃsnāpya| savastradhānyakṛta sthaṇḍile nidhāya|
analyzed: vanamālā pratiṣṭhāḥ vanamālām suvarṇa mayīm nānā ratna pariṣphṛtām pūrva ukta vidhānena sva mantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya su muhūrte viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhe laṃbayet atha kirīṭa pratiṣṭhāḥ śuddha kārtasvara mayam ratna citam vā kirīṭam bhagavat yogyam kṛtvā pādya ādi ghṛta antaiḥ saptadaśa kalaśaiḥ kirīṭa mantreṇa saṃsnāpya savastra dhānya kṛta sthaṇḍile nidhāya

original: kumbhe tanmantreṇa āvāhyaabhyarcya| kuṇḍacatuṣṭaye vā ekasmin kuṇḍe vā samidājyacarubhiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatāhutīnāṃ hutvā| śāntihomaṃ hutvā| saṃpātena kirīṭaṃ saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte kumbhajalenasvavidyayā prokṣya| tadanu bhadrāsane samāsīnaṃ devaṃ rājavat upacarya saṃsnāpya| alaṃkṛtya ārādhya|
analyzed: kumbhe tad mantreṇa āvāhya abhyarcya kuṇḍa catuṣṭaye vā ekasmin kuṇḍe vā samidh ājya carubhiḥ tad mantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśata āhutīnām hutvā śānti homam hutvā saṃpātena kirīṭam saṃspṛśya su muhūrte kumbha jalena sva vidyayā prokṣya tadanu bhadrāsane samāsīnam devam rāja vat upacarya saṃsnāpya alaṃkṛtya ārādhya

original: vedaghoṣaiḥ vādyaghoṣaiḥ sarvopacāraiḥ saha ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ sākaṃ pañcopaniṣanmantraiḥ devasya mūrdhani kirīṭaṃ āropya| devaṃ yānaṃ āropya| tūryaghoṣa puṣpavṛṣṭyādyupacārapurassaraṃ grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya mandire viniveśya arcayet| gurave dakṣiṇā deyā| bhūṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāḥ hārādi nūpurāntaṃ bhūṣaṇajālaṃ dvādaśākṣareṇa gandha jalena saṃkṣālya|
analyzed: veda ghoṣaiḥ vādya ghoṣaiḥ sarva upacāraiḥ saha ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ sākam pañca upaniṣad mantraiḥ devasya mūrdhani kirīṭam āropya devam yānam āropya tūrya ghoṣa puṣpa vṛṣṭi ādi upacāra purassaram grāmam pradakṣiṇī kṛtya mandire viniveśya arcayet gurave dakṣiṇā deyā bhūṣaṇa ādi pratiṣṭhāḥ hāra ādi nūpura antam bhūṣaṇa jālam dvādaśa akṣareṇa gandha jalena saṃkṣālya

original: dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya| agnau svavidyayā hutvā| tattadbhūṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā| dvādaśākṣaramanuṃ japan tattanmantreṇa taistaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣayet| cakrādyāyudha pratiṣṭhāḥ atha cakrādyāyudhānāṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ ucyate| cakraṃ tu hastamānena yadvā saptadaśāṃgulam| aṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ yadvā viṃśatyaṃgulasaṃmitam| caturdaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi ṣoḍaśāṃgulameva vā|
analyzed: dhānya rāśau saṃsthāpya agnau sva vidyayā hutvā tad tad bhūṣaṇam dhyātvā dvādaśa akṣara manum japan tad tad mantreṇa taiḥ taiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣayet cakra ādi āyudha pratiṣṭhāḥ atha cakra ādi āyudhānām pratiṣṭhā vidhiḥ ucyate cakram tu hasta mānena yat vā saptadaśa aṃgulam aṣṭādaśa aṃgulam yat vā viṃśati aṃgula saṃmitam caturdaśa aṃgulam vā api ṣoḍaśa aṃgulam eva vā

original: dvādaśāṃgulamānaṃ vā svalakṣaṇa pariṣphṛtam| mūlabimbānanasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ samujvalam| yadvā śatāramathavā caturviṃśatyarānvitam| ṣoḍaśāramathāṣṭāram athavā ṣaḍaraṃ varam| sahasrajvālamathavā ṣaḍjvālaṃ nābhimaṇḍitam| trilohanirmitaṃ cakraṃ nālapīṭha samanvitam| kṛtvā karaṇḍamakuṭaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ vā sudarśanam|
analyzed: dvādaśa aṃgula mānam vā sva lakṣaṇa pariṣphṛtam mūla bimba ānana samam sahasrāram samujvalam yat vā śata aram athavā caturviṃśati ara anvitam ṣoḍaśa aram atha aṣṭa aram athavā ṣaṣ aram varam sahasra jvālam athavā ṣaṣ jvālam nābhi maṇḍitam triloha nirmitam cakram nāla pīṭha samanvitam kṛtvā karaṇḍa makuṭam bibhrāṇam vā sudarśanam

original: caturbhujadharaṃ kruddhaṃ bhrukuṭī kuṭilānanam| puruṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ yadvā dakṣiṇenāpi tarjanam| spṛśantaṃ kaṭimanyena ca itarābhyām kṛtāñjalim| mukhyābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ tu susthitaṃ padmaviṣṭare| ‘‘ evaṃ rūpayutaṃ cakraṃ kalpayitvā|
analyzed: catur bhuja dharam kruddham bhrukuṭī kuṭila ānanam puruṣam dvi bhujam yat vā dakṣiṇena api tarjanam spṛśantam kaṭim anyena ca itarābhyām kṛtāñjalim mukhyābhyām karābhyām tu susthitam padma viṣṭare evam rūpa yutam cakram kalpayitvā

original: pūrvavat aṅkurārpaṇajalādhivāsa nayanonmīlana snapana śayanādhivāsadvāratoraṇakumbhapūjānāṃ anantaraṃ mahākumbhe sudarśanaṃ tanmantreṇa āvāhya| abhyarcya| atyugraṃ puruṣaṃ dhyāyet dvibhujaṃ rakta vāsasam| raktadaṃṣṭrānanam nābhau susthitaṃ cakranāyakam| ‘‘ iti dhyātvā|
analyzed: pūrvavat aṅkura arpaṇa jala adhivāsa nayana unmīlana snapana śayana adhivāsa dvāra toraṇa kumbha pūjānām anantaram mahākumbhe sudarśanam tad mantreṇa āvāhya abhyarcya atyugram puruṣam dhyāyet dvi bhujam rakta vāsasam rakta daṃṣṭra ānanam nābhau susthitam cakranāyakam iti dhyātvā

original: catuṣphuṇḍeṣu yadvā ekasmin samidājya carubhiḥ tanmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā| cakraṃ śoṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃśoṣya| śāntihomāvasāne saṃpātena nābhyādyavayavān saṃspṛśya| sumuhūrte svavidyayā prokṣya| sampūjayet| śaṅkhādi pratiṣṭhāḥ śaṅkhādīnāṃ caturṇām yathā pūrvaṃ ācāryaḥ svasvamantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā| yathāvidhi pūjayet|

original: oṃ ślāṃ ślāṃ ślāṃ pārthivāṃśaṃ pādādijānuparyantāt caturaśrāt pārthiva maṇḍalāt āpyāṃśe sāpekṣaṃ līno bhava| apāṃ bījasya sindhudvīpaṛṣiḥ|gāyatrī chandaḥ|varuṇo devatā| oṃ vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ rasanā pāyvindriyayutāḥ ardhacandrākṛtiḥ śvetāḥ śabdasparśarūparasa guṇayutāḥ apaḥ bāhyāt pūrakeṇa jānvādi kaṭiparyantaṃ mama śarīre saṃpūrayāmi|

original: oṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ tryaśraṃ pāṭalavarṇaṃ dṛṣṭicaraṇendriyayutaṃ śabdasparśa rūpaguṇaṃ agniṃ bāhyāt pūrakeṇa guhyādi ānābhi mama śarīresaṃpūrayāmi| tanmadhye oṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ ṇyaṃ hrīṃ sakalarūṃ agnyadhipataye rudrāya ghorāya pradyumnāya vidyākalātmane huṃ phaṭ iti mantraṃ dhyāyan, taijasaṃ sarvaṃ kumbhakena śanaiśśanaiḥ tanmantre saṃharāmi|

original: oṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ dhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tvakkarendriyayutaṃ śabdasparśaguṇaṃ vāyuṃ bāhyāt pūrakeṇa nābhyādi nāsikāntaṃ mama śarīre saṃpūrayāmi| tanmadhye oṃ hraiṃ ṇaṃ sakalaraiṃ vāyvadhipataye īśvarāya tatpuruṣāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śāntikalātmane huṃ phaṭ iti mantraṃ dhyāyan, vāyavyaṃ sarvaṃ kumbhakeṇa śanaiśśanaiḥ tanmantre saṃharāmi|
analyzed: om yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ dhūmram vṛttam tvac kara indriya yutam śabda sparśa guṇam vāyum bāhyāt pūrakeṇa nābhi ādi nāsikā antam mama śarīre saṃpūrayāmi tad madhye om   ṇaṃ sakala raiṃ vāyu adhipataye īśvarāya tatpuruṣāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śānti kalā ātmane hum phaṭ iti mantram dhyāyan vāyavyam sarvam kumbhakeṇa śanais śanais tad mantre saṃharāmi

analyzed: om dhaṃ namaḥ parasmai lohita varṇāya sparśa tanmātra ātmane namaḥ vāyu mantram sparśa tanmātrāyām samharāmi tām sparśa tanmātrāyām gandha rasa rūpa tanmātrābhiḥ saha recakena ākāśe saṃyojayāmi syām syām syām vāyu āṃśa nābhi ādi nāsikā antāt ṣaṣ bindu lāñchitāt vāyu maṇḍalāt nābhasa aṃśe sāpekṣam līnaḥ bhava ākāśa bījasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandhaḥ

original: paramahaṃsaḥ devatā| oṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ nīlotpaladalanibhaṃ vāk śrotrendriyayutaṃ śabdaguṇaṃ ākāśaṃ bāhyāt pūrakeṇa nāsādimūrdhāntaṃ mama śarīre saṃpūrayāmi|tanmadhye oṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sakalarauṃ ākāśādhipataye sadāśivāya īśānāya vāsudevāya śāntyādikalātmane huṃ phaṭ iti mantraṃ dhyāyan nābhasaṃ sarvaṃ kumbhakena śanaiśśanaiḥ tanmantre saṃharāmi|

original: oṃ paṃ namaḥparāya sitāsita varṇāya manastatvātmane namaḥ, svāntaṃ ahaṃkṛtau samharāmi| oṃ phaṃ namaḥparāya pāṭala varṇāya ahaṃkārātmane namaḥ,ahaṃkāraṃ buddhau samharāmi| oṃ baṃ namaḥparāya sphaṭikābhāsāya buddhi tatvātmanenamaḥ, buddhiṃ prakṛtau samharāmi| oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ parāyasita varṇāya prakṛtyātmane namaḥ,prakṛtiṃ jīve samharāmi|
analyzed: om paṃ namaḥ parāya sita asita varṇāya manas tattva ātmane namaḥ svāntam ahaṃkṛtau samharāmi om phaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭala varṇāya ahaṃkāra ātmane namaḥ ahaṃkāram buddhau samharāmi om baṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭika ābhāsāya buddhi tattva ātmane namaḥ buddhim prakṛtau samharāmi om bhaṃ namaḥ parasmai asita varṇāya prakṛti ātmane namaḥ prakṛtim jīve samharāmi

original: oṃ maṃ namaḥparāya sphaṭikābhāsāya jīvatatvātmane namaḥ| susūkṣmaṃ bhāskarābhaṃ vāsanāvivaśaṃ jīvaṃ nābhicakrasthitaṃ padmasūtra susūkṣmayā suṣumnayānāḍyā kumbhakena vāyunā antardehe upari āropya, brahmarandhraṃ bhitvā dehāt bahiḥ nirgatya sūryamaṇḍalaṃ praviśya upari sahasradalayute śvetapadme saṃsthitaṃ parabrahmaṇi saṃyojayāmi|
analyzed: om maṃ namaḥ parasmai sphaṭika ābhāsāya jīva tattva ātmane namaḥ su sūkṣmam bhāskara ābham vāsanā vivaśam jīvam nābhi cakra sthitam su sūkṣmayā suṣumnayā nāḍyā kumbhakena vāyunā antar dehe upari āropya brahmarandhram bhitvā dehāt bahis nirgatya sūrya maṇḍalam praviśya upari sahasra dala yute śveta padme saṃsthitam para brahmaṇi saṃyojayāmi

original: oṃ maṃ haṃsaḥ he jīva nābhicakrāt suṣumnā vartmanā paramātmani sāpekṣaṃ līno bhava| pādādimūrdhāntaṃ| oṃ hrīṃ yonimudrāyai namaḥ| iti mudrāṃ pradarśya| oṃ lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane śrīmatenārāyaṇāya namaḥ| oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛtyātmane aniruddhāya namaḥ| oṃ rāṃ namaḥparāya viśvātmane pradyuṃnāya namaḥ|
analyzed: om maṃ haṃsaḥ he jīva nābhi cakrāt suṣumnā vartmanā paramātmani sāpekṣam līnaḥ bhava pāda ādi mūrdha antam om hrīṃ yonimudrāyai namaḥ iti mudrām pradarśya om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane śrīmatenārāyaṇāya namaḥ om vām namaḥ parāya nivṛti ātmane aniruddhāya namaḥ om rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane pradyuṃnāya namaḥ

original: oṃ yāṃ namaḥparāya puruṣātmane saṃkarṣaṇāya namaḥ| oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥparāya parameṣṭyātmane vāsudevāya namaḥ| brahmahatyāśiraskandhaṃ svarṇasteyaṃ bhujadvayam| surāpānahṛdāyuktaṃ gurutalpa kaṭidvayam| tatsaṃyogi padadvandvaṃ raktaśmaśru vilocanam| upapātakaromāṇamaṃgapratyaṃga saṃyutam | khaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kukṣau pāpaṃ vicintayet|
analyzed: om yāṃ namaḥ parasmai puruṣa ātmane saṃkarṣaṇāya namaḥ om ṣauṃ namaḥ parasmai parameṣṭi ātmane vāsudevāya namaḥ brahmahatyā śira skandham svarṇa steyam bhuja dvayam surā pāna hṛd āyuktam gurutalpa kaṭi dvayam tad saṃyogi pada dvandvam rakta śmaśru vilocanam upapātaka romāṇam aṅga pratyaṅga saṃyutam khaḍga carma dharam kṛṣṇam kukṣau pāpam vicintayet

original: itirītyā dhyātvā| pādāgre raktavarṇāya trikoṇāyāgnaye namaḥ| tajjvālayā dehamāpādatalamastakaṃ dahāmi| oṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ utthitamagniṃ staṃbhayāmi| ākāśe oṃ vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ amṛtabījaṃ dhyāyāmi| tadutthāmṛtadhārayā tadbhasmaṃ plāvayāmi| oṃ pṛthvī bījasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ| atalaṃ chandaḥ| śrī kūrmo devatā| plāvitabhasma piṇḍīkaraṇārtheviniyogaḥ|
analyzed: iti rītyā dhyātvā pāda agre rakta varṇāya trikoṇāya agnaye namaḥ tad jvālayā deham āpādatalamastakam dahāmi om laṃ laṃ laṃ utthitam agnim staṃbhayāmi ākāśe om vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ amṛta bījam dhyāyāmi tad uttha amṛta dhārayā tad bhasmam plāvayāmi om pṛthvī bījasya meru pṛṣṭhe ṛṣiḥ atalam chandaḥ śrī kūrmaḥ devatā plāvita bhasma piṇḍīkaraṇa arthe viniyogaḥ

original: ‘‘oṃ bhūmirbhūmnā” ityārabhya ‘‘pitaraṃca prayantstuvaḥ”| ityantaṃ japtvā| oṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ śyāmavarṇāya pṛthivyātmane namaḥ| plāvita bhasmakūṭaṃ piṇḍīkaromi| ‘‘ākāśa śarīraṃ brahmā" ityārabhya ‘‘yogyopāsva” oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śaktibījena sarvavarṇena sarvātmanā śarīraṃ sakaracaraṇādyavayavaṃ karomi| oṃ sṛṣṭimudrāyai namaḥ|
analyzed: om bhūmiḥ bhūmnā iti ārabhya pitaram ca prayan stuvaḥ ityantam japtvā om laṃ laṃ laṃ śyāma varṇāya pṛthivī ātmane namaḥ plāvita bhasmakūṭam piṇḍīkaromi ākāśa śarīram brahmā iti ārabhya yogya upāsva om śrīṃ   śakti bījena sarva varṇena sarva ātmanā śarīram sa kara caraṇa ādi avayavam karomi om sṛṣṭimudrāyai namaḥ

original: ākāśe ‘oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛtyātmane namaḥityamṛta bījaṃ dhyāyāmi|tasmāt oṃ pīyūṣanidhaye namaḥ| iti dhyāyan tasmin oṃ śvetāyāvyakta paṃkajāya namaḥ| iti padmaṃ dhyātvā| tasmin parabrahmaṇaḥ sakāśāt jīvamutpannaṃ smarāmi| oṃ maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikābhāsāya jīvatatvātmane namaḥ|
analyzed: ākāśe om vām namaḥ parāya nivṛti ātmane namaḥ iti amṛta bījam dhyāyāmi tasmāt om pīyūṣa nidhaye namaḥ iti dhyāyan tasmin om śvetāya avyakta paṃkajāya namaḥ iti padmam dhyātvā tasmin para brahmaṇaḥ sakāśāt jīvam utpannam smarāmi om maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭika ābhāsāya jīva tatva ātmane namaḥ

original: āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaralavaśaṣa saha oṃ maṃ haṃ saḥ he jīva parabrahmaṇassaṃkāśāt etasmin śvetapaṃkaje sāpekṣamāgaccha| oṃ maṃ jīva mudrāyai namaḥ|tarjanyaṃguṣṭa parvaniveśo jīvamudrā| tāṃ pradarśya| oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ parāya sitavarṇāya prakṛtyātmane namaḥ| jīvāt oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ namaḥ triguṇātmikāṃ prakṛtiṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ saha om maṃ haṃ saḥ he jīva para brahmaṇaḥ saṃkāśāt etasmin śveta paṃkaje sāpekṣam āgaccha om maṃ jīva mudrāyai namaḥ tarjanī aṃguṣṭa parva niveśaḥ jīva mudrā tām pradarśya om bhaṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya prakṛti ātmane namaḥ jīvāt om śrīṃ hrīṃ namaḥ triguṇa ātmikām prakṛtim sṛjāmi

original: oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikābhāsāya buddhitatvātmane namaḥ| prakṛteḥ vāṇyātmikāṃ buddhiṃsṛjāmi| oṃ phaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṭalavarṇāya ahaṃkārātmane namaḥ buddheḥahaṃkṛtiṃ sṛjāmi| oṃ paṃ namaḥ parāya sitāsita varṇāya manastatvātmane namaḥ ahaṃkārāt manastatvaṃ sṛjāmi| oṃ naṃ namaḥ parāya śuklavarṇāya śabdatanmātrātmane namaḥ|
analyzed: om bhaṃ namaḥ parasmai sphaṭika ābhāsāya buddhi tatva ātmane namaḥ prakṛteḥ vāṇī ātmikām buddhim sṛjāmi om phaṃ namaḥ parasmai pāṭala varṇāya ahaṃkāra ātmane namaḥ buddheḥ ahaṃkṛtim sṛjāmi om paṃ namaḥ parasmai sita asita varṇāya manas tatva ātmane namaḥ ahaṃkārāt manas tatvam sṛjāmi om naṃ namaḥ parasmai śukla varṇāya śabda tanmātra ātmane namaḥ

original: manasaḥ śabdatanmātrāṃ sṛjāmi| śabdatanmātrāyāḥ oṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sakalarauṃ ākāśādhipataye sadāśivāya īśānāya vāsudevāya śāṃtyādikalātmane huṃphaṭ bhinnāñjanavarṇaṃ vākśrotrendriyayutaṃ śabdaguṇaṃ oṃ kaṃ namaḥ parāya ākāśatatvaṃ sṛjāmi| oṃ dhaṃ namaḥ parāya lohitavarṇāya sparśatanmātrātmane namaḥ sparśatanmātrāṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: manasaḥ śabda tanmātrām sṛjāmi śabda tanmātrāyāḥ om hrauṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sakala rauṃ ākāśa adhipataye sadāśivāya īśānāya vāsudevāya śāṃti ādi kalā ātmane huṃ phaṭ bhinnāñjana varṇam vāc śrotra indriya yutam śabda guṇam om kaṃ namaḥ parāya ākāśa tatvam sṛjāmi om dhaṃ namaḥ parāya lohita varṇāya sparśa tanmātra ātmane namaḥ sparśa tanmātrām sṛjāmi

original: sparśatanmātrāyāḥ oṃ hraiṃ ṇaṃ sakalaraiṃ vāyvādhipataye īśvarāya tatpuruṣāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śāṃtikalātmane huṃ phaṭ dhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tvakkarendriyayutaṃ śabdasparśaguṇaṃ oṃ khaṃ namaḥ parāya vāyutatvaṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: sparśa tanmātrāyāḥ om   ṇaṃ sakala raiṃ vāyu adhipataye īśvarāya tatpuruṣāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śāṃti kalā ātmane hum phaṭ dhūmram vṛttam tvak kara indriya yutam śabda sparśa guṇam om khaṃ namaḥ parāya vā ayuta tvam sṛjāmi

original: vāyoḥ oṃ daṃ namaḥ parāya jyotirvarṇāya rūpatanmātrātmane namaḥ rūpatanmātrāṃ sṛjāmi|rūpatanmātrāyāḥ oṃ hrūṃ ṇyaṃ hrīṃ sakalarūṃ agnyādhipataye rudrāya ghorāya pradyuṃnāya vidyākalātmane huṃ phaṭ śabdasparśa rūpaguṇasahitaṃ dṛṣṭicaraṇendriyayutaṃ pāṭalavarṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ oṃ gaṃ namaḥ parāya agnitatvaṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: vāyoḥ om daṃ namaḥ parāya jyotiḥ varṇāya rūpa tanmātra ātmane namaḥ rūpa tanmātrām sṛjāmi rūpa tanmātrāyāḥ om   ṇyaṃ   sakala rūṃ agni adhipataye rudrāya ghorāya pradyuṃnāya vidyākalā ātmane hum phaṭ śabda sparśa rūpa guṇa sahitam dṛṣṭi caraṇa indriya yutam pāṭala varṇam trikoṇam om gaṃ namaḥ parāya agni tatvam sṛjāmi

original: agneḥ oṃ thaṃ namaḥparāya pāṇḍaravarṇāya rasatanmātrātmane namaḥ rasatanmātrāṃ sṛjāmi| rasatanmātrāyāḥ oṃ hrīṃ ṣaṃ hrīṃ sakalarīṃ aṃbodhipataye brahmaṇe vāmadevāya dhanurdharāya pratiṣṭhākalātmane huṃphaṭ rasanāpāyvindriyasahitaṃ śabdasparśa rūpa rasa guṇayutaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ardhacandrākṛtiṃ oṃ ghaṃ namaḥparāya aptatvaṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: agneḥ om thaṃ namaḥ parāya pāṇḍara varṇāya rasa tanmātra ātmane namaḥ rasa tanmātrām sṛjāmi rasa tanmātrāyāḥ om hrīṃ ṣaṃ hrīṃ sa kalarīṃ aṃbodhipataye brahmaṇe vāmadevāya dhanurdharāya pratiṣṭhā kalā ātmane huṃ phaṭ rasanā pāyu indriya sahitam śabda sparśa rūpa rasa guṇa yutam śveta varṇam ardhacandra ākṛtim om ghaṃ namaḥ parāya apta tvam sṛjāmi

original: aptatvāt oṃ taṃ namaḥparāya sitavarṇāya gandhatanmātrātmane namaḥ| gandhatanmātrāṃ sṛjāmi gandhatanmātrāyāḥoṃ hrāṃ jhaṃ laṃ hrīṃ sakalarāṃ pṛthivyadhipataye viṣṇave sadyojātāya nārāyaṇāya nivṛttikalātmane huṃ phaṭ pītābhaṃ caturaśraṃ ghrāṇopasthendriyayutaṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇaṃ oṃ ṅaṃ namaḥ parāya pṛthivītatvaṃ sṛjāmi|
analyzed: om taṃ namaḥ parāya sita varṇāya gandha tanmātra ātmane namaḥ gandha tanmātrām sṛjāmi gandha tanmātrāyāḥ om hrāṃ jhaṃ laṃ hrīṃ sakala rām pṛthivī adhipataye viṣṇave sadyojātāya nārāyaṇāya nivṛtti kalā ātmane hum phaṭ pīta ābham caturaśram ghrāṇa upastha indriya yutam śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha guṇam om ṅaṃ namaḥ parāya sṛjāmi

original: evaṃ pāñcabhautikaṃ saptadhātumayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulāyataṃ divyaṃ śarīraṃ kalpayāmi| oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥparāya parameṣṭyātmane vāsudevāya namaḥ| oṃ yāṃ namaḥparāya puruṣātmane saṃkarṣaṇāya namaḥ|oṃ rāṃ namaḥparāya viśvātmane pradyuṃnāya namaḥ | oṃ vāṃ namaḥparāya nivṛtyātmane aniruddhāya namaḥ| oṃ lāṃ namaḥparāya sarvātmane śrīmatenārāyaṇāya namaḥ|
analyzed: evam pāñcabhautikam sapta dhātu mayam ṣaṇṇavati aṅgula āyatam divyam śarīram kalpayāmi om ṣauṃ namaḥ parāya parameṣṭi ātmane vāsudevāya namaḥ om yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣa ātmane saṃkarṣaṇāya namaḥ om rām namaḥ parāya viśvātmane pradyuṃnāya namaḥ om vām namaḥ parāya nivṛti ātmane aniruddhāya namaḥ om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarva ātmane śrīmate nārāyaṇāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭikābhāsāya jīvatatvātmane namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaralavaśaṣa saha oṃ maṃ haṃ saha he jīva śvetapaṅkajāt mama hṛtkamale sāpekṣamāgaccha| upari oṃ prabuddhāya paṃkajāya namaḥ | tadutpannāmṛtapūritairhemakumbhai divyanārīkaradhṛtairātmānaṃ abhiṣiṃcāmi| harerārādhanayogyaṃ śuddhaṃ anaghaṃ mamaśarīraṃ arcayāmi|
analyzed: om maṃ namaḥ parāya sphaṭika ābhāsāya jīva tatva ātmane namaḥ om hrīṃ kroṃ saha om maṃ haṃ saha he jīva śveta paṅkajāt mama hṛd kamale sāpekṣam āgaccha upari om prabuddhāya paṃkajāya namaḥ tad utpanna amṛta pūritaiḥ hema kumbhaiḥ divya nārī kara dhṛtaiḥ ātmānam abhiṣiṃcāmi hareḥ ārādhana yogyam śuddham anagham mama śarīram arcayāmi

original: oṃ asmat gurubhyo namaḥ| mātṛkā nyāsa maṃtrasya| brahmā ṛṣiḥ| devīgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ|mātṛkā sarasvatī devatā | halo bījāni| svarāḥ śaktayaḥ| sakalamaṃtropabrahmaṇārthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ rñaṃ iṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā| oṃ uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ |
analyzed: om asmat gurubhyaḥ namaḥ mātṛkā nyāsa maṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ devī gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ mātṛkā sarasvatī devatā om aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ ām aṅguṣṭhābhyām namaḥ om iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ rñaṃ iṃ tarjanībhyām svāhā om um ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūm madhyamābhyām vaṣaṭ

original: oṃ eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ| oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ au ṃ kaniṣṭikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | oṃ aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aḥ nakhamukhebhyaḥ phaṭ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaśca| pañcāśadvarṇabhedairvihita vadanadoḥpādahṛt kukṣivakṣo| dehāṃbhāsvat kapardā kalitaśaśikalāṃ iṃdukundāvadātām|
analyzed: om eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aim anāmikābhyām hum om paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ au kaniṣṭikābhyām vauṣaṭ om aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śam ṣaṃ sam haṃ laṃ   aḥ nakha mukhebhyaḥ phaṭ evam ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ ca pañcāśat varṇa bhedaiḥ vihita vadana dos pāda hṛt kukṣi vakṣaḥ deha aṃbhāsvat kapardā kalita śaśi kalām indu kunda avadātām

original: akṣasṛkkuṃbhacihnāṃ likhitavarakarāṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ padmasaṃsthāṃ| icchākalpāṃ atucchastanajaghanabharāṃ bhāratīṃ tāṃ namāmi| atha keśavādi mātṛkānyāsaḥ| oṃ aṃ keśavakīrtibhyāṃ namaḥ lalāṭe| oṃ āṃ nārāyaṇa kāṃtibhyāṃ namaḥ mukhe | oṃ iṃ mādhavatuṣṭibhyāṃ narmaḥ | oṃ iṃ goviṃda puṣṭibhyāṃ namaḥnetrayoḥ| oṃ uṃ viṣṇudhṛtibhyāṃ namaḥ|
analyzed: akṣa sṛj kuṃbha cihnām likhita vara karām trīkṣaṇām padma saṃsthām icchā kalpām a tuccha stana jaghana bharām bhāratīm tām namāmi atha keśava ādi mātṛkā nyāsaḥ om aṃ keśava kīrtibhyām namaḥ lalāṭe om āṃ nārāyaṇa kāṃtibhyām namaḥ mukhe om iṃ mādhava tuṣṭibhyām narmaḥ om iṃ goviṃda puṣṭibhyām namaḥ netrayoḥ om um viṣṇu dhṛtibhyām namaḥ

original: oṃ ūṃ madhusūdanaśāntibhyāṃ namaḥ śrotrayoḥ | oṃ ṛṃ trivikramakriyābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ ṝṃ vāmanadayābhyāṃ namaḥ nāsāpuṭayoḥ oṃ lṛṃ śrīdharamedhābhyāṃ namaḥ| oṃ lṝṃ hṛṣīkeśa harṣābhyāṃ namaḥ gaṇḍayoḥ| oṃ eṃ padmanābha śraddhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ dāmodaralajjābhyāṃ namaḥ | dantapaṅktayoḥ | oṃ oṃ vāsudeva lakṣmībhyāṃ namaḥ|
analyzed: om ūm madhusūdana śāntibhyām namaḥ śrotrayoḥ om ṛṃ trivikrama kriyābhyām namaḥ om ṝṃ vāmana dayābhyām namaḥ nāsā puṭayoḥ om lṛṃ śrīdhara medhābhyām namaḥ om lṝṃ hṛṣīkeśa harṣābhyām namaḥ gaṇḍayoḥ om em padmanābha śraddhābhyām namaḥ om aim dāmodara lajjābhyām namaḥ danta paṅktayoḥ om om vāsudeva lakṣmībhyām namaḥ

original: oṃ au ṃ saṃkarṣaṇa sarasvatībhyāṃ namaḥ oṣṭayoḥ| oṃ aṃ pradyumna prītibhyāṃ namaḥ rasanāgre | oṃ aḥ aniruddha ratibhyāṃ namaḥ mukhamaṇḍale|oṃ kaṃ śaṃkhi chāyābhyāṃ namaḥ| oṃ khaṃ cakri jāyābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gaṃ gadi durgābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ ghaṃ khaḍgi satyābhyāṃ namaḥ|oṃ ṅaṃ śārṅgi prabhābhyāṃ namaḥ | dakṣiṇabāhvau pañcavibhāgaśaḥ|

original: nābhimeḍhrāntare oṃ hrīṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ pṛthivyaptejovayvākāśa pañcabhūtamayāya svasatvavibhavāntasthāya ādhārāya namaḥ | śāntaṃ ujjhitaceṣṭaṃ sitaṃ antarmukhasmitaṃ ādhāyolliṅgitākāraṃ ādhāraṃsmarāmi | upari jñauṃ ṣrūṃ jvālaugha vibhavāṃtasthāya naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ śabdasparśarūparasa gandhaguṇayutāya kālāgnirūpāya kūrmāya namaḥ |
analyzed: nābhi meḍhra antare om   ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vayu ākāśa pañcabhūta mayāya sva satva vibhava antasthāya ādhārāya namaḥ śāntam ujjhita ceṣṭam sitam antar mukha smitam ādhāya ulliṅgita ākāram ādhāram smarāmi upari jñauṃ ṣrūṃ jvālā ogha vibhava antasthāya naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandha guṇa yutāya kālāgni rūpāya kūrmāya namaḥ

original: kūrmamudrānvitaṃ kūrmavaktraṃ niṣṭaptakāñcananibhaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ svastikena sthitaṃ kūrmaṃ dhyāyāmi| upari oṃ aṃ svabhogavibhavāntasthāya ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthayutāya anantāya namaḥ |
analyzed: kūrma mudrā anvitam kūrma vaktram niṣṭapta kāñcana nibham śaṅkha cakra dharam svastikena sthitam kūrmam dhyāyāmi upari om aṃ sva bhoga vibhava anta sthāya ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ vāc pāṇi pāda pāyu upastha yutāya anantāya namaḥ

original: anantasaśisaṃkāśaṃ sahasraphaṇālaṅkṛtaṃ sahasrabhujaṃ svapāṇisaṃpuṭena bhuvaṃ dadhānaṃ sitāravinda śaṃkhākṣasūtrā’bhayakaraṃ anantaṃ dhyāyāmi | upari oṃ bhūṃ kāñcana vibhavāntasthāyai ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ śrotra tvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇayutāyai bhūmyai namaḥ |
analyzed: ananta sa śi saṃkāśam sahasra phaṇa alaṅkṛtam sahasra bhujam sva pāṇi saṃpuṭena bhuvam dadhānam sita aravinda śaṃkha akṣa sūtra abhaya karam anantam dhyāyāmi upari om bhūm kāñcana vibhava anta sthāyai ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇa yutāyai bhūmyai namaḥ

original: niśśeṣaratnahemāṅgāṃ prāvṛṭcchriyamivojjvalāṃ padmāsanopaviṣṭāṃ padmāñjalidharāṃ bhuvaṃ dhyāyāmi|nābhau oṃ vaṃ amṛtasāra vibhavāntasthāya paṃ manastatvayutāya kṣīrārṇavāya namaḥ| phullakundāvadātaṃ sitasnigdhajaṭādharaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dhmāyamānaṃ muktādāmavirājitaṃ vistīrṇa sarvāvayavaṃ vikṣiptorudvayaṃ sthitaṃ vikṣiptajānupādaṃ kṣīrārṇavaṃ dhyāyāmi |
analyzed: niśśeṣa ratna hema aṅgām prāvṛṣ śriyam iva ujjvalām padmāsana upaviṣṭām padma añjali dharām bhuvam dhyāyāmi nābhau om vaṃ amṛta sāra vibhava anta sthāya paṃ manaḥ tatva yutāya kṣīrārṇavāya namaḥ phulla kunda avadātam sita snigdha jaṭā dharam śaṃkham dhmāyamānam muktā dāma virājitam vistīrṇa sarva avayavam vikṣipta ūru dvayam sthitam vikṣipta jānu pādam kṣīrārṇavam dhyāyāmi

original: upari oṃ phaṃ ahaṃkāratatvayutāya svabījakośa kisalayadala vibhavāntasthāya anantadalapadmāya namaḥ | supakvāmraphalaśyāmapāṇipadatalojjvalaṃ raktākṣaṃ viprakīrṇakeśaṃ smitānanaṃ padmāsanasthitaṃ alimālāvṛtaṃ sudīrghacaraṇaṃ padmamudrānvitaṃ padmaṃ dhyāyāmi| tasmin āgneye oṃ vaṃ buddhitatvayutāya vivekavibhavāntasthāya dharmāya namaḥ|
analyzed: upari om phaṃ ahaṃkāra tatva yutāya sva bīja kośa kisalaya dala vibhava anta sthāya ananta dala padmāya namaḥ su pakva āmra phala śyāma pāṇi pada tala ujjvalam rakta akṣam viprakīrṇa keśam smita ānanam padmāsana sthitam ali mālā vṛtam su dīrgha caraṇam padma mudrā anvitam padmam dhyāyāmi tasmin āgneye om vaṃ buddhi tatva yutāya viveka vibhava anta sthāya dharmāya namaḥ

original: tuhinavarṇam mṛgendravadanaṃ dharmarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi | naiṝte oṃ vaṃ buddhitatvayutāya vivekavibhavāntasthāya jñānamūrtayenamaḥ|acchopalavarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ jñānarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi|vāyavye oṃ baṃ buddhitattvayutāya vivekavibhavāntasthāya vairāgyāya namaḥ | muktāphalaruciṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ vairāgyarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi |
analyzed: tuhina varṇam mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi naiṝte om vaṃ buddhi tattva yutāya viveka vibhava antasthāya jñāna mūrtaye namaḥ accha upala varṇam mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi vāyavye om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya viveka vibhava antasthāya vairāgyāya namaḥ muktāphala rucim mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi

original: aiśāne oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya avidyāvibhavāntasthāya aiśvaryāya namaḥ | śaśivarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ aiśvaryarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi | pūrveoṃ baṃ buddhitattvayutāya avidyāvibhavāntasthāya adharmāyanamaḥ | padmarāgavarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ adharmarmūīṃtadhyāyāmi |
analyzed: aiśāne om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya avidyā vibhava anta sthāya aiśvaryāya namaḥ śaśi varṇam mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi pūrve om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya avidyā vibhava anta sthāya adharmāya namaḥ padmarāga varṇam mṛgendra vadanam

original: dakṣiṇeoṃ baṃ buddhitattvayutāya avidyāvibhavāntasthāya ajñānāya namaḥ|pravālavarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ ajñānarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi|paścime oṃ baṃ buddhitattva yutāya avidyā vibhavāntasthāya avairāgyāya namaḥ|agnivarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ ajñānarmūīṃtadhyāyāmi|uttare oṃ baṃ buddhitattvayutāya avidyāvibhavāntasthāya anaiśvaryāya namaḥ|
analyzed: dakṣiṇe om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya avidyā vibhava antasthāya ajñānāya namaḥ pravāla varṇam mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi paścime om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya avidyā vibhava antasthāya avairāgyāya namaḥ agni varṇam mṛgendra vadanam anaiśvaryāya namaḥ

original: dāḍimaphalavarṇaṃ mṛgendravadanaṃ ajñānarmūīṃta dhyāyāmi| prāgīśānadiṅmadhye oṃ baṃ buddhitattvayutāya vākprapañcavibhavāntasthāya ṛgvedāya namaḥ|hemavarṇaṃ vājivaktraṃ ṛgvedaṃ dhyāyāmi|prāgāgneyadigaṃtare oṃ yaṃ buddhitatvāyutāya vākprapañca vibhavāntasthāya yajurvedāya namaḥ | caṃpakavarṇaṃ vājivaktraṃ yajurvedaṃ dhyāyāmi|
analyzed: dāḍima phala varṇam mṛgendra vadanam dhyāyāmi prāk īśāna diś madhye om baṃ buddhi tattva yutāya vāc prapañca vibhava antasthāya ṛgvedāya namaḥ hema varṇam vāji vaktram ṛgvedam dhyāyāmi prāk āgneya diś antare om yaṃ buddhi tattva ayutāya vāc prapañca vibhava antasthāya yajurvedāya namaḥ caṃpaka varṇam vāji vaktram yajurvedam dhyāyāmi

original: niṛtivaruṇa madhye oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya vākprapañja vibhavāntasthāya sāmavedāya namaḥ | khadyotavarṇaṃ vājivaktraṃ sāmavedaṃ dhyāyāmi| vāyavya varuṇāntare oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya vākprapañja vibhavāntasthāya atharvaṇavedāya namaḥ |
analyzed: niṛti varuṇa madhye om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya vāc prapañja vibhava anta sthāya sāmavedāya namaḥ khadyota varṇam vāji vaktram sāmavedam dhyāyāmi vāyavya varuṇa antare om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya vāc prapañja vibhava anta sthāya atharvaṇa vedāya namaḥ

original: haritālavarṇaṃ vājivaktraṃ atharvaṇavedaṃ dhyāyāmi|īśānasomadiṅmadhye oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya truṭyādyākalpa vibhavāntasthāya kṛtayugāya namaḥ | vṛṣendravadanaṃ supakvāmraphalavarṇaṃ kṛtayugaṃ dhyāyāmi | antakā’gnyantare oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya truṭyādyākalpa vibhavāntasthāya tretāyugāya namaḥ|
analyzed: haritāla varṇam vāji vaktram atharvaṇa vedam dhyāyāmi īśāna soma diś madhye om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya truṭi ādi ākalpa vibhava anta sthāya kṛta yugāya namaḥ vṛṣa indra vadanam supakva āmra phala varṇam kṛta yugam dhyāyāmi antaka agni antare om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya truṭi ādi ākalpa vibhava anta sthāya tretā yugāya namaḥ

original: atasīpuṣpanibhaṃ vṛṣendravadanaṃ tretāyugaṃ dhyāyāmi|yāmyarākṣasamadhye oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya truṭyādyākalpa vibhavāntasthāya dvāparayugāya namaḥ| vṛṣendravadanaṃ nīlābjavarṇaṃ dvāparayugaṃ dhyāyāmi | somasāmīraṇāntare oṃ baṃ buddhitatvayutāya truṭyādyākalpa vibhavāntasthāya kaliyugāya namaḥ|
analyzed: atasī puṣpa nibham vṛṣa indra vadanam tretā yugam dhyāyāmi yāmya rākṣasa madhye om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya truṭyā ādi ākalpa vibhava anta sthāya dvāpara yugāya namaḥ vṛṣa indra vadanam nīla abja varṇam dvāpara yugam dhyāyāmi soma sāmīraṇa antare om baṃ buddhi tatva yutāya truṭyā ādi ākalpa vibhava anta sthāya kali yugāya namaḥ

original: vṛṣendravadanaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ kaliyugaṃ dhyāyāmi|etān saṃpūrṇanara lakṣaṇān sadvastra satpuṣpasadalaṅkaraṇānvitān śaṃkha padma varābhayakarān ādheyacakravinyastamastakān svātmasiddhaye parasmin mantrākaraṇe samarpitāntaḥ karaṇān ṣoḍaśavārṣikān dhyāyāmi| upari oṃ raṃ vaṃ haṃ dhāmatrayāśrayāya hrīṃ bhramanmāyāvibhavāntasthāya kālacakrāya namaḥ |
analyzed: vṛṣa indra vadanam śukla varṇam kali yugam dhyāyāmi etān saṃpūrṇa nara lakṣaṇān sat vastra sat puṣpa sat alaṅkaraṇa anvitān śaṃkha padma vara abhaya karān ādheya cakra vinyasta mastakān sva ātma siddhaye parasmin mantra ākaraṇe samarpita antar karaṇān ṣoḍaśa vārṣikān dhyāyāmi upari om raṃ vaṃ haṃ dhāma traya āśrayāya   bhramat māyā vibhava antasthāya kālacakrāya namaḥ

original: yugāntārkāgnisaṃkāśaṃ svagomaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ svamudrāvyagrapāṇiṃ valgantaṃ hetirājaṃ dhyāyāmi | upari oṃ bhaṃ prakṛti tatvayutāya gauṇivṛttavibhavāntasthāya avyaktapadmāya namaḥ| himahemāgnibhāsvaraṃ vāyavyodbhūtanālaṃ śāntaṃ aṣṭabhujaṃ svastikenasthitaṃ saumyaṃ ūrdhvamukhaṃ vikārādhārasusthitaṃ hṛtpuṇḍarīkarūpaṃ avyaktapadmaṃ dhyāyāmi|
analyzed: yugānta arka agni saṃkāśam sva go maṇḍala madhyagam sva mudrā vyagra pāṇim valgantam hetirājam dhyāyāmi upari om bhaṃ prakṛti tatva yutāya gauṇi vṛtta vibhava antasthāya avyakta padmāya namaḥ hima hema agni bhāsvaram vāyavya udbhūta nālam śāntam aṣṭa bhujam svastikena sthitam saumyam ūrdhva mukham vikāra ādhāra susthitam hṛd puṇḍarīka rūpam avyakta padmam dhyāyāmi

original: upari oṃ maṃ cidādityasvarūpāya vimalādikalājāla vibhavāntasthāya jīvātmane namaḥ| sphaṭikopalakāntiṃ cidghanaṃ dhruvaṃ avyaktaṃ sarvaśaktinidhiṃ amūrtaṃ citprabhākāraṃ jīvaṃ dhyāyāmi| dehamadhye oṃ suṣumnānāḍikāyai namaḥ|
analyzed: upari om maṃ cit āditya svarūpāya vimala ādi kalā jāla vibhava anta sthāya jīvātmane namaḥ sphaṭika upala kāntim cit ghanam dhruvam avyaktam sarva śakti nidhim amūrtam cit prabhā ākāram jīvam dhyāyāmi deha madhye om suṣumnā nāḍikāyai namaḥ

original: nābhikandāt brahmarandhreṇa sūryapathāt paragatāṃ pāyudvāreṇa pātālaṃ bhitvā svagocaraṃ yātāṃ sūtre maṇigaṇavat svapratiṣṭhita sarvasaṃkalpaviṣayāṃ tridīptibhāsvarāṃ suṣumnābhidhāṃ madhyanāḍikāṃ dhyāyāmi| jīvātmanaḥ upari oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ nānāmantragaṇarūpiṇyai śabdabrahmaśaktyai namaḥ |
analyzed: nābhi kandāt brahmarandhreṇa sūrya pathāt para gatām pāyu dvāreṇa pātālam bhitvā sva gocaram yātām sūtre maṇi gaṇa vat sva pratiṣṭhita sarva saṃkalpa viṣayām tri dīpti bhāsvarām suṣumnā abhidhām madhya nāḍikām dhyāyāmi jīvātmanaḥ upari om   aim   sauḥ nānā mantra gaṇa rūpiṇyai śabdabrahma śaktyai namaḥ

original: sarvamantra jananīṃ ākārādi hāntaṃ dhārāsaṃtānarūpaṃ varṇajaṃ nādaṃ nadantīṃ parāṃ vākbhramarīṃ śabdabrahmediviśrutāṃ śāntātmanāṃ śaktiṃ dhyāyāmi| upari nādāvasānagagane oṃnamobhagavatevāsudevāya |
analyzed: sarva mantra jananīm ākāra ādi ha antam dhārā saṃtāna rūpam varṇa jam nādam nadantīm parām vāc bhramarīm śabdabrahma idi viśrutām śānta ātmanām śaktim dhyāyāmi upari nāda avasāna gagane om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya

original: śāntaṃ sanātanaṃ saṃvitsvarūpaṃ nityatṛptanirañjanaṃ sarvākāraṃ amūrtaṃ bhaktānugrahakāmyayāmūrtatāṃgataṃ anupamaṃ sahasraravivahnīṃdu lakṣakoṭisamaprabhaṃ devaṃ dhyāyāmi | iti dhyātvā| tadanu oṃ asmadga urubhyaḥ namaḥ iti dhyāyet | hṛtkamaladaleṣu pūrvādiṣu oṃ utkarṣiṇyai namaḥ|oṃ jñānāyai namaḥ | oṃ kriyāyai namaḥ|oṃ yoginyai namaḥ |
analyzed: śāntam sanātanam saṃvid svarūpam nitya tṛpta nirañjanam sarva ākāram amūrtam bhakta anugraha kāmyayā amūrta tāṃgatam anupamam sahasra ravi vahni iṃdu lakṣa koṭi sama prabham devam dhyāyāmi iti dhyātvā tadanu om asmad gaḥ urubhyaḥ namaḥ iti dhyāyet hṛd kamala daleṣu pūrva ādiṣu om utkarṣiṇyai namaḥ om jñānāyai namaḥ om kriyāyai namaḥ om yoginyai namaḥ

original: oṃ prahvayai namaḥ | oṃ satyāyai namaḥ| oṃ īśānyai namaḥ | karṇikāyāṃ oṃ anugrahāyai namaḥ | oṃ sahasraśīrṣāpuruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣassahasrapāt | sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā| atyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam | oṃ namobhagavatevāsudevāya, avyaktapaṅkaja karṇikāmadhye āgacchāgaccha| puruṣaevedam̐sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacchabhavyam| utāmṛtatvasyeśānaḥ| yadannenātirohati|
analyzed: om prahvayai namaḥ om satyāyai namaḥ om īśānyai namaḥ karṇikāyām om anugrahāyai namaḥ om sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapād sa bhūmim viśvatas vṛtvā atyatiṣṭhat daśa aṅgulam om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya avyakta paṅkaja karṇikā madhye āgaccha āgaccha puruṣaḥ eva idam sarvam yat bhūtam yat śa bhavyam uta amṛta tvasya īśānaḥ yat annena atirohati

original: āsanaṃ samarpayāmi| svāgataṃ devadeveśa sannidhiṃ bhaja me’cyuta| gṛhāṇamānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārtha paribhāvitām| oṃ āvāhanamudrāyai namaḥ| oṃ sthāpana mudrāyai namaḥ|oṃ sannidhāna mudrāyai namaḥ|oṃ sannirodha mudrāyai namaḥ| oṃ sāṃmukhyamudrāyai namaḥ| oṃ prārthanāmudrāyai namaḥ| śirasaḥ upari oṃ padmāntarākāśasthitāyai gaṃgāyai namaḥ|
analyzed: āsanam samarpayāmi svāgatam devadeveśa sannidhim bhaja mecyuta gṛhāṇa mānasīm pūjām yathārtha paribhāvitām om āvāhana mudrāyai namaḥ om sthāpana mudrāyai namaḥ om sannidhāna mudrāyai namaḥ om sannirodha mudrāyai namaḥ om sāṃmukhya mudrāyai namaḥ om prārthanā mudrāyai namaḥ śirasaḥ upari om padma antara ākāśa sthitāyai gaṃgāyai namaḥ

original: atha sarvāṇidravyāṇi prakṣālya | dakṣiṇe ca galaṃtikāṃ prakṣālya| aṃbupūritāṃ kṛtvā | vāme ca pārśve vinyasya| oṃ vardhanyādyarcanapātrādhidaivatāya oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | viṣṇugāyatryā’rghyadipātrāṇi prakṣālya| devasyātmano vā’gre tripādukāṃ vinyasya | tasyāṃ oṃ raṃ tripādukādhidaivatāya oṃ tretāgnaye namaḥ| ityāvāhyā’bhyarcya|
analyzed: atha sarvāṇi dravyāṇi prakṣālya dakṣiṇe ca galaṃtikām prakṣālya aṃbu pūritām kṛtvā vāme ca pārśve vinyasya om vardhanī ādi arcana pātra adhidaivatāya om varuṇāya namaḥ iti abhyarcya viṣṇugāyatryā arghya di pātrāṇi prakṣālya devasya ātmanaḥ vā agre tri pādukām vinyasya tasyām om raṃ tri pādukā adhidaivatāya om tretāgnaye namaḥ iti āvāhya abhyarcya

original: tadupari pātrādhārasthālikāṃ vinyasya| tasyāṃ oṃ laṃ pṛthvyai namaḥ ityāvāhyābhyarcya | tadupari madhya dakṣiṇa vāmeṣu pādyārghyacamanīya pātrāṇi nidhāya | gālitodakairāpūrya| praṇavena spṛṣṭvā|kuśāgrākṣata puṣpa phalacandana tilasiddhārtha yavānarghya pātre| tila dūrvāviṣṇuparṇī śyāmāka padmākṣatāṇipādya pātre |
analyzed: tad upari pātra ādhāra sthālikām vinyasya tasyām om laṃ pṛthvyai namaḥ iti āvāhya abhyarcya tad upari madhya dakṣiṇa vāmeṣu pādya arghya camanīya pātrāṇi nidhāya gālita udakaiḥ āpūrya praṇavena spṛṣṭvā kuśa agra akṣata puṣpa phala candana tila siddhārtha yavān arghya pātre tila dūrvā viṣṇuparṇī śyāmāka padma akṣata āṇi pādya pātre

original: elālavaṃga karpūra jātītakkola caṃdanānyācamanīyapātre ca nikṣipya| dakṣiṇahaste oṃ raṃ dvādaśārāya cakrāya namaḥ tanmadhye oṃ haṃ sūryāya namaḥ iti dhyātvā| dīptaistadraśmibhiḥ dravyāṇidagdāni dhyātvā | vāmahaste ṣoḍaśadalayutāya vikasvarāya śvetapadmāya namaḥ, tanmadhye oṃ vaṃ ṣoḍaśakalāyutāya’mṛtamayāya caṃdramase namaḥ iti dhyātvā|
analyzed: elā lavaṃga karpūra jātī takkola caṃdanāni ācamanīya pātre ca nikṣipya dakṣiṇa haste om raṃ dvādaśa ārāya cakrāya namaḥ tad madhye om haṃ sūryāya namaḥ iti dhyātvā dīptaiḥ tad raśmibhiḥ dravyāṇi dagdāni dhyātvā vāma haste ṣoḍaśa dala yutāya vikasvarāya śveta padmāya namaḥ tad madhye om vaṃ ṣoḍaśa kalā yutāya amṛta mayāya caṃdramase namaḥ iti dhyātvā

original: tasmādutthaiḥ amṛtāṃbubhirdravyāṇi siktāni dhyātvā | tāni yāgayogyāni viciṃtya | hastayorubhayoḥ oṃ namonārāyaṇāyeti devaṃ dhyātvā | tābhyāṃ dravyāṇi saṃspṛśya | viṣṇugāyatryā’bhimaṃtrya | oṃ surabhimudrāyai namaḥ iti surabhi mudrāṃ pradarśya|tadutthenāmṛtāni ca pūritānipātrāṇi viciṃtya|
analyzed: tasmāt utthaiḥ amṛta aṃbubhiḥ dravyāṇi siktāni dhyātvā tāni yāga yogyāni viciṃtya hastayoḥ ubhayoḥ om namaḥ nārāyaṇāya iti devam dhyātvā tābhyām dravyāṇi saṃspṛśya viṣṇugāyatryā abhimaṃtrya om surabhimudrāyai namaḥ iti surabhi mudrām pradarśya tad utthena amṛtāni ca pūritāni pātrāṇi viciṃtya

original: oṃ arghyaṃ kalpayāmi, oṃ pādyaṃ kalpayāmi, oṃ ācamanaṃ kalpayāmi ityuccharan tāni spṛṣṭvā | arghyāpātrāt kiñcijjalaṃ anyasmin pātre gṛhītvā | ādhāra stalikopari vinyasya | arghyāpātre om viṣṇave namaḥ, pādya pātre om madhusūdanāya namaḥ, ācamanīya pātre om trivikramāya namaḥ ityāvāhya abhyarcya | pātrāntarastamarghyajalam vāma haste saṃsthāpya |
analyzed: om arghyam kalpayāmi om pādyam kalpayāmi om ācamanam kalpayāmi iti uccharan tāni spṛṣṭvā arghyā pātrāt kiñcid jalam anyasmin pātre gṛhītvā ādhāra stalikā upari vinyasya arghyā pātre om viṣṇave namaḥ pādya pātre om madhusūdanāya namaḥ ācamanīya pātre om trivikramāya namaḥ iti āvāhya abhyarcya pātra antara stam arghya jalam vāma haste saṃsthāpya

original: mūlamaṃtreṇa saptavāraṃ abhimantriya | tajjalena oṃ sahasrārahumphaṭ; iti dravyāṇyātmānañca prokṣya| devasya yogapīṭhaṃ kalpayet om pṛṃ ḍhṛṃ ādhāra śaktyai namaḥ om hrūṃ kāla pāvaka kūrmāyanamaḥ om hāṃ sahasra phaṇādhṛta caturaśrabhūmaṇḍalāyaanantāya namaḥ om bhūm bhūmyai namaḥ . tadupari āgneyādi koṇeṣu |
analyzed: mūlamaṃtreṇa sapta vāram tad jalena om sahasrāra hum phaṭ iti dravyāṇi ātmānam ca prokṣya devasya yogapīṭham kalpayet om pṛṃ ḍhṛṃ ādhāra śaktyai namaḥ om   kāla pāvaka kūrmāya namaḥ om hāṃ sahasra phaṇa ādhṛta caturaśra bhū maṇḍalāya anantāya namaḥ om bhūm bhūmyai namaḥ tad upari āgneya ādi koṇeṣu

original: om dharmāya namaḥ , om jñānāya namaḥ ,om vairāgyāya namaḥ , om aiśvaryāya namaḥ , etān yogāsanāṅghrirūpān puruṣākṛtīṃ caturbhujān siṃhavaktrān sthitān dhyāyāmi | om adharmāya namaḥ, om ajñānāya namaḥ, om avairāgyāya namaḥ, om anaiśvaryāya namaḥ, madhye om sadāśivāya namaḥ | etān aruṇavarṇān pūrvasadṛśān dhyāyāmi |
analyzed: om dharmāya namaḥ om jñānāya namaḥ om vairāgyāya namaḥ om aiśvaryāya namaḥ etān yoga āsana aṅghri rūpān puruṣa ākṛtīm catur bhujān siṃha vaktrān sthitān dhyāyāmi om adharmāya namaḥ om ajñānāya namaḥ om avairāgyāya namaḥ om anaiśvaryāya namaḥ madhye om sadāśivāya namaḥ etān aruṇa varṇān pūrva sadṛśān dhyāyāmi

original: yogāsanāṅghri antarāntara prāgādiṣu,om ṛgvedāya namaḥ, om yajurvedāya namaḥ, om sāmavedāya namaḥ, om atharvavedāya namaḥ, om kṛtayugāya namaḥ , oṃ tretāyugāya namaḥ , om dvāparayugāya namaḥ, om kaliyugāya namaḥ etānīṣārūpena dhyāyāmi|
analyzed: yoga āsana aṅghri antara antara prāñc ādiṣu om ṛgvedāya namaḥ om yajurvedāya namaḥ om sāmavedāya namaḥ om atharvavedāya namaḥ om kṛta yugāya namaḥ om tretā yugāya namaḥ om dvāpara yugāya namaḥ om kali yugāya namaḥ etāni īṣā rūpena dhyāyāmi

original: om vaikārika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, om taijasika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, om bhautika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ, etān pāśarūpeṇayutān dhyāyāmi | om satvaguṇāya namaḥ, om rajoguṇāya namaḥ, om tamo guṇāya namaḥ, etān guṇarūpena dhyāyāmi | om ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ tūlikārūpebhyo pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmane namaḥ |
analyzed: om vaikārika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ om taijasika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ om bhautika ahaṃkārāya namaḥ etān pāśa rūpeṇa yutān dhyāyāmi om satva guṇāya namaḥ om rajaḥ guṇāya namaḥ om tamaḥ guṇāya namaḥ etān guṇa rūpena dhyāyāmi om ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ tūlikā rūpebhyaḥ pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu ākāśa ātmane namaḥ

original: om maṃ āstaraṇa rūpāya jīvātmane namaḥ |tadupari om raṃ agnimaṇḍalāya namaḥ | om vaṃ somamaṇḍalāya namaḥ | om haṃ sūrya maṇḍalāya namaḥ |upari om śvetāya dvādaśadalayutāya vipulakarṇikākesarayutāya guṇatrayātmakāya avyaktapadmāya namaḥ om bhadrāsanāyanamaḥ ityāsanāntasthadevatāśca āvāhya gandhādi caturbhirabhyarcya pīṭhasya dakṣiṇepārśve om
analyzed: om maṃ āstaraṇa rūpāya jīvātmane namaḥ tad upari om raṃ agni maṇḍalāya namaḥ om vaṃ soma maṇḍalāya namaḥ om haṃ sūrya maṇḍalāya namaḥ upari om śvetāya dvādaśa dala yutāya vipula karṇikā kesara yutāya guṇatraya ātmakāya avyakta padmāya namaḥ om bhadrāsanāya namaḥ iti āsana anta stha devatāḥ ca āvāhya gandha ādi caturbhiḥ abhyarcya pīṭhasya dakṣiṇe pārśve om oṃ agni maṇḍala oṃ agni maṇḍala anta stha devatāḥ ca āvāhya

original: brahmaṇe namaḥ, oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ, om īśvarāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | uttare oṃ sanatkumārāya namaḥ, oṃ sanakāya namaḥ, oṃ sanantāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| paścime oṃ durgāyai namaḥ, om vighneśāya namaḥ, om nāradāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| agre om asmadga urubhyo namaḥ ,oṃ asmatparama gurubhyo namaḥ om asmatsarva gurubhyo namaḥ | iti dhyātvā |
analyzed: brahmaṇe namaḥ om viṣṇave namaḥ om īśvarāya namaḥ iti abhyarcya uttare om sanatkumārāya namaḥ om sanakāya namaḥ om sanantāya namaḥ iti abhyarcya paścime om durgāyai namaḥ om vighneśāya namaḥ om nāradāya namaḥ iti abhyarcya agre om asmad gaḥ urubhyaḥ namaḥ om asmad parama gurubhyaḥ namaḥ om asmad sarva gurubhyaḥ namaḥ iti dhyātvā

original: tadanvāvāhanaṃ kuryāt | ekabheravidhāne tu nāvāhayet| surasiddhāvatārite harau ca tatra tu hṛdayasthaṃ biṃbe dhyātvā| ābhimukhyakaraṇamevāvāhanam | na parivāra kalpanaṃ ca| anyatra pratimādau cet|āvāhanapātramadbhiḥ prakṣālya | mūlamantreṇā’dbhirāpūrya | hastābhyāmālalāṭamuddhṛtya|
analyzed: tad anvāvāhanam kuryāt eka bhera vidhāne tu na āvāhayet sura siddha avatārite harau ca tatra tu hṛdaya stham biṃbe dhyātvā ābhimukhya karaṇam eva āvāhanam na parivāra kalpanam ca anyatra pratimā ādau ced āvāhana pātram adbhiḥ prakṣālya mūlamantreṇa adbhiḥ āpūrya hastābhyām ālalāṭam uddhṛtya

original: tasmin oṃ namonārāyaṇāya āgacchāgacchā iti vā oṃ namobhagavate vāsudevāyāgacchāgacchā iti vā biṃbānuguṇaṃ caturvāraṃ japtvā hṛdayasthamāvāhya | kūrcena tattoyaṃ pratimāmūrdhni secayitvā | pātrasthaṃ pratimāyāṃ viciṃtya | āvāhanamudrāṃ pradarśya | kiṃcidutthāya praṇamya| svāgatamuktvā | tanmudrāṃ pradarśya | pratimāmudrāṃ ca pradarśya |
analyzed: tasmin om namaḥ nārāyaṇāya āgaccha āgaccha iti vā om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya āgaccha āgaccha iti vā biṃba anuguṇam catur vāram japtvā hṛdaya stham āvāhya kūrcena tat toyam pratimā mūrdhni secayitvā pātra stham pratimāyām viciṃtya āvāhana mudrām pradarśya kiṃcid utthāya praṇamya svāgatam uktvā tad mudrām pradarśya pratimā mudrām ca pradarśya

original: sannidhiṃ kalpayitvā | mudrāṃ pradarśya | tatra hareḥ sthitiṃ yāgāvasānikaṃ prārthya | prārthanāmudrāṃ ca pradarśya | oṃ namobhagavatevāsudevāya sanmukhobhava iti sāmmukhya mudrāṃ pradarśayet | ekabera viṣaye mūlāt yathāvidyukta vartmanā’‘vāhya | āvāhana sthāpana sannidāna sannirodha sāmmukhya prārthanāmudrāḥ pradarśya |
analyzed: sannidhim kalpayitvā mudrām pradarśya tatra hareḥ sthitim yāga avasānikam prārthya prārthanāmudrām ca pradarśya om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya sanmukhaḥ bhava iti sāmmukhya mudrām pradarśayet ekabera viṣaye mūlāt yathāvid yukta vartmanā āvāhya āvāhana sthāpana sannidāna sannirodha sāmmukhya prārthanāmudrāḥ pradarśya

original: mūlena saparyāsanaṃ datvā | hastanyāsaṃ vinā devadehe maṃtranyāsaṃ kṛtvā | kirīṭa śrīvatsa kaustubha vanamālā cakra śaṃkha gadāpadma garuḍa mudrāśca pradarśya | vibho sakala lokeśa viṣṇojiṣṇo prabho hare | tvām bhaktyā pūjayāṃyadya bhogairarghyadibhiḥkramāt | divyenā’rghyopacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi | arcayiṣyāmi samaye bhagavantam janārdanam|
analyzed: mūlena saparyā asanam da tvā hasta nyāsam vinā deva dehe maṃtra nyāsam kṛtvā kirīṭa śrīvatsa kaustubha vanamālā cakra śaṃkha gadā padma garuḍa mudrāḥ ca pradarśya vibho sakala lokeśa viṣṇo jiṣṇo prabho hare tvām bhaktyā bhogaiḥ arghya dibhiḥ kramāt divyena arghya upacāreṇa yathāśakti yathāvidhi arcayiṣyāmi samaye bhagavantam janārdanam

original: iti deveśaṃ vijñāpya| om tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargodevasya dhīmahi dhīyo yonaḥ pracodayāt arghyaṃ samarpayāmi | iti devasya mūrdhni arghyaṃ samarpya | om trīṇipadā vicakrameviṣṇurgopā’thābhyaḥ tatodharmāni dhārayan pādayoḥ pādyaṃ samarpayāmi | iti dvivāraṃ | om āpaḥ punantu pṛthvīṃ pṛthvī pūtā punātumā punantu brahmaṇaspatiḥ |
analyzed: iti deveśam vijñāpya om tat savituḥ vareṇyam bhargaḥ devasya dhīmahi dhīyas yonaḥ pracodayāt arghyam samarpayāmi iti devasya mūrdhni arghyam samarpya om trīṇi padā tatas dharmāni dhārayan pādayoḥ pādyam samarpayāmi iti dvi vāram om āpaḥ punantu pṛthvīm pṛthvī pūtā punātumā punantu brahmaṇaspatiḥ

original: brahma pūtā punātumām | iti mukhecācamanam samarpya | madhukṣīraṃ ca dadhyājyam madhuparkamiti smṛtam | ekāṅgaṃ vā samastam vā madhuparkam na lopayet | ityuktavat om namobhagavatevāsudevāya madhuparkam nivedya | hastābhyāṃ śirasāpadbhyāṃ manasā ca dhiyā tathā | ahaṃkārenacātmānaṃ nipātya dharaṇī tale| ityaṣṭāṅga praṇipātena devaṃ praṇipatya|
analyzed: brahma pūtā punātu mām iti mukhe ca ācamanam samarpya madhu kṣīram ca dadhi ājyam madhuparkam iti smṛtam eka aṅgam vā samastam vā madhuparkam na lopayet iti ukta vat om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya madhuparkam nivedya hastābhyām śirasā āpadbhyām manasā ca dhiyā tathā ahaṃkārena ca ātmānam nipātya dharaṇī tale iti aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena devam praṇipatya

original: dāsoham te jagannātha saputrādi parigrahaḥ preṣyam prasādikartavye mām niyuṅkṣva hi te sadā| iti deveśaṃ vijñāpya parivāra kalpanaṃ kuryāt yogāsanābjapatreṣu, pūrvādiṣu, dvādaśasu | om śrīvatsāya namaḥ, om vanamālāyai namaḥ, om yogamāyāyai namaḥ, oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ, om vimalāyai namaḥ |
analyzed: dāsaḥ aham te jagannātha sa putra ādi parigrahaḥ preṣyam prasādi kartavye mām niyuṅkṣva hi te sadā iti deveśam vijñāpya parivāra kalpanam kuryāt yoga āsana abja patreṣu pūrva ādiṣu dvādaśasu om śrīvatsāya namaḥ om vanamālāyai namaḥ om yogamāyāyai namaḥ om vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ om vimalāyai namaḥ

original: om sṛṣṭyai namaḥ, om utkarṣiṇyai namaḥ, om prajñāyai namaḥ, om satyāyai namaḥ, om aiśānyai namaḥ, om anukampāyai namaḥ, om pitāmahyai namaḥ pīṭhasya paritaḥ prathamāvaraṇe prāgādiṣu om vyāptyai namaḥ, om kāṃtyai namaḥ, om tṛptyai namaḥ, om śraddhāyai namaḥ, om vidyāyai namaḥ, om jayāyai namaḥ, om kṣamāyai namaḥ, om śāṃtyai namaḥ iti
analyzed: om sṛṣṭyai namaḥ om utkarṣiṇyai namaḥ om prajñāyai namaḥ om satyāyai namaḥ om aiśānyai namaḥ om anukampāyai namaḥ om pitāmahyai namaḥ pīṭhasya paritas prathama āvaraṇe prāñc ādiṣu om vyāptyai namaḥ om kāṃtyai namaḥ om tṛptyai namaḥ om śraddhāyai namaḥ om vidyāyai namaḥ om jayāyai namaḥ om kṣamāyai namaḥ om śāṃtyai namaḥ iti

original: cāmaradhāriṇīśca, dvitīyāvaraṇe om śaṃkhiṇe namaḥ, om cakriṇe namaḥ, om gadine namaḥ, om khaḍgiṇe namaḥ, om padmine namaḥ, om musaline namaḥ, om śārṅgaṇe namaḥ , om vanamāline namaḥ iti ca . tritīyāvaraṇe oṃ iṃdrāya namaḥ, om agnaye namaḥ, om yamāya namaḥ, om naiṛtaye namaḥ, oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ , om vāyave namaḥ, om somāya namaḥ, om īśānāya namaḥ |
analyzed: cāmara dhāriṇīḥ ca dvitīya āvaraṇe om śaṃkhiṇe namaḥ om cakriṇe namaḥ om gadine namaḥ om khaḍgiṇe namaḥ om padmine namaḥ om musaline namaḥ om śārṅgaṇe namaḥ om vanamāline namaḥ iti ca tritīya āvaraṇe om iṃdrāya namaḥ om agnaye namaḥ om yamāya namaḥ om naiṛtaye namaḥ om varuṇāya namaḥ om vāyave namaḥ om somāya namaḥ om īśānāya namaḥ

original: tritīyāvaraṇādbahiḥ bhagavatpratimukhaṃ vainateyaṃ ca | aiśānyām om viṣvaksenāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya| snānāsanaṃ kalpayāmi om pādukādhi daivatāya om am anantāya namaḥ | iti pādukāmabhyarcya idaṃ viṣṇuḥ, trīṇipadā iti devasya pādukārohaṇaṃ smṛtvā | abhiṣecanam | ‘uttiṣṭha’ iti devam utthitamsmṛtvā |

original: tribhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ navabhiḥ ekādaśabhiḥ vā pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭhāntaiḥ darbhaiḥ oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ | oṃ saṅkarṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ pradyumnāya namaḥ | oṃ aniruddhāya namaḥ prāgudagagraṃ prāgādyuttarāntaṃ prādakṣiṇyena paristīrya| tatra dravyāgni madhye pūrvāgrān darbhān āstīrya | tadupari praṇītānnidhāya | adbhiḥāpūrya | akṣataiḥ abhyarcya |
analyzed: tribhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ navabhiḥ ekādaśabhiḥ vā pañcaviṃśati niṣṭhā antaiḥ darbhaiḥ om vāsudevāya namaḥ om saṅkarṣaṇāya namaḥ om pradyumnāya namaḥ om aniruddhāya namaḥ prāc udak agram prāc ādi uttara antam prādakṣiṇyena paristīrya tatra dravya agni madhye pūrva agrān darbhān āstīrya tad upari praṇītān nidhāya adbhiḥ āpūrya akṣataiḥ abhyarcya

original: darbhayugma nirmitaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ kūrcaṃ tasyāṃ vinyasya| tribhiḥrdarbhaiḥ pavitraiḥ ācchādya| prokṣaṇīṃ ātmanaḥ agre vinyasya | praṇītājalaṃ kūrcena saha prokṣaṇyāṃ āvāpya | tatkūrcaṃ hastayoḥ aṅguṣṭā’nāmikābhyāṃ mūlena punaḥ āghāraṃ triḥutpūrya | tatkūrcena prokṣaṇīṃ homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi ca prokṣya | tena nāmādeśaṃ yathāyathaṃ spṛṣṭvā |
analyzed: darbha yugma nirmitam prādeśa sammitam kūrcam tasyām vinyasya tribhiḥ darbhaiḥ pavitraiḥ ācchādya prokṣaṇīm ātmanaḥ agre vinyasya praṇītā jalam kūrcena saha prokṣaṇyām āvāpya tat kūrcam hastayoḥ aṅguṣṭa anāmikābhyām mūlena punar āghāram tris utpūrya tad kūrcena prokṣaṇīm homa dravyāṇi sarvāṇi ca prokṣya tena nāma ādeśam yathāyatham spṛṣṭvā

original: tānipātrāṇi uttānāni kṛtvā|punaḥ prokṣya | tāni prokṣaṇījalena ‘‘satyaṃtvartenapariṣiñcāmi iti prādakṣiṇyena srāvayitvā | praṇītāṃ punaḥadbhiḥ sampūrya|tasmin oṃ kaumodakī śaṃkhacakrapadmadharāya vāsudevāya namaḥ| iti āvāhya | gandhādibhiḥ abhyarcya |
analyzed: tāni pātrāṇi uttānāni kṛtvā punar prokṣya tāni prokṣaṇī jalena satyam tvā ṛtena pariṣiñcāmi iti prādakṣiṇyena srāvayitvā praṇītām punar adbhiḥ sampūrya tasmin om kaumodakī śaṃkha cakra padma dharāya vāsudevāya namaḥ iti āvāhya gandha ādibhiḥ abhyarcya

original: agneḥ aiśānyāṃ darbha viṣṭare tāṃ saṃsthāpya|agneḥdakṣiṇataḥdarbheṣu dvādaśa darbha kṛta kūrcaṃ pūrvāgraṃ vinyasya|tasmin caturmukhaṃ bhuja dvandvaṃ sākṣa mālā kamaṇḍalam| hemābhaṃ śakti sahitaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tu vicintayet | iti dhyātvā | oṃ kam brahmaṇe namaḥ | itikūrce samāvāhya dhyātvā abhyarcya | viṣṇugāyatryā sthālīṃ prakṣālya |
analyzed: agneḥ aiśānyām darbha viṣṭare tām saṃsthāpya agneḥ dakṣiṇatas darbheṣu dvādaśa darbha kṛta kūrcam pūrvāgram vinyasya tasmin caturmukham bhuja dvandvam sākṣa mālā kamaṇḍalam hema ābham śakti sahitam brahmāṇam tu vicintayet iti dhyātvā om kam brahmaṇe namaḥ iti kūrce samāvāhya dhyātvā abhyarcya viṣṇugāyatryā sthālīm prakṣālya

original: taṇḍulān āḍakapramāṇān oṃ ācakrāya svāhā iti tasyāṃ nikṣipya | ‘oṃ vicakrāya svāhā iti śuddhajalaiḥ saṃkṣālya | ‘oṃ sucakrāya svāhā iti saṃśodhya | ‘oṃ sūryacakrāya svāhā iti agnau āropya | ‘oṃ jvālācakrāya svāhā iti agniṃ uddīpya | ‘oṃ mahāsudarśanacakrāya svāhā iti śrapayitvā |
analyzed: taṇḍulān āḍaka pramāṇān om ā cakrāya svāhā iti tasyām nikṣipya om vicakrāya svāhā iti śuddha jalaiḥ saṃkṣālya om sucakrāya svāhā iti saṃśodhya om sūrya cakrāya svāhā iti agnau āropya om jvālā cakrāya svāhā iti agnim uddīpya om mahāsudarśana cakrāya svāhā iti śrapayitvā

original: evaṃ mahānase culyāṃ vā kevalānna mudgānna pāyasānna guḍānnādi caturvidhamannaṃ śrapayitvā | agneḥ uttarato nikṣipya | ājyapātraṃ ātmanaḥ purataḥ saṃsthāpya | drāvitaṃ gālitaṃ ājyaṃ| ājyapātre oṃ aṃ viṣṇave namaḥ ‘‘ oṃāpyāyasvasametute | viśvatassomavṛṣṇiyam|bhavāvājasya saṅgate| iti mantreṇa niṣicya | kuṇḍasya uttare pūrvāgrān darbhān āstīrya |
analyzed: evam mahānase culyām vā kevala anna mudga anna pāyasa anna guḍa anna ādi caturvidham annam śrapayitvā agneḥ uttaratas nikṣipya ājya pātram ātmanaḥ puratas saṃsthāpya drāvitam gālitam ājyam ājya pātre om aṃ viṣṇave namaḥ om āpyāyasva sametu te viśvatas soma vṛṣṇi yambhavau vājasya iti mantreṇa niṣicya kuṇḍasya uttare pūrva agrān darbhān āstīrya

original: teṣu aṅgārān nirūhya|teṣu ājyapātraṃ nidhāya | darbhān ādīpya darśayitvā visṛjya | tribhirdabhaiḥ āchādya | darbha yugma nirmitaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ kūrcam nidhāya | darbhānādīpya darśayitva | śrīmannārāyaṇa caraṇau śaraṇaṃ prapadye | śrīmate nārāyaṇāya namaḥ |
analyzed: teṣu aṅgārān nirūhyateṣu ājya pātram nidhāya darbhān ādīpya darśayitvā visṛjya tribhiḥ dabhaiḥ āchādya darbha yugma nirmitam prādeśa sammitam kūrcam nidhāya darbhān ādīpya darśayitvā śrīmat nārāyaṇa caraṇau śaraṇam prapadye śrīmate nārāyaṇāya namaḥ

original: ātmanaḥ udīcyāṃ sruksruvau nidhāya | kūrca granthiṃ visṛjya taṃ agnau prahṛtya| sruveṇa ājyamādāya|homa dravyeṣu samsicya | kuṇḍasya paścime kuṇḍāyāma sadṛśaṃ aṅguṣṭa nahanaṃ ; dakṣiṇe tasmāt aṅguli hīnaṃ madhyamāṅgulinahanaṃ; uttare tasmāt aṅguli hīnaṃ kaniṣṭhānāhakaṃ paridhi trayam krameṇa śrīdhara , nṛsiṃha, hayagrīva mantraiḥ saṃsthāpya |

original: anuyājasamidhaṃ praṇītāṃmukhe nidhāya|pañcadaśaikataḥ go ghṛtāktā samidhaḥ muṣṭimudrayā prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyan sakṛdevamūlena hutvā | kuśa kūrca veṣṭite vāmakaratale ghṛta pātraṃ nidhāya | oṃ prajāpataye idaṃ na mama iti prathamaṃ naiṛtyādi īśānāntaṃ | oṃ indrāya idaṃ na mama iti dvitīyaṃ vāyavyāt āgneyāntaṃ | āghāraṃ hutvā|
analyzed: anuyāja samidham praṇītām mukhe nidhāya pañcadaśa ekatas go ghṛta aktā samidhaḥ muṣṭi mudrayā prajāpatim manasā dhyāyan sakṛt evamūlena hutvā kuśa kūrca veṣṭite vāma kara tale ghṛta pātram nidhāya om prajāpataye idam na mama iti prathamam naiṛtya ādi īśāna antam om indrāya idam na mama iti dvitīyam vāyavyāt āgneya antam āghāram hutvā

original: tataḥ agnau uttare oṃ agnaye svāhā agnaye idaṃ na mama| dakṣiṇe oṃ somāya svāhā| somāya idaṃ na mama| madhye bhūrādi vyāhṛtibhiśca hutvā | tadanu agniṃ saṃsmaret| dvi śīrṣakaṃ saptahastaṃ tripādaṃ saptajihvakaṃ| varadaṃ śakti pāṇiṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ sruksruvau tathā| abhītidaṃ carmadharaṃ vāmecājyadharaṃ kare| kālī karālī sumanā lohitā dhūmrayeva hi|
analyzed: tatas agnau uttare om agnaye svāhā agnaye idam na mama dakṣiṇe om somāya svāhā somāya idam na mama madhye bhūḥ ādi vyāhṛtibhiḥ ca hutvā tadanu agnim saṃsmaret dvi śīrṣakam sapta hastam tri pādam sapta jihvakam vara dam śakti pāṇim ca bibhrāṇam sruc sruvau tathā abhīti dam carma dharam kare kālī karālī sumanāḥ lohitā dhūmrayā iva hi

original: sphuliṃginī viśvarūpā saptajihvāḥprakīrtitāḥ| kālyāstu madhyamaṃsthānaṃ karālyāḥ pūrvadigbhavet| manojavāyāścāgneyāṃ lohitāyāstu vāruṇe| sudhūmrāsomanilayā sphuliṅginyanilāśrayā| aiśānyaṃ viśvarūpī tu evaṃ sthānaṃ smaret kramāt| jihvāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vaktre dhūmrāyāṃ māraṇādikam| lohitāyāṃ vaśīkāraḥ kālyāṃ karma ca śāntikam|
analyzed: sphuliṃginī viśvarūpā sapta jihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ kālyāḥ tu madhyamam sthānam karālyāḥ pūrva diś bhavet manojavāyāḥ ca āgneyām lohitāyāḥ tu vāruṇe sudhūmrā somanilayā sphuliṅginī anilāśrayā aiśānyam viśvarūpī tu evam sthānam smaret kramāt jihvāyām dakṣiṇe vaktre dhūmrāyām māraṇa ādikam lohitāyām vaśīkāraḥ kālyām karma ca śāntikam

original: sarvasiddhiḥ sphuliṅginyāṃ ānane dakṣiṇetare| viśvarūparasajñāyāṃ aṇimādimahāphalam| karālikā vijayadā puṣṭidā ca manojavā| kārṣṇyaṃ lauhityametāsāṃ varṇaṃśyāmalameva ca| sphuliṅgarūpaṃ ca tataḥ varṇaḥ sphaṭikasannibhaḥ| tapanīyanibhaḥ proktaḥ jihvānāmānupūrvaśaḥ|evaṃ bālāgniṃ dhyātvā|
analyzed: sarva siddhiḥ sphuliṅginyām ānane dakṣiṇetare viśva rūpa rasajñāyām aṇima ādi mahā phalam karālikā vijayadā puṣṭidā ca manojavā kārṣṇyam lauhityam etāsām varṇam śyāmalam eva ca sphuliṅga rūpam ca tatas varṇaḥ sphaṭika sannibhaḥ tapanīya nibhaḥ proktaḥ jihvānām ānupūrvaśas evam bālāgnim dhyātvā

original: utsavāgniḥ trinetraṃ pañcavaktrāḍyaṃ rakta varṇaṃ diśā bhujam | trimekhalaṃ tripādaṃ ca saptajihvā samanvitam| upavītasamāyuktaṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam| cakraṃparaśukhaḍgaṃ ca vajraṃ cā’bhayadakṣiṇe| ṭaṃkaṃ pāśābjacakraṃ ca varadaṃ vahnivāmake| svāhādakṣiṇapārśve tu svadhā vāme tathaiva ca| hiraṇyākanakā’‘kārā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhā|
analyzed: utsava agniḥ trinetram pañcavaktrāḍyam rakta varṇam diśā bhujam trimekhalam tripādam ca sapta jihvā samanvitam upavīta samāyuktam jaṭā makuṭa maṇḍitam cakram paraśu khaḍgam ca vajram ca abhaya dakṣiṇe ṭaṃkam pāśa abja cakram ca vara dam vahni vāmake svāhā dakṣiṇa pārśve tu svadhā vāme tathā eva ca hiraṇyākanaka ākārā kṛṣṇā ca eva tu suprabhā

original: atirikto bahurūpāsaptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| meṣārūḍhaṃ yauvanāgniṃ dhyāyedutsava karmaṇi|evaṃ utsavāgniṃ dhyātvā| nityāgniḥ caturbhujaṃ trinetraṃ ca ekavaktraṃ jaṭādharam| śūlaṃ paraśuhastaṃ ca abhayaṃ varadānvitam| saptajihvānvitaṃ śakti upavītottarīyakam| meṣāsīnaṃ sitaṃ nitye śivaṃ vṛddhāgnimārabhet| dīkṣāśāntipratiṣṭhāgniḥ bāla ityabhidhīyate|
analyzed: atiriktaḥ bahurūpā sapta jihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ meṣa ārūḍham yauvana agnim dhyāyet utsava karmaṇi evam utsava agnim dhyātvā nitya agniḥ caturbhujam trinetram ca ekavaktram jaṭā dharam śūlam paraśu hastam ca abhayam varada anvitam sapta jihvā anvitam śakti upavīta uttarīyakam meṣa āsīnam sitam nitye śivam vṛddha agnim ārabhet dīkṣā śānti pratiṣṭhā agniḥ bālaḥ iti abhidhīyate

original: evaṃ tattatkarmānuguṇaṃ agniṃ dhyātvā | ityabhyarcya | tadanu agnerjātadoṣaśāntaye tilān āghāra sammiśrān dvādaśākṣareṇa aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyayā hunet | āsāṃ madhye kālyāṃ agniṃ ‘‘garbhādhānādikarmaṇā saṃskariṣye iti saṅkalpya| aditenumanyasva ityādinā pariṣicya |
analyzed: evam tad tad karma anuguṇam agnim dhyātvā iti abhyarcya tadanu agneḥ jāta doṣa śāntaye tilān āghāra sammiśrān dvādaśa akṣareṇa aṣṭottaraśata saṃkhyayā hunet āsām madhye kālyām agnim garbhādhāna ādi karmaṇā saṃskariṣye iti saṅkalpya aditenum anyasva ityādinā pariṣicya
