analyzed: snapana artham prāsādasya agratas sarvāsu āvaraṇa bhūmiṣu sarvāsu dikṣu yathāvakāśam catur dvāra catur toraṇa stambha veṣṭana vitāna muktā dāma pūrṇa kumbha darbha mālā ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtam daśa hasta vistṛtam dviguṇena āyatam maṇḍapam kārayitvā tasmin pūrva klṛpte vā maṇḍape tat tredhā vibhajya

original: tṛtīyeṃśe paścime caturaśrāṃ caturhastavistārāṃ śilādinirmitāṃ upānādiyutāṃ vedikāṃ kalpayitvā | tadupari caturaśrāṃ vṛttaṃ vā prādeśena vistīrṇaṃ aṣṭāṅgulena caturaṅgulena vā unnataṃ valayaṃ vedikopari ca ādhāratulyaṃ āśvabhramedinīṃ kuryāt | mṛṇmayādiṣubimbeṣu bahirvedi prakalpanam| ekabere tu na bahiḥ snāna vediprakalpanam|
analyzed: tṛtīya iṃśe paścime caturaśrām catur hasta vistārām śilā ādi nirmitām upānah ādi yutām vedikām kalpayitvā tad upari caturaśrām vṛttam vā prādeśena vistīrṇam aṣṭa aṅgulena catur aṅgulena vā unnatam valayam vedikā upari ca ādhāra tulyam āśvabhra medinīm kuryāt mṛṇmaya ādi bimbeṣu bahirvedi prakalpanam eka bere tu na bahis snāna vedi prakalpanam

original: toraṇādi na kartavyaṃ gṛhārcā snapane tathā| iti vidhāya | tat gomayena anulipya | sudhācūrṇā’kṣata dūrvāṅkura dīpa sāṃkura pālikādibhiḥalaṅkṛtya | tasya raudrekoṇe gālitavastu sugandhijalapūritāni jaladroṇyādi bhājanāni ca| vedikāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bhūtale pavamānādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ abhimantritaṃ sāpidhānaṃ upasnānāmbubhājanaṃ ca kalpayitvā |
analyzed: toraṇa ādi na kartavyam gṛha arcā snapane tathā iti vidhāya tat gomayena anulipya sudhā cūrṇa akṣata dūrvā aṅkura dīpa sāṃkura pālikā ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya tasya raudrekoṇe gālita vastu sugandhi jala pūritāni jala droṇī ādi bhājanāni ca vedikāyām dakṣiṇe bhū tale pavamāna ādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ abhimantritam sa apidhānam upasnāna ambu bhājanam ca kalpayitvā

original: arghyādi dīpaparyantāni pūjādravyāṇi snānopayuktāni ca| tadanu vedikāgre | adhamottamasnapanavidhiḥ candanārdrāṇisūtrāṇi caturdaśa prāgāyatāni udagāyatāni ca āsphālya teṣu ekonasaptatyuttaraśatakoṣṭheṣu dhānyapīṭhānurūpyeṇa ṣoḍaśāṅgulāyāmavistāreṣu brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ nava nava padāni ekādhikāśīti saṃkhyākāni kalaśāspadāni visṛjya|
analyzed: arghya ādi dīpa paryantāni pūjā dravyāṇi snāna upayuktāni ca tadanu vedikā agre adhama uttama snapana vidhiḥ candana ārdrāṇi sūtrāṇi caturdaśa prāc āyatāni udak āyatāni ca āsphālya teṣu ekonasaptati uttaraśata koṣṭheṣu dhānya pīṭha anurūpyeṇa ṣoḍaśa aṅgula āyāma vistāreṣu brahma ādi īśāna paryantam nava nava padāni eka adhika aśīti saṃkhyākāni kalaśa āspadāni visṛjya

original: śeṣāṇi aṣṭottarāśītisaṃkhyākāni vīthyarthaṃ saṃmārjya | pratipadaṃ vrīhyāḍhakena tadardhena vā taṇḍulena tadardhena tilena ca pīṭhikāṃ āracayya| tadupari dvaudvau darbhau pratyasya |
analyzed: śeṣāṇi aṣṭottara aśīti saṃkhyākāni vīthi artham saṃmārjya pratipadam vrīhi āḍhakena tad ardhena vā taṇḍulena tad ardhena tilena ca pīṭhikām āracayya tad upari dvau dvau darbhau pratyasya

original: tadupariṣṭāt sauvarṇān rājatān tāmrānvā mṛṇmayān pakvabimba phalopamān acchidrān svanavataḥ kālamaṇḍalavarjitān abhinnān pāṣāṇasphoṭavarjitān droṇena tadardhena vā vāriṇā paripūraṇocitān saptadaśakumbhān vāryāḍhakena pūraṇocitān catuṣṣaṣṭiśuddhodakakumbhān ca tantunā ‘indraṃ natvā’iti pariveṣṭitān viṣṇugāyatryā prakṣālya |
analyzed: tad upariṣṭāt sauvarṇān rājatān tāmrān vā mṛṇmayān pakva bimba phala upamān acchidrān svanavataḥ kāla maṇḍala varjitān abhinnān pāṣāṇa sphoṭa varjitān droṇena tad ardhena vā vāriṇā paripūraṇa ucitān saptadaśa kumbhān vāri āḍhakena pūraṇa ucitān catuṣṣaṣṭi śuddha udaka kumbhān ca tantunā indram natvā iti pariveṣṭitān viṣṇugāyatryā prakṣālya

original: kalaśāspadamedinyāḥ paścime bhāge dhānyapīṭhaṃ vidhāya | ācāryaḥ svayaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | saṃprokṣya | tasmin prāgagrān udagagrān vā darbhān saṃstīrya | teṣu etān oṃ iti brahmādīśānantaṃ adhomukhān saṃsthāpya | teṣāṃ upari oṃ ṣauṃ namaḥ parāya parameṣṭyātmane namaḥ iti trīn trīn darbhān vinyasya |
analyzed: kalaśa āspada medinyāḥ paścime bhāge dhānya pīṭham vidhāya ācāryaḥ svayam bhūtaśuddhim kṛtvā puṇyāham vācayitvā saṃprokṣya tasmin prāc agrān udak agrān vā darbhān saṃstīrya teṣu etān om iti brahma ādi īśa antam adhomukhān saṃsthāpya teṣām upari om ṣauṃ namaḥ parāya parameṣṭi ātmane namaḥ iti trīn trīn darbhān vinyasya

original: prāṅmukhaḥ san arghyātoyena oṃ yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣātmane namaḥ iti prokṣya | oṃ rāṃ namaḥparāya viśvātmane namaḥ iti akṣatān vikīrya | oṃ vāṃ namaḥ parāya nivṛtyātmane namaḥ iti uttānīkṛtya | vidhivat agniṃ saṃsādhya | viṣṇugāyatryā ājyena snapanadravyāṇi saṃsicya |
analyzed: prāc mukhaḥ san om yāṃ namaḥ parāya puruṣa ātmane namaḥ iti prokṣya om rāṃ namaḥ parāya viśvātmane namaḥ iti akṣatān vikīrya om vām namaḥ parāya nivṛti ātmane namaḥ iti uttānīkṛtya vidhivat agnim saṃsādhya viṣṇugāyatryā ājyena snapana dravyāṇi saṃsicya

original: yathocitaṃ vastrapūtaiḥ ghṛtādi snapanadravyaiḥ tattanmantraiḥ kumbhān āpūrayet| oṃ lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ iti saptadaśakalaśān uddhṛtya | teṣu ekaṃ madhyamanavaka madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ droṇamāṇena ghṛtena oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ iti saṃpūrya | madhye saṃsthāpya | tādṛśa pramāṇena uṣṇodakena āpūrya |
analyzed: yathocitam vastra pūtaiḥ ghṛta ādi snapana dravyaiḥ tad tad mantraiḥ kumbhān āpūrayet om lāṃ namaḥ parāya sarvātmane namaḥ iti saptadaśa kalaśān uddhṛtya teṣu ekam madhyama navaka madhyamam kumbham droṇa māṇena ghṛtena om vāsudevāya namaḥ iti saṃpūrya madhye saṃsthāpya tādṛśa pramāṇena uṣṇa udakena āpūrya

original: oṃ puruṣāya namaḥ iti ghṛtakumbhasya prācyāṃ ca | tasya āgneyadikkumbhaṃ māṇikyapadmarāganīla vajrapuṣyarāga pravāla mauktika marataka vaidūryanāmabhiḥ navaratnaiḥ saratnodakaṃ oṃ keśavāya namaḥ itisaṃpūrya | tadyāmyāyāṃ sodakumbhaṃ kadalīdāḍima cūtāmalakabilvanālikerapanasa mātulaṅgābhidhaiḥ bhinnaiḥ phalaiḥ oṃ satyāya namaḥ iti |
analyzed: om puruṣāya namaḥ iti ghṛta kumbhasya prācyām ca tasya āgneya diś kumbham māṇikya padmarāga nīla vajra puṣyarāga pravāla mauktika marataka vaidūrya nāmabhiḥ navaratnaiḥ sa ratna udakam om keśavāya namaḥ iti saṃpūrya tad yāmyāyām sa udakumbham kadalī dāḍima cūta āmalaka bilva nālikera panasa mātulaṅga abhidhaiḥ bhinnaiḥ phalaiḥ om satyāya namaḥ iti

original: ghṛtasya naiṝtakumbhaṃ lohodakena suvarṇa rajatatāmra sīsa trapukāṃsyāyobhidhānaiḥ pratyekaṃ niṣphapramāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ lohaiḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya’ iti| tatpaścimesajalaṃ kumbhaṃ rajanīsūryavartinīsahadevī śirīṣa sadābhadra kuśāgraiḥ mārjanadravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimāṇaiḥ oṃ acyutāya namaḥ iti|
analyzed: ghṛtasya naiṝta kumbham loha udakena suvarṇa rajata tāmra sīsa trapu kāṃsya ayaḥ abhidhānaiḥ pratyekam niṣpha pramāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ lohaiḥ om namaḥ nārāyaṇāya iti kumbham rajanī sūryavartinī sahadevī śirīṣa sadābhadra kuśa agraiḥ mārjana dravyaiḥ pratyekam muṣṭi māṇaiḥ om acyutāya namaḥ iti

original: tasya mārutaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ candanakuṣṭa kuṅgumāgaru uśīra hrībera girisaṃbhava māṃsīmurābhidhaiḥ pṛthak palamitaiḥ gandhadravyaiḥ oṃ mādhavāya namaḥiti| tasya kauberaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ nīvāraveṇuśāli priyaṅgu yava kaṅgu ṣāṣṭika godhūmataṇḍulaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimātraiḥ oṃ anantāya namaḥ iti|
analyzed: tasya mārutam sa jalam kumbham uśīra hrībera girisaṃbhava māṃsī murā abhidhaiḥ pṛthak pala mitaiḥ gandha dravyaiḥ om mādhavāya namaḥ iti tasya kauberam sa jalam kumbham nīvāra veṇuśāli priyaṅgu yava kaṅgu godhūma taṇḍulaiḥ pratyekam muṣṭi mātraiḥ om anantāya namaḥ iti

original: tasya aiśānaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ yava veṇu vrīhibhiḥ pratyekaṃ kuḍupa pramāṇaiḥ oṃ goviṃdāya namaḥ iti ca saṃpūrya | brahmasthāna navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ sodakaṃ pādyābhidhānaṃ tulasī padma dūrvākṣata śyāmāka viṣṇuparṇī bilvapatraiḥ palamātreṇa candanena ca oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ iti saṃpūrya |
analyzed: tasya aiśānam sajalam kumbham yava veṇu vrīhibhiḥ pratyekam kuḍupa pramāṇaiḥ om goviṃdāya namaḥ iti ca saṃpūrya brahmasthāna navakasya madhyamam kumbham sa udakam pādya abhidhānam tulasī padma dūrvā akṣata śyāmāka viṣṇuparṇī bilva patraiḥ pala mātreṇa candanena ca om viṣṇave namaḥ iti saṃpūrya

original: yāmya navakasya madhyamaṃ arghyākhyaṃ sodakaṃ kumbhaṃ siddhārthākṣata kuśāgra pūrvokta phalayava tila candanapuṣpaiḥ pratyekaṃ muṣṭimātraiḥ, candanena triniṣphamātreṇa oṃ madhusūdanāya namaḥ iti |
analyzed: yāmya navakasya madhyamam arghya ākhyam sa udakam kumbham siddhārtha akṣata kuśa agra pūrva ukta phala yava tila candana puṣpaiḥ pratyekam muṣṭi mātraiḥ candanena tri niṣpha mātreṇa om madhusūdanāya namaḥ iti

original: paścima kumbhanavakasya madhyamaṃ upasparśanākhyaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ takkola caṃpakamukulakarpūra jātīphala elālavaṅgatvakcandanapuṣpaiḥ pratyekaṃ palārdhaparimāṇaiḥ oṃ trivikramāya namaḥiti |
analyzed: paścima kumbha navakasya madhyamam upasparśana ākhyam sa jalam kumbham takkola caṃpaka mukula karpūra jātīphala elā lavaṅga tvac candana puṣpaiḥ pratyekam pala ardha parimāṇaiḥ om trivikramāya namaḥ iti

original: uttara navakasya madhyamaṃ pañcagavyākhyaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhidviguṇena āghāreṇa,tasmāt triguṇena payasā taccaturguṇena mūtreṇa tasmāt caturguṇena śakṛdvāriṇā ca gomūtraṃ viṣṇugāyatryā gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ| āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāviṇṇeti vai dadhi| ghṛtaṃ śukramasītyevaṃ gavyāni sahayojayet|
analyzed: uttara navakasya madhyamam pañcagavya ākhyam kumbham dadhi dviguṇena āghāreṇa tasmāt triguṇena payasā tad caturguṇena mūtreṇa tasmāt caturguṇena śakṛt vāriṇā ca go mūtram viṣṇugāyatryā gandha dvārā iti gomayam āpyāyasva iti ca kṣīram dadhikrāviṇṇā iti vai dadhi ghṛtam śukram asi iti evam gavyāni sahayojayet

original: athavā viṣṇugāyatryā,yadvā ‘‘parameṣṭī śakṛnmantraḥ,gomūtrasya tu pūruṣaḥ| viśvamantraḥ bhavet dadhnaḥ nivṛttiḥ sarpiṣā bhavet|payasaḥ sarvamantraḥ syāt yadvācāṣṭākṣareṇa vā | evaṃ saṃyojya | devasyatveti sarvāṇi ekīkṛtya | evaṃ sādhitena etena pañcagavyena droṇamānena |
analyzed: athavā viṣṇugāyatryā yat vā parameṣṭī śakṛt mantraḥ go mūtrasya tu pūruṣaḥ viśva mantraḥ bhavet dadhnaḥ nivṛttiḥ sarpiṣā bhavet payasaḥ sarva mantraḥ syāt yat vācā aṣṭa akṣareṇa vā evam saṃyojya devasya tvā iti sarvāṇi ekīkṛtya evam sādhitena etena pañcagavyena droṇa mānena

original: evaṃ saṃyojanaprakāraḥ snapanavidhau, prokṣaṇe tu etatsarvaṃ pañcakaṃ samaṃ|prāśane tu gomayena samaṃ mūtraṃ dadhisyāt dviguṇaṃ tataḥ| tataḥ caturguṇaṃ sarpiḥ sarpiṣā’ṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ| prāśane pañcagavyasya pramāṇamidamīritam| droṇamānaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtamānaṃ ca tādṛśam| tādṛgeva dadhi kṣīraṃ tāvadeva ca mākṣikam|
analyzed: evam saṃyojana prakāraḥ snapana vidhau prokṣaṇe tu etat sarvam pañcakam samaṃprāśane tu gomayena samam mūtram dadhi syāt dviguṇam tatas tatas caturguṇam sarpiḥ sarpiṣā aṣṭaguṇam payaḥ prāśane pañcagavyasya pramāṇam idam īritam droṇa mānam pañcagavyam ghṛta mānam ca tādṛśam tādṛś eva dadhi kṣīram tāvat eva ca mākṣikam

original: ardhaṃ vāsyādāḍhakaṃ vā nyūnaṃcedāsuraṃ bhavet| gṛhārcāsnapane nyūnaṃ prasthenaiva prakalpayet| pañcagavyāni gṛhṇīyāt mṛtpātre nūtane śubhe| kapilāyāḥ jarāyāḥ vā pañcagavyaṃ praśasyate| na ārtāyāḥ na ca garbhiṇyāḥ na vṛddhāyāḥ kadācana| na avatsāyaḥ upādadyāt dhenomūtraṃ śakṛddvayam| bhūmiṣṭhaṃ gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ soṣṇaṃ kṛmyādi dhūṣitam|
analyzed: ardham vā nyūnam ced āsuram bhavet gṛha arcā snapane nyūnam prasthena eva prakalpayet pañcagavyāni gṛhṇīyāt mṛd pātre nūtane śubhe kapilāyāḥ jarāyāḥ vā pañcagavyam praśasyate na ārtāyāḥ na ca garbhiṇyāḥ na vṛddhāyāḥ kadācana na a vatsa ayaḥ upādadyāt dheno mūtram śakṛt dvayam bhūmiṣṭham gomayam grāhyam sa uṣṇam kṛmi ādi dhūṣitam

original: niṣpīḍya samyak gṛhṇīyāt gomayasya rasaṃ punaḥ| sadyastaptaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ ahorātroṣitaṃ dadhi| kṣīraṃ grāhyamataptaṃ ca daśahājjanmanaḥ param|evaṃ saṃpādya | oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ iti |
analyzed: niṣpīḍya samyak gṛhṇīyāt gomayasya rasam punar sadyas taptam ghṛtam śuddham ahar rātra uṣitam dadhi kṣīram grāhyam ataptam ca daśahāt janmanaḥ param evam saṃpādya om vāmanāya namaḥ iti

original: āgneya navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhnā oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ iti naiṝtakumbha navakasya madhya kumbhaṃ payasā oṃ hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ iti, vāyavīyakumbha navakumbha navakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ madhunā oṃ padmanābhāya namaḥ iti, aiśānyāṃ kumbhanavakasya madhyamaṃ kumbhaṃ śamīpalāśakhādira bilvāśvattha vikaṅga ta audumbara nyagrodhatvakbhiḥ
analyzed: āgneya navakasya madhyamam kumbham dadhnā om śrīdharāya namaḥ iti naiṝta kumbha navakasya madhya kumbham payasā om hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ iti vāyavīya kumbha nava kumbha navakasya madhyamam kumbham madhunā om padmanābhāya namaḥ iti aiśānyām kumbha navakasya madhyamam kumbham śamī palāśa khādira bilva aśvattha vikaṅga audumbara nyagrodha tvakbhiḥ

original: palārdhaparimitābhiḥ kṛtena kaṣāyena oṃ dāmodarāya namaḥ iti ca saṃpūrya | viṣṇugāyatryā saptadaśa dravya kumbhān saṃsthāpya | madhyamanavakasya pūrvanavakādyaṣṭanavakamadhyadravyakumbhānāṃ ca parito’ṣṭāvaṣṭau śuddhodakalaśān dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa saṃsthāpayet | pūrvoktadravyā’lābhe tu pādyadravyāṃtarālābhe dūrvāgrepi ca sarṣapaḥ|

analyzed: viśvamantreṇa akṣatān vikīrya nivṛttimantreṇa uttānikṛtya tadanu vidhivat agnim saṃsādhya sarpiṣā viṣṇugāyatrya aṣṭottara śatāhutiḥ hutvā saṃpātena snapana dravyāṇi saṃsicya vastrapūtaiḥ snapanadravyaiḥ tattat devatā mantraiḥ kalaśān saṃpūrya dravya kalaśān uddhṛtya viṣṇugāyatrya yathāsthānam vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā sthāpayet

original: madhye brāhmebhāge ekottarāśīti ghaṭāḥ| divye aindre divye yāmye vāruṇe divye saumye ca pratidiśaṃ ekottarāśītikalaśāḥ | divyabhāgāgneyādi koṇacatuṣṭayeṣvapi pratikoṇaṃ ekonapañcāśat saṃkhyākāḥ kalaśāḥ| teṣāṃ tu prāgudagagrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya| pūrvādi dikṣu dve dve paṅktī hitvā | paritaḥ ekaikāṃ paṅktiṃ saṃmārjya |
analyzed: madhye brāhme bhāge eka uttara aśīti ghaṭāḥ divye aindre divye yāmye vāruṇe divye saumye ca pratidiśam eka uttara aśīti kalaśāḥ divyabhāga āgneya ādi koṇa catuṣṭayeṣu api pratikoṇam ekonapañcāśat saṃkhyākāḥ kalaśāḥ teṣām tu prāc udak agrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya pūrva ādi dikṣu dve dve paṅktī hitvā paritas ekaikām paṅktim saṃmārjya

original: madhye nava pūrvādyuttarāntaṃ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ | āgneyādīśānāntaṃ catvāri catvāri kalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ| tatparitaśca mānuṣe bhāge ṣoḍaśasthāneṣu ca pratisthānaṃ pañcaviṃśatikalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ | teṣāṃ tu prāgudagagrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya | catusṛṣu dikṣu ekaikām paṅktī hitvā | tadanu dve dve paṅktī sammārjya | madhye nava dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi vidikṣu ekaikāṃ |
analyzed: madhye nava pūrva ādi uttara antam ṣaṣ ṣaṣ āgneya ādi īśāna antam catvāri catvāri kalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ tad paritas ca mānuṣe bhāge ṣoḍaśa sthāneṣu ca pratisthānam pañcaviṃśati kalaśāḥ sthāpyāḥ teṣām tu prāc udak agrāṇi daśa sūtrāṇi āsphālya catusṛṣu dikṣu ekaikām paṅktī hitvā tadanu dve dve paṅktī sammārjya madhye nava dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi vidikṣu ekaikām paṅktī sammārjya madhye nava dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi vidikṣu ek

original: evaṃ pañcaviṃśati kalaśān sthāpayet |evaṃ cet kalaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ekottaraṃ bhavati | brāhme madhyanavake navakamadhyame sarvalohān || suvarṇa rajata tāmra sīsa trapu kāṃsyā’yassārān niṣphamātrān, māṇikya padmarāga nīlavajra puṣyaka pravālamuktāmarataka vaiḍhūryāṇi |
analyzed: evam pañcaviṃśati kalaśān sthāpayet evam ced kalaśānām sahasram eka uttaram bhavati brāhme madhya navake navaka madhyame sarva lohān suvarṇa rajata tāmra sīsa trapu kāṃsya ayaḥsārān niṣpha mātrān māṇikya padmarāga nīla vajra puṣyaka pravāla muktā marataka vaiḍhūryāṇi

original: kadalī bījapūrakā’‘mrā’‘malaka bilva nālikera panasa mātuluṅgāni māṃsi kuṣṭha haridrādvitaya murāśaileya campaka mukula mustāvacā karpūrāṇi pṛthak pṛthak palamātrāṇi |
analyzed: kadalī bījapūraka āmra āmalaka bilva nālikera panasa mātuluṅgāni māṃsi kuṣṭha haridrā dvitaya murā śaileya campaka mukula mustā vacā karpūrāṇi pṛthak pṛthak pala mātrāṇi

original: karpūra kuṅakuma kuṣṭha māṃsi candanamurapriyaṅgu kesara mustātamālanāgakesara mūladvaya, kacchora suraparṇi kesarośīra tagara loghra haricandana agaru dvaya, sitakuṣṭhakāleya granthipallava campaka mukulāni pratyekaṃ palamānāni cūrṇikṛtāni|
analyzed: karpūra kuṅakuma kuṣṭha māṃsi candana murapriyaṅgu kesara mustā tamāla nāgakesara mūla dvaya kacchora suraparṇi kesara uśīra tagara loghra haricandana agaru dvaya sitakuṣṭha kāleya granthipallava campaka mukulāni pratyekam pala mānāni cūrṇikṛtāni

original: śrīvatsa vanamāla śaṅkha cakra gadāṃbuja khaḍga śārṅgāṇi svarṇanirmitāni pratyekaṃ niṣphamānāni ca sajale kumbhe oṃ namobhagavatevāsudevāya iti viniveśya | taṃ yuvāsā iti vāsobhyāṃ āveṣṭya | sakūrca pippala dalāpidhānaṃ kṛtvā| tatra yogapīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya | tasmin sāṅgaṃ saparivāraṃ vāsudevaṃ āvāhya | arghyādi dīpāntaṃ abhyarcya|
analyzed: śrīvatsa vanamāla śaṅkha cakra gadā ambuja khaḍga śārṅgāṇi svarṇa nirmitāni pratyekam ca sa jale kumbhe om namaḥ bhagavate vāsudevāya iti viniveśya tam iti vāsobhyām āveṣṭya sa kūrca pippala dala apidhānam kṛtvā tatra yogapīṭham saṃkalpya tasmin sa aṅgam sa parivāram vāsudevam āvāhya arghya ādi dīpa antam abhyarcya

original: brāhme tasya prācīnakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe sūryakānta padmarāgau| tasya puruṣo devatā | brāhme āgneya kumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe vaiḍhūrya candrakāntau| tasya vāsudevaḥ devatā | brāhme yāmyakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe indranīlāyasyakāntau tasya satyo devatā| brāhme naiṝtakumbhanavaka madhyame kumbhe pravālagaruḍau tasya saṅkarṣaṇo devatā|
analyzed: brāhme tasya prācīna kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe sūryakānta padmarāgau tasya puruṣaḥ devatā brāhme āgneya kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe vaiḍhūrya candrakāntau tasya vāsudevaḥ devatā brāhme yāmya kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe indranīla āyasya kāntau tasya satyaḥ devatā brāhme naiṝta kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe pravāla garuḍau tasya saṅkarṣaṇaḥ devatā

original: brāhme vāruṇa kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe puṣyasphaṭikau tasya acyutaḥdevatā | brāhme vāyavya kumbhanavakamadhyamekumbhe padmarāgamaratake tasya pradyumno devatā| brāhme vāruṇa kumbhanavakamadhyamekumbhe vajraṃ,rajatam tasya anantaḥ devatā| brāhme raudrakumbhanavakamadhyame kumbhe tāmramauttike tasya aniruddhaḥ devatā|
analyzed: brāhme vāruṇa kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe puṣya sphaṭikau tasya acyutaḥ devatā brāhme vāyavya kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe padmarāga maratake tasya pradyumnaḥ devatā brāhme vāruṇa kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe vajraṃrajatam tasya anantaḥ devatā brāhme raudra kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe tāmra mauttike tasya aniruddhaḥ devatā

original: sarveṣu śuddhodakeṣu mauktikāni teṣāṃ devatā nārāyaṇaḥ| tasyāṃ prācyāṃ divye bhāge ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe kadali panasa āmra mātulaṅga bhavya jaṃbukesara badari phalāni | tasya devatā tattvātmā | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe mātulaṅga dāḍimaphale | tasya devatā pṛthvī |
analyzed: sarveṣu śuddha udakeṣu mauktikāni teṣām devatā nārāyaṇaḥ tasyām prācyām divye bhāge ekāśīti ghaṭa āspade madhya navaka madhyame kumbhe kadali panasa āmra mātulaṅga bhavya jaṃbu kesara badari phalāni tasya devatā tattva ātmā tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe mātulaṅga dāḍima phale tasya devatā pṛthvī

original: tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe jambūnāraṅga phale | tasya devatā apāṃadhiṣṭhātri| tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe takkolailāphale | tasya tejasvīpuruṣaḥ devatā | tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe kṣīrikāmalaka phale | tasya vāyurdevatā| tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame ghaṭe drākṣā kharjūra phale | tasya ākāśātmā devatā |
analyzed: tasya āgneya navaka madhyame ghaṭe jambū nāraṅga phale tasya devatā apām adhiṣṭhātri tasya yāmya navaka madhyame ghaṭe takkola elā phale tasya tejasvī puruṣaḥ devatā tasya naiṝta kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe kṣīrikā āmalaka phale tasya vāyuḥ devatā tasya vāruṇa navaka madhyame ghaṭe drākṣā kharjūra phale tasya ākāśa ātmā devatā

original: tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame ghaṭe cūtapārāvataphale| tasya devatā manaḥ| tasya saumya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kṣudraṃ panasaphalaṃ| tasya devatāahaṃkāraḥ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe bilvakadali phale | tasya devatā buddhiḥ | sarveṣu śuddhodaka kumbheṣu badari phalāni devatāḥ pūrvavat| aṣṭākṣareṇa pañcopaniṣadaiḥ kumbhānāṃ abhimantraṇam |
analyzed: tasya vāyavya navaka madhyame ghaṭe cūta pārāvata phale tasya devatā manaḥ tasya saumya navaka madhyame ghaṭe kṣudram panasa phalam tasya devatā ahaṃkāraḥ tasya aiśānya navaka madhyame ghaṭe bilva kadali phale tasya devatā buddhiḥ sarveṣu śuddha udaka kumbheṣu badari phalāni devatāḥ pūrvavat aṣṭa akṣareṇa pañca upaniṣadaiḥ kumbhānām abhimantraṇam

original: divyayāmye ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe uśīra, kuṅakuma, kuṣṭha, māṃsī, malayaja, mura, hrībera, agarupiṣṭāni pratyekaṃ palamātrāṇi tasya devatā trailokyamohanaḥ | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe jaladavāreṇamūle| tasya devatā babhruḥ | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe karpūrakāśmīre | tasya devatā śauriḥ |
analyzed: divya yāmye ekāśīti ghaṭa āspade madhya navaka madhyame kumbhe uśīra kuṅakuma kuṣṭha māṃsī malayaja mura hrībera agaru piṣṭāni pratyekam pala mātrāṇi tasya devatā trailokya mohanaḥ tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe tasya devatā babhruḥ tasya āgneya navaka madhyame ghaṭe karpūra kāśmīre tasya devatā śauriḥ

original: tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe campaka mukula māṃsīpiṣṭe | tasya devatā dāśārhaḥ| tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe candana raktacandanakṣodau | tasya devatāannādhipatiḥ | tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame kumbhe suraparṇī maurarajasī | tasya devatāvaikuṇṭhaḥ | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame ghaṭe girijamūla praiyaṅgava mūla rajasī |
analyzed: tasya yāmya navaka madhyame ghaṭe campaka mukula māṃsī piṣṭe tasya devatā dāśārhaḥ tasya naiṝta kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe candana raktacandana kṣodau tasya devatā annādhipatiḥ tasya vāruṇa navaka madhyame kumbhe suraparṇī maurarajasī tasya devatā vaikuṇṭhaḥ tasya vāyavya navaka madhyame ghaṭe girijamūla praiyaṅgava mūla rajasī

original: tasya devatā puruṣottamaḥ | tasya saumya navakamadhyame kumbhe kuṣṭa sitakuṣṭapiṣṭe | tasya devatā mukundaḥ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kṛṣṇa dhavalāgarukṣodau | tasya devatā vṛṣākapiḥ| avaśiṣṭeṣu śuddhodaka kumbheṣu tamāla patrāṇi | devatāḥ pūrvavat | puruṣamantreṇa vā pavamānādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ vā kumbhābhimantraṇam|
analyzed: tasya devatā puruṣottamaḥ tasya saumya navaka madhyame kumbhe kuṣṭa sitakuṣṭa piṣṭe tasya devatā mukundaḥ tasya aiśānya navaka madhyame ghaṭe kṛṣṇa dhavala agaru kṣodau tasya devatā vṛṣākapiḥ avaśiṣṭeṣu śuddha udaka kumbheṣu tamāla patrāṇi devatāḥ pūrvavat puruṣamantreṇa vā pavamāna ādibhiḥ sūktaiḥ vā kumbha abhimantraṇam

original: divya vāruṇe ekottarāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavakamadhyame kumbhe vāpi saritkūpa hrada vṛṣṭi hima āpagā samudra taṭāka pāthāṃsi nava | tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe vāpījalaṃ | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe sarijjalaṃ | tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe kūpajalaṃ | tasya naiṝta kumbha navakamadhyame kumbhe hradajalaṃ |
analyzed: divya vāruṇe ekottara aśīti ghaṭa āspade madhya navaka madhyame kumbhe vāpi sarit kūpa hrada vṛṣṭi hima āpagā samudra taṭāka pāthāṃsi nava tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe vāpī jalam tasya āgneya navaka madhyame ghaṭe sarit jalam tasya yāmya navaka madhyame ghaṭe kūpa jalam tasya naiṝta kumbha navaka madhyame kumbhe hrada jalam

original: tasya vāruṇa navakamadhyame kumbhe himajalaṃ | tasya vāyavya navakamadhyame vṛṣṭi| tasya saumya navakamadhyame kumbhe āpagājalaṃ | tasya aiśānya navakamadhyame ghaṭe samudrajalaṃ | eteṣāṃ devatāstu krameṇa bhārgavarāmarahitāḥ matsyādayaḥ| śuddhodakānāṃ pūrvavat|
analyzed: tasya vāruṇa navaka madhyame kumbhe hima jalam tasya vāyavya navaka madhyame vṛṣṭi tasya saumya navaka madhyame kumbhe āpagā jalam tasya aiśānya navaka madhyame ghaṭe samudra jalam eteṣām devatāḥ tu krameṇa bhārgava rāma rahitāḥ matsya ādayaḥ śuddha udakānām pūrvavat

original: divye saumye ekāśītighaṭāspade madhyanavaka madhyame kumbhe yava godhūma vrīhi śāli mudga priyaṅgu māṣa śyāmāka nīvārāṇi| tasya devatā garuḍārūḍhaḥ padmanābhaḥ| tasya aindre navaka madhyame kumbhe yavaṃ | tasya devatā vanamālā | tasya āgneya navakamadhyame ghaṭe godhūmaḥ | tasya devatā śaṅkhaḥ | tasya yāmya navakamadhyame ghaṭe vrīhiḥ |

original: tanmūrtipasya śirasi nikṣipya| tūryaghoṣaissaha dhāmapradakṣiṇī kṛtya | garbhamandiraṃ nītvā | bhagavantamarghyadibhirabhyarcya| puṇyāhajalenā’stramantreṇa paṭaṃ saṃprokṣya | astramantrābhimantrita siddhārthaiḥ puṣpaiśca santāḍya | dāhānāpyāyane kṛtvā| devaṃ praṇamya|imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet | bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa sarveśvara jaganmaya|
analyzed: tat mūrtipasya śirasi nikṣipya tūrya ghoṣaiḥ saha dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya garbha mandiram nītvā bhagavantam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya puṇyāha jalena astramantreṇa paṭam saṃprokṣya astramantra abhimantrita siddhārthaiḥ puṣpaiḥ ca santāḍya dāha an āpyāyane kṛtvā devam praṇamya emām gāthām udīrayet bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa sarveśvara jagat maya

original: tvayā yathā tu kathitaṃ tathākartuṃ na śakyate| asvātantyādasāmartyāt śraddhādīnāmabhāvataḥ| tasmānmānādisarveṣāṃ nyūnādhikhyopaśāntaye| sarvadoṣāpahāribhyāṃ vainateyaṃ prasīdaya| iti bhagavantaṃ vijñāpya | tūryaghoṣapurassaraṃ prādakṣiṇyena yāgamaṇṭapaṃ praviśya| śālipīṭhe paṭaṃ sthāpya vistārya |
analyzed: tvayā yathā tu kathitam tathā kartum na śakyate asvātantyāt asāmartyāt śraddhā ādīnām abhāvataḥ tasmāt māna ādi sarveṣām nyūna adhikhyā upaśāntaye sarva doṣa apahāribhyām vainateyam prasīdaya iti bhagavantam vijñāpya tūrya ghoṣa purassaram prādakṣiṇyena yāga maṇṭapam praviśya śāli pīṭhe paṭam sthāpya vistārya

original: chāyādhivāsa pratiṣṭhāntānāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhyarthaṃ rakṣābandhanakarmakariṣye iti saṃkalpya | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā prokṣya | paṭasthasya pratisaraṃ yathāvidhi baddhvā | tasya dakṣiṇataḥ upaviśya | prāṇāyāma purassaraṃ bhūtaśuddhimaṣṭākṣara mantranyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā| tadanu asyaśrī garuḍapañcākṣara mantrasya| kāśyapaṛṣiḥ| paṅktīścandaḥ| śrī garuḍodevatā |
analyzed: chāyā adhivāsa pratiṣṭhā antānām karmaṇām siddhi artham rakṣābandhana karma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya paṭa sthasya pratisaram yathāvidhi baddhvā tasya dakṣiṇatas upaviśya prāṇāyāma purassaram bhūtaśuddhim aṣṭa akṣara mantra nyāsam ca kṛtvā tadanu kāśyapa ṛṣiḥ paṅktīḥ candaḥ śrī garuḍaḥ devatā

original: kṣīṃ bījaṃ | svāhā śaktiḥ | śrīgaruḍo devatā | śrī garuḍa prasādasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | oṃ kṣīṃ aṅguṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ paṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ oṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | oṃ svāṃ anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ | oṃ hāṃ kaniṣṭikābhyāṃ phaṭ | oṃ kṣipa oṃ svāhā nakhamukhairvauṣṭ | oṃ jvala jvala mahāmate svāhā oṃ kṣāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ|
analyzed: kṣīṃ bījam svāhā śaktiḥ śrī garuḍaḥ devatā śrī garuḍa prasāda siddhi arthe viniyogaḥ om kṣīṃ aṅguṣṭābhyām namaḥ om paṃ tarjanībhyām svāhā om om madhyamābhyām vaṣaṭ om svāṃ anāmikābhyām hum om hāṃ kaniṣṭikābhyām phaṭ om kṣipa om svāhā nakha mukhaiḥ vauṣṭ om jvala jvala mahāmate svāhā om   hṛdayāya namaḥ

original: oṃ garuḍa cūḍānane svāhā oṃ kṣīṃ śirase svāhā | oṃ garuḍa prabhañjaya prabhañjaya prabhedaya prabhedaya vitrāsaya vitrāsaya vimardaya vimardayasvāhā oṃ kṣaiṃ kavacāya huṃ | ugrarūpadhara sarva sarpa bhayaṃkara sarvaviṣaṃ dāraya dāraya bhīṣaya bhīṣaya daha daha bhasmīkuru svāhā,oṃ kṣauṃ netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ|
analyzed: om garuḍa cūḍā ānane svāhā om   śirase svāhā om garuḍa prabhañjaya prabhañjaya prabhedaya prabhedaya vitrāsaya vitrāsaya vimardaya vimardaya svāhā om   kavacāya hum ugra rūpa dhara sarva sarpa bhayaṃkara sarva viṣam dāraya dāraya bhīṣaya bhīṣaya daha daha bhasmīkuru svāhā om   netrābhyām vauṣaṭ

original: oṃ apratihata śāsanāya oṃ namaḥ sudarśanāya huṃphaṭsvāhā oṃ kṣaḥ astrāya phaṭ’ dhyānam| ājānuta suvarṇābhaṃ ānābheḥ tuhinaprabham| kuṅkumāruṇamākaṇṭhāt ākeśāntāt sitetaram| svastikaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu kuñcitam| dīrghabāhuṃ bṛhatskandhaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitam| nīlāgranāsikātmānaṃ māhapakṣaṃ smaretbudhaḥ|
analyzed: om apratihata śāsanāya om namaḥ sudarśanāya huṃ phaṭ svāhā om   astrāya phaṭ dhyānam ā nābheḥ tuhina prabham kuṅkuma aruṇam ā kaṇṭhāt ā keśāntāt sitetaram svastikam dakṣiṇam pādam vāma pādam tu kuñcitam dīrgha bāhum bṛhat skandham nāga ābharaṇa bhūṣitam nīla agra nāsikā ātmānam smaret budhaḥ

original: daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ kirīṭamakuṭojjvalam| sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram| ananto vāmakaṭakaḥ yajñasūtraṃ tu vāsukiḥ| takṣakaḥ kaṭisūtraṃ tu hāraḥ kārkoṭakaḥ tathā| padmo dakṣiṇakarṇe tu mahāpadmastu vāmataḥ| śaṃkhaḥ śiraḥpradeśe tu gulikastu bhujāntare| evaṃ dhyāyet trisandhyāyāṃ ātmānaṃ garuḍākṛtim|
analyzed: daṃṣṭrā karāla vadanam kirīṭa makuṭa ujjvalam sarva ābharaṇa saṃyuktam sarva avayava sundaram anantaḥ vāma kaṭakaḥ yajña sūtram tu vāsukiḥ takṣakaḥ kaṭi sūtram tu hāraḥ kārkoṭakaḥ tathā padmaḥ dakṣiṇa karṇe tu mahāpadmaḥ tu vāmatas śaṃkhaḥ śiraḥ pradeśe tu gulikaḥ tu bhujāntare evam dhyāyet trisandhyāyām ātmānam garuḍa ākṛtim

original: viṣaṃ nāśayate kṣipraṃ agnikṣiptamivāṃbhasi| oṃ namaḥ pakṣirājāya vedapakṣayugaprabho| vainateya namastestu śrī garuḍāya namo namaḥ| evamātmānaṃ garuḍaṃ dhyātvā | hṛtpuṇḍarīkāvyaktapadme garuḍaṃ dhyātvā | mānasaiḥ upacāraiḥ abhyarcya |
analyzed: viṣam nāśayate kṣipram agni kṣiptam iva aṃbhasi om namaḥ pakṣirājāya veda pakṣa yuga prabho vainateya namaḥ te tu śrī garuḍāya namaḥ namaḥ evam ātmānam garuḍam dhyātvā hṛd puṇḍarīka avyakta padme garuḍam dhyātvā mānasaiḥ upacāraiḥ abhyarcya

original: tadanu tasya purataḥ chāyādhivāsa siddhyarthaṃ dhānyarāśau svarṇādilohajaṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vā jaladroṇīṃ tādṛśaṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya| gandhatoyena saṃpūrya | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvāprokṣya| śoṣaṇadahanaplāvanāni kṛtvā | toraṇadhvaja kumbhapūjanaṃ ca vidhāya | paṭastaṃ kūrce samāvāhya | tasmin saṃhārakrameṇa prākchirasaṃ śāyayitvā |
analyzed: tadanu tasya puratas chāyā adhivāsa siddhi artham dhānya rāśau svarṇa ādi loha jam mṛṇmayīm vā jala droṇīm tādṛśam kaṭāham vā saṃsthāpya gandha toyena saṃpūrya puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya śoṣaṇa dahana plāvanāni kṛtvā toraṇa dhvaja kumbha pūjanam ca vidhāya paṭaḥ tam kūrce samāvāhya tasmin saṃhāra krameṇa prāc śirasam śāyayitvā

original: sudarśanamantreṇa cakramudrāṃ pradarśya | tatraiva yamasya diśi dhānyarāśau rakṣākumbhaṃ sakarakaṃ vinyasya | tasmin brahmāṇaṃ karake sudarśana mantreṇa cakramudrāṃ pradarśya | evaṃ yāmaṃ yāmārdhaṃ vā adhivāsya | sadyo vā| tadanu kūrcaṃ jālāduddhṛtya | paṭe samāvāhya|
analyzed: sudarśana mantreṇa cakra mudrām pradarśya tatra eva yamasya diśi dhānya rāśau rakṣā kumbham sa karakam vinyasya tasmin brahmāṇam karake sudarśana mantreṇa cakra mudrām pradarśya evam yāmam yāma ardham vā adhivāsya sadyas vā tadanu kūrcam jālāt uddhṛtya paṭe samāvāhya

original: nayanonmīlanārthaṃ suvarṇarajata pātre āḍhakapūraṇayogye tādṛśau śalākike ca samādāya | purataḥ dhānyapīṭhe pūrve sauvarṇaṃ paścime rājataṃ ca pātraṃ saśalākaṃ nidhāya | tatparitaḥ pātreṣu nīvāra,śāli,mudga,śyāmāka, priyaṅgu, yava, tila, godhūmāni aṣṭadhānyāni pṛthak pṛthak nidhāya | ādyaṃ madhunā dvitīyamājyena ca pātraṃ āpūrya |
analyzed: nayana unmīlana artham suvarṇa rajata pātre āḍhaka pūraṇa yogye tādṛśau śalākike ca samādāya puratas dhānya pīṭhe pūrve sauvarṇam paścime rājatam ca pātram sa śalākam nidhāya tad paritas pātreṣu nīvāra śāli mudga śyāmāka priyaṅgu yava tila godhūmāni aṣṭadhānyāni pṛthak pṛthak nidhāya ādyam madhunā dvitīyam ājyena ca pātram āpūrya

original: ‘nayanonmīlanakarmakariṣye’ iti saṃkalpya | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā | tāni prokṣya, paristīrya | madhuni sūryaṃ, ājye candramasaṃ ca āvāhya abhyarcya | saveda vādyaghoṣaṃ madhvaktamukhayā suvarṇaśalākayā ‘citraṃdevānāṃ’ iti dakṣiṇaṃ ghṛtāktayā rājata śalākayā’taccakṣuḥ’ iti vāmalocanaṃ ca unmīlya | ācchādanapaṭaṃ vyapohya |
analyzed: nayana unmīlana karma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya puṇyāham vācayitvā tāni prokṣya paristīrya madhuni sūryam ājye candramasam ca āvāhya abhyarcya sa veda vādya ghoṣam madhu akta mukhayā suvarṇa śalākayā citram devānām iti dakṣiṇam ghṛta aktayā rājata śalākayā tad cakṣuḥ iti vāma locanam ca unmīlya ācchādana paṭam vyapohya

original: madhusarpiṣī ca aṣṭadhānyāni darśayitvā | aṣṭanāgānāṃ api evaṃ kṛtvā| chāyāsnapana karmakariṣye iti saṃkalpya| purataḥ dhānyapīṭhe salakṣaṇān ṣoḍaśakumbhān saṃsthāpya| pūrvoktavidhinā, tattad dravyaiḥ āpūrya| paristīrya | devatāvāhanaṃ puṇyāhavācanapūrvakaṃ kṛtvā | sakūrce darpaṇe paṭasthaṃ garuḍaṃ samāvāhya |
analyzed: madhu sarpiṣī ca aṣṭa dhānyāni darśayitvā aṣṭa nāgānām api evam kṛtvā chāyāsnapana karma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya puratas dhānya pīṭhe sa lakṣaṇān ṣoḍaśa kumbhān saṃsthāpya pūrva ukta vidhinā tat tat dravyaiḥ āpūrya paristīrya devatā vāhanam puṇyāha vācana pūrvakam kṛtvā sa kūrce darpaṇe paṭa stham garuḍam samāvāhya

original: arghyādipūjanapurassaraṃ puruṣasūktasya ṣoḍaśa ṛgbhiḥ ghṛtāntaiḥ ṣoḍaśakumbhaiḥ saṃsnāpya | garuḍagāyatryā saṃpūjya| paṭepunaḥ āvāhya śālibhāradvitayena tadardhena taṇḍulena taṇḍulārdhenatilena dhānyapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā | navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ ācchādya | darbhān āstīrya |
analyzed: arghya ādi pūjana purassaram puruṣasūktasya ṣoḍaśa ṛgbhiḥ ghṛta antaiḥ ṣoḍaśa kumbhaiḥ saṃsnāpya garuḍa gāyatryā saṃpūjya paṭe punar āvāhya śāli bhāra dvitayena tad ardhena taṇḍulena taṇḍula ardhena tilena dhānya pīṭham kṛtvā navaiḥ vāsobhiḥ ācchādya darbhān āstīrya

original: navavastra vyāghracarma tūlikāratnakambala kṣauma citravastrāṇi ca gandhadravyaiḥ adhivāsya| darbhaiḥ paristīrya | puṇyāhajalena prokṣya | tasyāṃ śyyāyāṃ śāyayitvā | dvāratoraṇapūjāṃ kṛtvā | tataḥ śāyayitvā | paṭasyadakṣiṇe pārśve dhānyarāśau sakarakaṃ mahākumbhaṃ upakumbhāṣṭakaṃ ca salakṣaṇaṃ saṃsthāpya | gandhodakena āpūrya |
analyzed: nava vastra vyāghra carma tūlikā ratna kambala kṣauma citra vastrāṇi ca gandha dravyaiḥ adhivāsya darbhaiḥ paristīrya puṇyāha jalena prokṣya tasyām śyyāyām śāyayitvā dvāra toraṇa pūjām kṛtvā tatas śāyayitvā paṭasya dakṣiṇe pārśve dhānya rāśau sa karakam mahā kumbham upa kumbha aṣṭakam ca sa lakṣaṇam saṃsthāpya gandha udakena āpūrya

original: sakūrca vastra ratna tattaddevatāṅga pratimā’śvattha pallavāpidhānān tān sarvān kṛtvā | paristīrya | prokṣya|mahākumbhe ādhārādi padmāntaṃ iṣṭvā|tasmin ehi kheśa mahābāho vainateya vayodhipa| sānnidhyaṃ kuru pakṣīndra prasīdātra namostu te| kṣipa oṃ svāhā āgacchāgaccheti garuḍaṃ āvāhya | tadgāyatryā abhyarcya|
analyzed: sa kūrca vastra ratna tad tad devatā aṅga pratimā aśvattha pallava apidhānān tān sarvān kṛtvā paristīrya prokṣya mahākumbhe ādhāra ādi padma antam iṣṭvā tasmin ehi kheśa mahā bāho vainateya vayodhipa sānnidhyam kuru pakṣi indra prasīda atra namaḥ astu te kṣipa om svāhā āgaccha āgaccha iti garuḍam āvāhya tad gāyatryā abhyarcya

original: karake sahasrārahuṃphaṭ āgacchāgaccheti āvāhya | abhyarcya | pūrvādiṣu kalaśeṣu indrādīn ca| paṭasthagaruḍaṃ śoṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃśodhya | tatvāni kramāt saṃhṛtya | punaḥ utpādya| kuṇḍeṣu caturṣu sthaṇḍileṣu vā yadvā ekasmin kuṇḍe mahānase nityāgnikuṇḍe vā adhivāsahomaṃ kuryāt| kuṇḍa catuṣṭayeṣu prācyāṃ kuṇḍe satyaṃ āvāhya |
analyzed: karake sahasrāra huṃ phaṭ āgaccha āgaccha iti āvāhya abhyarcya pūrva ādiṣu kalaśeṣu indra ādīn ca paṭa stha garuḍam śoṣaṇa ādibhiḥ saṃśodhya tattvāni kramāt saṃhṛtya punar utpādya kuṇḍeṣu caturṣu sthaṇḍileṣu vā yat vā ekasmin kuṇḍe mahānase nitya agnikuṇḍe vā adhivāsa homam kuryāt kuṇḍa catuṣṭayeṣu prācyām kuṇḍe satyam āvāhya

original: ‘bṛhatsāma mantreṇa’ dakṣiṇasyāṃdiśi kuṇḍe suparṇaṃ āvāhya|gāruḍa mantreṇa ca | pratīcyāṃkuṇḍe garuḍaṃ āvāhya| ‘rathantarasāmnā’| udīcyāṃ kuṇḍe tārkṣyamāvāhya | garuḍamantreṇa ca | yadvā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu tattaddevatāmantraiḥ vā samidbhiḥ ājyaiśca caruṇā puruṣasūktena ca ekasmin kuṇḍe tu ‘oṃ namo bhagavate vainateyāya namaḥ’ iti āvāhya |
analyzed: bṛhatsāman mantreṇa dakṣiṇasyām diśi kuṇḍe suparṇam āvāhya gāruḍa mantreṇa ca pratīcyām kuṇḍe garuḍam āvāhya rathantara sāmnā udīcyām kuṇḍe tārkṣyam āvāhya garuḍa mantreṇa ca yat vā sarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu tad tad devatā mantraiḥ vā samidbhiḥ ājyaiḥ ca caruṇā puruṣasūktena ca ekasmin kuṇḍe tu om namaḥ bhagavate vainateyāya namaḥ iti āvāhya

original: garuḍamantreṇa ca hutvā |pūrvādiṣu caturṣu kuṇḍeṣu oṃ bhūḥ svāhā,oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā,oṃ suvaḥ svāhā,oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvas svāhā iti mantraiḥ krameṇa madhu payo dadhyājyaiḥ pratyekaṃ śatasaṃkhyayā āhutīḥ hutvā| anyasmin pātre saṃpātaṃ pṛthak pṛthak saṃgṛhya|
analyzed: garuḍa mantreṇa ca hutvā pūrva ādiṣu caturṣu kuṇḍeṣu om bhūḥ svāhā om bhuvaḥ svāhā om suvar svāhā om bhūḥ bhuvaḥ suvar svāhā iti mantraiḥ krameṇa madhu payaḥ dadhi ājyaiḥ pratyekam śata saṃkhyayā āhutīḥ hutvā anyasmin pātre saṃpātam pṛthak pṛthak saṃgṛhya

original: paṭasthasya pāda jaṭhara mūrdhasu hutamantraireva svāhārahitaiḥ krameṇa kūrcena sarvāṃgaṃ ca saṃspṛśya| auttarekuṇḍe viṣṇugāyatryā guḍājyamadhubhiḥ hutvā| saṃpātena mukhaṃ ca saṃspṛśya| homaṃ nirvartya|
analyzed: paṭa sthasya pāda jaṭhara mūrdhasu huta mantraiḥ eva svāhā rahitaiḥ krameṇa kūrcena sarva aṃgam ca saṃspṛśya auttare kuṇḍe viṣṇugāyatryā guḍa ājya madhubhiḥ hutvā saṃpātena mukham ca saṃspṛśya homam nirvartya

original: pālāśakhādirāśvattha bilvaśākhābhiḥ catasṛbhiḥ kramāt abliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ mahādik kalaśāṃbubhiḥkoṇastha kalāśāṃbubhirvā etasyāḥ śākhayā viṣṇugāyatryā ca paṭasthaṃ prokṣya| mandirābhimukhaṃ paṭaṃ vistārya| tasmin yogapīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya| gandhādibhiḥ abhyarcya| svāñjalau yogapīṭhaṃ vicintya| tasmin hṛtpuṇḍarīkasthagaruḍaṃ recakena avatārya| dhyātvā|
analyzed: pālāśa khādira aśvattha bilva śākhābhiḥ catasṛbhiḥ kramāt abliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ mahādiś kalaśa aṃbubhiḥ koṇa stha kalāśa aṃbubhiḥ vā etasyāḥ śākhayā viṣṇugāyatryā ca paṭa stham prokṣya mandira abhimukham paṭam vistārya tasmin yogapīṭham saṃkalpya gandha ādibhiḥ abhyarcya sva añjalau yogapīṭham vicintya tasmin hṛd puṇḍarīka stha garuḍam recakena avatārya dhyātvā

original: tasya gāyatryā paṭasthasya brahmarandreṇa praviṣṭaṃ vicintya| brahmarandraṃ praṇavena pidhāya| mudrayā sannirudhya| dhyātvā| sannidhiṃ prārthayet| mahābalamahābāho vainateya vayodhipa| sannidhatsva paṭe tubhyaṃ namaḥ praṇavamūrtaye| karmaṇāṃ siddhimāhūtaḥ kuruṣva vihageśvara| āhūtavyāḥ trayolokāḥ devasyotsavasaṃpadi| iti garuḍaṃ prārthya |
analyzed: tasya gāyatryā paṭa sthasya brahmarandreṇa praviṣṭam vicintya brahmarandram praṇavena pidhāya mudrayā sannirudhya dhyātvā sannidhim prārthayet mahā bala mahā bāho vainateya vayodhipa sannidhatsva paṭe tubhyam namaḥ praṇava mūrtaye karmaṇām siddhim āhūtaḥ kuruṣva vihaga īśvaraḥ āhūtavyāḥ trayaḥ lokāḥ devasya utsava saṃpadi iti garuḍam prārthya

original: arghyādibhiḥ upacāraiḥ tadgāyatryā upacarya| caturvidhaṃ annaṃ nivedya| mahākumbhāya ca tathā kṛtvā| tadanu oṃ vāhanāya mahāviṣṇoḥ tārkṣyayāmita tejase| garuḍāya namastubhyaṃ sarvasarpendramṛtyave| namo namaste pakṣīndra svādhyāyavapuṣe namaḥ| vihagendra namastestu samutpāṭitakalpaka| āhṛtāmṛtakumbhāya jananedāsyamocine|
analyzed: arghya ādibhiḥ upacāraiḥ tad gāyatryā upacarya caturvidham annam nivedya mahākumbhāya ca tathā kṛtvā tadanu om vāhanāya mahāviṣṇoḥ tārkṣyayā amita tejase garuḍāya namaḥ tubhyam sarva sarpa indra mṛtyave namaḥ namaḥ te pakṣi indra svādhyāya vapuṣe namaḥ vihaga indra namaḥ te tu samutpāṭita kalpakaḥ āhṛta amṛta kumbhāya jananedāsya mocine

original: surāsurendrajayine nāgendrābharaṇāya te| yadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ tadādhārāya te namaḥ| pakṣau yasya bṛhatsāmarathantaramapi dvayam| akṣiṇī cāpi gāyatrī trivṛtsāmaśiraḥ smṛtam| stoma ātmā namastasmai vāmadevyāṃgasaṃpade| namaḥ prāṇādi vāyūnāṃ īśānāya garutmate| doṣān apanaya akhaṇḍān guṇān āvahasarvataḥ| vighnāni jahi sarvāṇi ātmasāt kuru māmapi|
analyzed: sura asura indra jayine nāga indra ābharaṇāya te yad ādhāram idam sarvam tad ādhārāya te namaḥ pakṣau yasya bṛhat sāma rathantaram api dvayam akṣiṇī ca api gāyatrī trivṛt sāma śiraḥ smṛtam stomaḥ ātmā namaḥ tasmai vāmadevya aṃga saṃpade namaḥ prāṇa ādi vāyūnām īśānāya garutmate doṣān apanaya akhaṇḍān guṇān āvaha sarvatas vighnāni jahi sarvāṇi ātmasāt kuru mām api

original: evaṃ stutvā| gāruḍamantraṃ yathāśakti japitvā| vedaghoṣaiḥ tūryaghoṣaiḥ niśāṃ jāgareṇa nītvā| tataḥ prabhāte guruḥ nityakarma samāpya| garbhagehaṃ praviśya| mūlaberaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| tasmāt utsavabiṃbe samāvāhya| udvāsanarahitaiḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ ārādhya|
analyzed: evam stutvā gāruḍa mantram yathāśakti japitvā veda ghoṣaiḥ tūrya ghoṣaiḥ niśām jāgareṇa nītvā tatas prabhāte guruḥ nityakarma samāpya garbha geham praviśya mūlaberam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya tasmāt utsava biṃbe samāvāhya udvāsana rahitaiḥ ṣoḍaśa upacāraiḥ ārādhya

original: taṃ paṭasthaṃ garuḍaṃ ca mālyādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya|hastipṛṣṭhe rathe, śibikādau vā yātrābimbaṃ ca pṛthak yāne ca samāropya|bherī mṛdaṅga paṭaha śaṃkha kāhala nṛtta geyasahitaṃ śirobhiḥ sāṅkura pālikāśatadhārakaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ ca grāmadhāmnoḥ prādakṣiṇyena dhvajastambhasamīpaṃ nītvā|
analyzed: tam paṭa stham garuḍam ca mālya ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya hasti pṛṣṭhe rathe śibikā ādau vā yātrā bimbam ca pṛthak yāne ca samāropya bherī mṛdaṅga paṭaha śaṃkha kāhala nṛtta geya sahitam śirobhiḥ sa aṅkura pālikā śata dhārakaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ ca grāma dhāmnoḥ prādakṣiṇyena dhvaja stambha samīpam nītvā

original: dhvajastaṃbhastu antassāraḥ bahissāraḥ nissāraśceti dāruḥ trividhaḥ|campaka, devadāru, candana, khadira, sāla, bilva, kakubha, āmalakādayaḥantassārāḥ| kramuka nālikera tāla, hintāla, veṇvādayaḥ bahissārāḥ| nissāraṃ varjayitvā| antassāraṃ bahissāraṃ vā mānena śatatalāyataṃ śubhaṃ|
analyzed: dhvaja staṃbhaḥ tu antar sāraḥ bahis sāraḥ nissāraḥ ca iti dāruḥ trividhaḥ campaka devadāru candana khadira sāla bilva kakubha āmalaka ādayaḥ antar sārāḥ kramuka nālikera tāla hintāla veṇu ādayaḥ bahis sārāḥ nissāram varjayitvā antar sāram bahis sāram vā mānena śata tala āyatam śubham

original: aśītitālamānaṃ vā prāsāda ucchrāyamānaṃ,yadvā gopuramānaṃ vā stambhaṃ samānīya| caturdhā vibhajya| agraikāṃśenamaskaraṃ tadādhāra bhūtāni dvitālāyatāni tadardhena vistīrṇāni, tadardhenaghanāni, pīṭhatritayāt mūle sthūlāni, agre sūkṣmāṇi mūlatacchidritāni kṛtvā| stambhāgre tāni viniveśya|
analyzed: aśīti tāla mānam vā prāsāde ucchrāyamānam yat vā gopura mānam vā stambham samānīya caturdhā vibhajya agra eka aṃśena maskaram tat ādhāra bhūtāni dvi tāla āyatāni tad ardhena vistīrṇāni tad ardhena ghanāni pīṭha tritayāt mūle sthūlāni agre sūkṣmāṇi mūla tat chidritāni kṛtvā stambha agre tāni viniveśya

original: agrapīṭhadvaye chidrite tatra dhvajayaṣṭimaskaraṃ evaṃ stambhe viniveśya| dhvajayaṣṭyāṃ ekaṃ veṇukaṃ vā nava sapta pañcaveṇukān vā niveśya| itthaṃ bhūtaṃ dhvajastambhaṃ pīṭhasya uttarepārśve viniveśya| ācāryaḥ vedavidvipraiḥ saha ‘abliṅgarmantraiḥ prakṣālya|kuśaiḥ darbhai ūrdhvamukhaiḥ pracchādya| darbhamālābhiḥ saṃveṣṭya|
analyzed: agra pīṭha dvaye chidrite tatra dhvaja yaṣṭi maskaram evam stambhe viniveśya dhvaja yaṣṭyām ekam veṇukam vā nava sapta pañca veṇukān vā niveśya ittham bhūtam dhvaja stambham pīṭhasya uttara pārśve viniveśya ācāryaḥ veda vid vipraiḥ saha prakṣālya kuśaiḥ darbhaiḥ ūrdhva mukhaiḥ pracchādya darbha mālābhiḥ saṃveṣṭya

original: śodhite staṃbhāvaṭe lohabījādīni vinyasya| tatra āvaṭe dhvajastaṃbhaṃ ‘viṣṇusūktena’ dhṛḍhaṃ yathā bhavet| tathā prāsādābhimukhaṃ sthāpayitvā| staṃbhamūlasthale saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ tribhiḥ vā hastaiḥ āyatāṃ tāvadvistīrṇāṃ ekahastasamucchritāṃ caturaśrāṃ vedikāṃ kārayitvā| tāṃ tredhā vibhajya|
analyzed: śodhite staṃbha avaṭe loha bīja ādīni vinyasya tatra āvaṭe dhvaja staṃbham viṣṇusūktena dhṛḍham yathā bhavet tathā prāsāda abhimukham sthāpayitvā staṃbha mūla sthale saptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ tribhiḥ vā hastaiḥ āyatām tāvat vistīrṇām eka hasta samucchritām caturaśrām vedikām kārayitvā tām tredhā vibhajya

original: ekāṃśe madhye catuṣṭaya aṅgulotsedha mekhalātrayayutaṃ pīṭhaṃ,tasyāpi tṛtīyebhāge karṇikāmadhye yathārambhaviniveśanaṃ bhavet tathā padmaṃ kṛtvā| pīṭhasya paritaḥ ṣoḍaśastambhayutāṃ tiraskariṇīṃ citradarbhamālā dīpapuṣpamālāvitānādyalaṅkṛtāṃ caturdvārayutāṃ prapāṃ kārayitvā| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya| stambhadakṣiṇe dhānyapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: eka aṃśe madhye tṛtīye bhāge karṇikā madhye yathā ārambha viniveśanam bhavet tathā padmam kṛtvā pīṭhasya paritas ṣoḍaśa stambha yutām tiraskariṇīm citra darbha mālāḥ dīpa puṣpa mālā vitāna ādi alaṅkṛtām catur dvāra yutām prapām kārayitvā puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya stambha dakṣiṇe dhānya pīṭham kṛtvā

original: tasmin salakṣaṇaṃ kumbhanavakaṃ vinyasya|madhye garuḍaṃ paritaḥ aṣṭadikṣu indrādīn āvāhya abhyarcya| tattanmantreṇa stambhaṃ yathākramaṃ prokṣya| tadveṇvagra vivare tantubhiḥ triguṇīkṛtena aṅguṣṭānāhena pāśena dhvajapaṭaṃ puruṣamantreṇa saṃyojya| vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā dhvajaṃ āropayet| yadvā baddhadhvajāgraṃ stambhaṃ vā sthāpayet|
analyzed: tasmin sa lakṣaṇam kumbha navakam vinyasya madhye garuḍam paritas aṣṭa dikṣu indra ādīn āvāhya abhyarcya tad tad mantreṇa stambham yathākramam prokṣya tad veṇu agra vivare tantubhiḥ triguṇīkṛtena aṅguṣṭa ānāhena pāśena dhvaja paṭam puruṣa mantreṇa saṃyojya vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā dhvajam āropayet yat vā baddha dhvaja agram stambham vā sthāpayet

original: tadanu guruḥ śobhane muhūrte paṭasthaṃ garuḍaṃ prāsādābhimukhaṃ saṃsthāpya| sarvataḥ dikṣu vedatūryaghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu svayaṃ garuḍamālāmantrādi japan garuḍaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| mahākumbhajalena tadgāyatryā kūrcena saṃprokṣya| gāruḍamantreṇa kumbhān paṭasthaṃ anucintya| prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ yathāvidhi kṛtvā| tanmūlamantraṃ vinyasya|
analyzed: tadanu guruḥ śobhane muhūrte paṭa stham garuḍam prāsāda abhimukham saṃsthāpya sarvatas dikṣu veda tūrya ghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu svayam garuḍa mālā mantra ādi japan garuḍam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya mahā kumbha jalena tad gāyatryā kūrcena saṃprokṣya gāruḍa mantreṇa kumbhān paṭa stham anucintya prāṇa pratiṣṭhām yathāvidhi kṛtvā tad mūlamantram vinyasya

original: tadgāyatryā tanmudrāṃ pradarśya| arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| aṣṭāsu dikṣu indrādīn ca āvāhya| gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ abhyarcya| pṛthuka, nālikera, apūpa, mudgānnādīni paṭasthasya nivedya| vedaghoṣaiḥ saha’suparṇosi iti mantreṇa dhvajaṃ āropya| yāvadavabhṛtaṃ dhvajodare garuḍasya sthitiṃ vakṣyamāṇa gāthayā prārthayet|
analyzed: tad gāyatryā tad mudrām pradarśya arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya aṣṭāsu dikṣu indra ādīn ca āvāhya gandha puṣpa ādibhiḥ abhyarcya pṛthuka nālikera apūpa mudga anna ādīni paṭa sthasya nivedya veda ghoṣaiḥ saha suparṇaḥ asi iti mantreṇa dhvajam āropya yāvat avabhṛtam dhvaja udare garuḍasya sthitim vakṣyamāṇa gāthayā prārthayet

original: pakṣīndrapakṣavikṣepa taraṅgānilasaṃpadā| nirastāsurasannāha samare śatrusūdane| sannidhatsvapaṭe yāvat utsavāvabhṛtakṣaṇam| iti prārthya| utsavapratimāṃ dhvajastambhasamīpaṃ ānīya| khagaṃ darśayitvā|samastadevatāhvānārthaṃ garuḍaṃ niyujya| utsavabimbasannidhau eva puṣpāñjaliṃ samādāya| asmaddinātsamārabhya yāvattīrtha dināntimam|
analyzed: pakṣi indra pakṣa vikṣepa taraṅga anila saṃpadā samare śatru sūdane sannidhatsva paṭe yāvat utsava avabhṛta kṣaṇam iti prārthya utsava pratimām dhvaja stambha samīpam ānīya khagam darśayitvā a samasta devatā āhvāna artham garuḍam niyujya utsava bimba sannidhau eva puṣpa añjalim samādāya asmad dināt samārabhya yāvat tīrtha dina antimam

original: sannidhiṃ kuru pakṣīndra rājñojanapadasya ca| grāmasya yajamānasya vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ| tuṣṭaye puṣṭaye caiva sarvaśatru kṣayāya ca| apamṛtyu jayārthāya vainateya prasīda oṃ| iti gāthāṃ udīrayan| garuḍopari puṣpāñjaliṃ vitīrya| tadanu bhagavantaṃ vijñāpayet| jñānato’jñānatovāpi yathoktaṃ na kṛtaṃ mayā|
analyzed: sannidhim kuru pakṣi indra rājñaḥ janapadasya ca grāmasya yajamānasya vaiṣṇavānām viśeṣataḥ tuṣṭaye puṣṭaye ca eva sarva śatru kṣayāya ca apamṛtyu jaya arthāya vainateya prasīda om iti gāthām udīrayan garuḍa upari puṣpa añjalim vitīrya tadanu bhagavantam vijñāpayet jñānataḥ jñānataḥ vā api yathoktam na kṛtam mayā

original: tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu sutṛptobhava sarvadā| omacyuta jagannātha mantramūrte janārdana| rakṣa māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa kṣamasvāja prasīda oṃ| iti vijñāpya| bhagavantaṃ maṇḍapāntaraṃ nītvā| yathāvidhi saṃpūjayet| dhvajasamīpe naktadivaṃ anirvāṇaṃ dīpaṃ āropya| dhvajārohaṇā’varohaṇāntaṃ pratidinaṃ garuḍaṃ sampūjayet| atha bherītāḍanam|
analyzed: tat sarvam pūrṇam eva astu su tṛptaḥ bhava sarvadā om acyuta jagannātha mantra mūrte janārdana rakṣa mām puṇḍarīkākṣa kṣamasva āja prasīda om iti vijñāpya bhagavantam maṇḍapa antaram nītvā yathāvidhi saṃpūjayet dhvaja samīpe nakta divam anirvāṇam dīpam āropya dhvaja ārohaṇa avarohaṇa antam pratidinam garuḍam sampūjayet atha bherī tāḍanam

original: atha bherītāḍana vidhiḥ ucyate|ācāryaḥ tadrātrau devaṃ prāṇāyāmāntaryāga purassaraṃ pūjayitvā|nivedya|homaṃ ca kṛtvā| dhvajapīṭhasya purataḥ kṣitiṃ gomayavāriṇā caturaśrāṃ ālipya| sudhācūrṇaiḥ alaṅkṛtya| droṇapañcaka śālinā dhānyena pīṭhaṃ caturaśraṃ vidhāya| tatra kālacakraṃ likhitvā|
analyzed: atha bherī tāḍana vidhiḥ ucyate ācāryaḥ tad rātrau devam prāṇāyāma antaryāga purassaram pūjayitvā anivedya homam ca kṛtvā dhvaja pīṭhasya puratas kṣitim gomaya vāriṇā caturaśrām ālipya sudhā cūrṇaiḥ alaṅkṛtya droṇapañcaka śālinā dhānyena pīṭham caturaśram vidhāya tatra kālacakram likhitvā

original: tanmadhye mūlaberāt āvāhitaśaktiṃ balibimbaṃ dhvajasaṃmukhaṃ niveśya pūjayitvā| tasya purataḥ ālipte bhūtale dhānyapīṭhake navavāsasā veṣṭitaṃ mahābherīṃ saṃsthāpya| tasyāḥ dakṣiṇe koṇaṃ ca nidhāya|
analyzed: tad madhye mūlaberāt āvāhita śaktim bali bimbam dhvaja saṃmukham niveśya pūjayitvā tasya puratas ālipte bhū tale dhānya pīṭhake nava vāsasā veṣṭitam mahā bherīm saṃsthāpya tasyāḥ dakṣiṇe koṇam ca nidhāya

original: bheryāḥ pūrvabhāge śaṅkhanikaraṃ,vahnau kāhalasañcayaṃ,yāmye maddhala,naiṛte mukhatantrī vaṃśāni, vāruṇe uḍuka mṛdaṅga hrasvasaṃmardani, vāyavye karaṭīṃ kāṃsyatālaṃ ca, saumye paṭaha hrasvapaṭahau, aiśānyāṃ ḍuḍḍukān, vallī,hastaghaṇṭān ca,eteṣāṃ alābhe saṃbhavānuguṇaṃ saṃsthāpya|

original: tataḥ prabhāte sumuhūrte guruḥ ‘uttiṣṭha’ iti mantreṇa devaṃ utthāpya| saṃpūjya| imāṃ gāthāṃ vijñāpayet| prasīdadevadeveśa utsavaḥ kriyate mayā| asmātkālālavādyāvat puṣpayāgadinātimam| tvatprītaye jagannātha yadyatkarma karomyaham| tatsarvamātmasātkṛtvā kṛpayā me prasīda oṃ| iti vijñāpya|
analyzed: tatas prabhāte su muhūrte guruḥ uttiṣṭha iti mantreṇa devam utthāpya saṃpūjya imām gāthām vijñāpayet prasīda devadeveśaḥ utsavaḥ kriyate mayā asmāt kāla alavāt yāvat puṣpa yāga dina atimam tvad prītaye jagannātha yat yat karma karomi aham tat sarvam ātmasātkṛtvā kṛpayā me prasīda om iti vijñāpya

original: dikṣubrāhmaṇeṣu śākunasūktaṃ paṭhatsu devaṃ’‘ idaṃ viṣṇuḥ” iti mantreṇa śibikādikaṃ yānaṃ āropya| yānaṃ vahatsu bhūsureṣugaruḍaṃ āvāhya| sarvālaṅkāra sarvopacāra sahitaṃ devaṃ sarvāvaraṇabhūmikāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā| yānāt avaropya| maṇḍape sauvarṇaṃ bhadrāsane viniveśya|
analyzed: dikṣu brāhmaṇeṣu śākuna sūktam paṭhatsu devam idam viṣṇuḥ iti mantreṇa śibikā ādikam yānam āropya yānam vahatsu bhūsura iṣu garuḍam āvāhya sarva alaṅkāra sarva upacāra sahitam devam sarva āvaraṇa bhūmikāḥ pradakṣiṇam nītvā yānāt avaropya maṇḍape sauvarṇam bhadrāsane viniveśya

original: sarvamutsavārthaṃ āhṛtaṃ prābhṛtadravyaṃ janasaṃsadi ‘‘itoyātaṃ idaṃ sarvaṃ itoyātaṃ” iti darśayitvā|mantrāsanapurassaraṃ pūrvoditakramāt snapanakarmakṛtvā| ācāryaḥ yajamānaśca vibhavodayaṃ samīkṣya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya|yathāvidhi hutvā devaṃ mandirāntarbhuvaṃ nītvā| tataḥ aparāhneprāpte garuḍena viṣvaksenena vā sākaṃ bahiḥ nirgatya|
analyzed: sarvam utsava artham āhṛtam prābhṛta dravyam jana saṃsadi itas yātam idam sarvam itas yātam iti darśayitvā āmantra āsana purassaram pūrva udita kramāt snapana karma kṛtvā ācāryaḥ yajamānaḥ ca vibhava udayam samīkṣya mahāhaviḥ nivedya yathāvidhi hutvā devam mandira antar bhuvam nītvā tatas aparāhne prāpte garuḍena viṣvaksenena vā sākam bahis nirgatya

original: yathāvidhi pūrvavat mṛtsaṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā| yāgamaṇḍapaṃ praviśya| trivargeṣupālikādipātreṣu utsavāṅkurārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā| sudarśana, snapana, nityotsava, balibimbānāṃ kalyāṇakautukasya iva kautukabandhanādhivāsa snapana karmaṇi pṛthak kṛtvā| yāgamaṇḍapaṃ praveśya tatrāsane viniveśya| tataḥ guruḥyajamānena sadanaṃ praviśya| devaṃ daṇḍavat praṇamya|
analyzed: yathāvidhi pūrvavat mṛd saṃgrahaṇam kṛtvā yāga maṇḍapam praviśya trivarga iṣupālikā ādi pātreṣu utsava aṅkura arpaṇam kṛtvā sudarśana snapana nitya utsava bali bimbānām kalyāṇa kautukasya iva kautuka bandhana adhivāsa snapana karmaṇi pṛthak kṛtvā yāga maṇḍapam praveśya tatra āsane viniveśya tatas guruḥ yajamānena sadanam praviśya devam daṇḍa vat praṇamya

original: bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa kariṣye kautukakriyām| mahotsavārthaṃ deveśa tadarthaṃ tvaṃ prasīda me| iti vijñāpya| mūlotsava snāna balibimba cakrāṇāṃ yathāvidhi utsavapratisaraṃ badhvā| tadanu vedikāyāṃ śālīnāṃ pañcabhāreṇa tadardhena tilena ca dhānyapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa kariṣye kautuka kriyām mahā utsava artham deveśa tad artham tvam prasīda me iti vijñāpya mūla utsava snāna bali bimba cakrāṇām yathāvidhi utsava pratisaram badhvā tadanu vedikāyām śālīnām pañca bhāreṇa tad ardhena tilena ca dhānya pīṭham kṛtvā

original: antarāntarayogena vastraiḥ ācchādya|tatra prakṣālitān sasūtrān sagandhodakān nyasta navaratnān saugandhika rajoyutān sakarakān pratyekaṃ nyastaniṣphamātrasuvarṇān sāśvatthapallava kūrcāpidhānān navakumbhān, madhyamaṃ vastrayugmena śiṣṭān ekena vāsasā saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vā hastaiḥāyatena tadardhena vistṛtena ācchādya|
analyzed: antara antara yogena vastraiḥ ācchādya tatra prakṣālitān sa sūtrān sa gandha udakān nyasta nava ratnān saugandhika rajaḥ yutān sa karakān pratyekam nyasta niṣpha mātra suvarṇān sa aśvattha pallava kūrca apidhānān nava kumbhān madhyamam vastra yugmena śiṣṭān ekena vāsasā saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pañcabhiḥ vā hastaiḥ āyatena tad ardhena vistṛtena ācchādya

original: vedikābhūmau dhānyarāśiṣu saṃsthāpya| vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| prokṣya| dvāratoraṇa dhvajakumbhān abhyarcya karake sudarśanam ca pūrvādyāśāgateṣu kumbheṣu vāsudevādīn āgneyādikoṇagateṣu pūrvavat puruṣādīn ca āvāhya| abhyarcya| sudarśana balibimbayośca aṣṭamaṅgalāni pṛthak vāsobhiḥ āveṣṭya| vedeḥ adhastāt dhānyarāśiṣu vinyasya abhyarcya|
analyzed: vedikā bhūmau dhānya rāśiṣu saṃsthāpya vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya dvāra toraṇa dhvaja kumbhān abhyarcya karake sudarśanam ca pūrva ādi āśā gateṣu kumbheṣu vāsudeva ādīn āgneya ādi koṇa gateṣu pūrvavat puruṣa ādīn ca āvāhya abhyarcya sudarśana bali bimbayoḥ ca aṣṭamaṅgalāni pṛthak vāsobhiḥ āveṣṭya vedeḥ adhastāt dhānya rāśiṣu vinyasya abhyarcya

original: vedikāyāṃ yathāvidhi pūrvoktavartmanā cakrābjaṃ vartayitvā| tasmin sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ vāsudevaṃ yathāvidhi pūrvavat abhyarcya| saṃpūjya|
analyzed: vedikāyām yathāvidhi pūrva ukta vartmanā cakra abjam vartayitvā tasmin sa aṃgam sa parivāram vāsudevam yathāvidhi pūrvavat abhyarcya saṃpūjya

original: catasṛṣudikṣu vedaghoṣe ca pravṛtte guruḥ āhavanīyāgnau vāsudevaṃ dakṣiṇāgnau saṃkarṣaṇaṃ, gārhapatye pradyumnaṃ,sadbhyāgnau aniruddhaṃ, āvasakthye mūlarmūīṃta ca tattatkuṇḍāgni madhyagata bhadrāsanapadmeṣu āvāhya|abhyarcya| tīrthāvasānikaṃ sannidhiṃ prārthya|
analyzed: catasṛṣu dikṣu veda ghoṣe ca pravṛtte guruḥ āhavanīya agnau vāsudevam dakṣiṇāgnau saṃkarṣaṇam gārhapatye pradyumnam sadbhyāgnau aniruddham ca tad tad kuṇḍa agni madhya gata bhadrāsana padmeṣu āvāhya abhyarcya tīrtha āvasānikam sannidhim prārthya

original: kuṇḍeṣu ghṛta prasūna dhūpadravya samitpayodadhi tilavrīhi yavaiḥ tattaddevatāmantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśataṃ āhutīnāṃ aṣṭāviṃśatiṃ vā hutvā| āhavanīyādyanukrameṇa pāyasa,kṛsara,guḍa , haridrānna,mudgānnaiḥ puruṣasūktasya ṣoḍaśa ṛgbhiḥ pratyekaṃ hutvā|
analyzed: kuṇḍeṣu ghṛta prasūna dhūpa dravya samidh payaḥ dadhi tila vrīhi yavaiḥ tad tad devatā mantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām aṣṭāviṃśatim vā hutvā āhavanīya ādi anukrameṇa pāyasa kṛsara guḍa haridrā anna mudga annaiḥ puruṣasūktasya ṣoḍaśa ṛgbhiḥ pratyekam hutvā

original: pañcamāgnau brahmādidevān uddiśya pāyasena tattannāma caturthyantaṃ svāhāntaṃ uccārya parivārapadānvitaṃ vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā hunet | oṃ brahmaṇe saparivārāya svāhā| oṃ prajāpataye saparivārāya svāhā| oṃ rudrāya saparivārāya svāhā| oṃ sarvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ chandobhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|
analyzed: pañcama agnau brahma ādi devān uddiśya pāyasena tad tad nām caturthī antam svāhā antam uccārya parivāra pada anvitam vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā hunet om brahmaṇe sa parivārāya svāhā om prajāpataye sa parivārāya svāhā om rudrāya sa parivārāya svāhā om sarvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om chandobhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā

original: oṃ vedebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|oṃ ṛṣibhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|oṃ gandharvebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|oṃ sarīsṛpebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ yakṣebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|oṃ apsarebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ māsādibhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ ṛtubhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ ayanebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|
analyzed: om vedebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om ṛṣibhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om gandharvebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om sarīsṛpebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om yakṣebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om apsarebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om māsa ādibhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om ṛtubhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om ayanebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā

original: oṃ vatsarebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ sarvebhyo devībhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ dvīpebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ samudrebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ parvatebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ āpagābhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ bhūtebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ paśubhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|
analyzed: om vatsarebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om sarvebhyaḥ devībhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om dvīpebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om samudrebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om parvatebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om āpagābhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om bhūtebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om paśubhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om vṛkṣebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā

original: oṃ oṣadībhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ vanaspatībhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ udbhījebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|oṃ svedajebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ aṇḍajebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ jarāyujebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| oṃ bhūrādi saptalokebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā|
analyzed: om oṣadībhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om vanaspatībhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om udbhījebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om sveda jebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om aṇḍa jebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om jarāyu jebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om bhūḥ ādi sapta lokebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā

original: oṃ atalādi saptapātālebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥsvāhā|oṃ caṇḍādi dvārapālebhyaḥ saparivārebhyaḥ svāhā| iti hutvā| prāyaścittārthaṃ pañcopaniṣanmantraiḥ vyāhṛtibhiśca,pūrṇāhutiṃ ‘idaṃ viṣṇuriti hunet|evaṃ taddinavihita balidravyaiḥ upariṣṭhāt tatra tatra tattaddevatodvāsanarahitaṃ pratyahaṃ yāvattīrthadināvadhi sāyaṃ prātaḥ hunet|
analyzed: om sapta pātālebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā om caṇḍa ādi dvārapālebhyaḥ sa parivārebhyaḥ svāhā iti hutvā prāyaścitta artham pañca upaniṣad mantraiḥ vyāhṛtibhiḥ ca pūrṇāhutim idam viṣṇuḥ iti hunet evam tad dina vihita bali dravyaiḥ upariṣṭhāt tatra tatra tad tad devatā udvāsana rahitam pratyaham yāvat tīrtha dina avadhi sāyam prātar hunet

original: ekāgnau vā homadravyaṃ traye catuṣṭaye vā agnau hunet| tāvatā ca agniṃ samyak rakṣet| balidānaṃ tu prathamaṃ yāgamaṇṭape kartavyam| tatprakārastu cakra balibimbā’nnamūrti sahitaṃ yāgamaṇḍapāt niṣkramya| taddvāreṣu purataḥ kumudādīnāṃ śucau bhūmau āvāhya abhyarcya| baliṃ datvā|
analyzed: eka agnau vā homa dravyam traye catuṣṭaye vā agnau hunet tāvatā ca agnim samyak rakṣet bali dānam tu prathamam yāgamaṇṭape kartavyam tad prakāraḥ tu cakra bali bimba anna mūrti sahitam yāga maṇḍapāt niṣkramya tad dvāreṣu puratas kumuda ādīnām śucau bhūmau āvāhya abhyarcya balim da tvā

original: balidravyapātra ghaṇṭā puṣpabājana toya karaka dhūpa dīpapātra dīpikādhārakeṣu agre gacchatsu tadanu annamūrtiḥ, tataḥ cakraṃ, tadanu nityotsavārcāṃ ca ityevaṃ kṛtvā| vitānachatrādi samanvitaṃ dvāreṣu caṇḍādīnāṃ āvaraṇeṣu tattaddevatānāṃ toyapūrvottaraṃ baliṃ nikṣipya| balimudrāṃ maṅgalāṣṭakaṃ ca darśayitvā|
analyzed: bali dravya pātra ghaṇṭā puṣpa bājana toya karaka dhūpa dīpa pātra dīpikā dhārakeṣu agre gacchatsu tadanu annamūrtiḥ tatas cakram tadanu nitya utsava arcām ca iti evam kṛtvā vitāna chatra ādi samanvitam dvāreṣu caṇḍa ādīnām āvaraṇeṣu tad tad devatānām toya pūrva uttaram balim nikṣipya bali mudrām maṅgala aṣṭakam ca darśayitvā

original: grāmamadhyamārabhya brahmadīśānaparyantaṃ kramāt tattaddeśeṣu tauryatrikasahitaṃ tattaddevatāḥ abhyarcya baliṃ datvā| mahābalipīṭhe tu aśeṣataḥ avaśiṣṭaṃ balidravyaṃ sarvān pārṣadān uddiśya baliṃ datvā| baliṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ālayaṃ praviśet| evaṃ dhvajārohaṇāditīrthāntaṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ baliṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: grāma madhyam ārabhya kramāt tad tad deśeṣu tauryatrika sahitam tad tad devatāḥ abhyarcya balim da tvā mahābali pīṭhe tu aśeṣatas avaśiṣṭam bali dravyam sarvān pārṣadān uddiśya balim da tvā balim pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ālayam praviśet evam dhvaja ārohaṇa ādi tīrtha antam sāyam prātar balim dadyāt

original: āraṃbhadivase rātrau samāptidivase ahani balimekamekāṃ madhyadivaseṣu ahni rātrau ca balidvayaṃ kuryat| tīrthadivase grahaṇāyana viṣuvādiṣu prāpteṣu tasmin balidvayaṃ kuryāt| grāmādi rahite sthānamadhye mahāpīṭhasya purataḥ brahmaṇe baliṃ vitaret| balidravyāṇi tu prathamehani phalalarajanīcūrṇa karaṃbha lājān caruṇā samyojya|
analyzed: āraṃbha divase rātrau samāpti divase ahani balim ekam ekām madhya divaseṣu ahni rātrau ca bali dvayam kuryat tīrtha divase grahaṇa ayana viṣuva ādiṣu prāpteṣu tasmin bali dvayam kuryāt grāma ādi rahite sthāna madhye mahā pīṭhasya puratas brahmaṇe balim vitaret bali dravyāṇi tu prathama ahani phalala rajanī cūrṇa karaṃbha lājān caruṇā samyojya

original: dvitīye ahani caruṇā tilataṇḍulena saṃyojya| tṛtīye tu lāja dhānyāpūpikāḥ caruṇā saṃyojya| caturthe caruṇā saktuśālipiṣṭa nālikera jalāni saṃyojya| pañcame padmabīja pāyasa śālitaṇḍulaṃ caruṇā saṃyojya| ṣaṣṭe tu apūpaṃ caruṇā saṃyojya| saptamādiṣu triṣu divaseṣu caturvidhamannaṃ apūpaiḥ saktubhiḥ saṃyojya| kramāt baliṃ dadyāt|
analyzed: dvitīye ahani caruṇā tila taṇḍulena saṃyojya tṛtīye tu lāja dhānyāpūpikāḥ caruṇā saṃyojya caturthe caruṇā saktuśāli piṣṭa nālikera jalāni saṃyojya pañcame padma bīja pāyasa śāli taṇḍulam caruṇā saṃyojya ṣaṣṭe tu apūpam caruṇā saṃyojya saptama ādiṣu triṣu divaseṣu caturvidham annam apūpaiḥ saktubhiḥ saṃyojya kramāt balim dadyāt

original: tadanu sumuhūrte prāpte guruḥ śayanasthaṃ utsavakautukaṃ ‘uttiṣṭhe’ti mantreṇa utthāpya|svastisūktaṃ paṭhadbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saptabhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tasmātmandirāt nirgamya| rathantarasāma uccārya| syandanena gajena vā anyena vā yānena maṇḍapāntaraṃ nītvā| ‘bhadraṃ karṇe’ti taddinavihitaṃ yānamāropya| tatra devam nyāsapūrvakaṃ abhyarcya|
analyzed: tadanu su muhūrte prāpte guruḥ śayana stham utsava kautukam uttiṣṭha iti mantreṇa utthāpya svasti sūktam paṭhadbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saptabhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tasmāt mandirāt nirgamya rathantara sāma uccārya syandanena gajena vā anyena vā yānena maṇḍapa antaram nītvā bhadram karṇa iti tad dina vihitam yānam āropya tatra devam nyāsa pūrvakam abhyarcya

original: pṛthukādikaṃ nivedya| kṣaumābharaṇamālyādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya|devasya caraṇayoḥ niśācūrṇaṃ nikṣipya| ghṛtādi pariṣiktaiḥ dīpaiḥ sarvataḥ vīthikāśca alaṅkṛtya|
analyzed: pṛthuka ādikam nivedya kṣauma ābharaṇa mālya ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya devasya caraṇayoḥ niśā cūrṇam nikṣipya ghṛta ādi pariṣiktaiḥ dīpaiḥ sarvatas vīthikāḥ ca alaṅkṛtya

original: vālavyajana tālavṛnta barhibarhamuktātapatrāsi dhūpa dīpa dhāribhiḥ svalaṅkṛtaiḥ brāhmaṇaiśca purataḥ yānārūḍhena sāñjalinā dhvajārūḍhena tārkṣyeṇa pṛṣṭhataśca kanakaśibikāṃ ārūḍhena vetrahastena viriñcādīn samutsārayatā praṇamatā viṣvaksenena ca kanakapātre pāduke samāropya|
analyzed: vāla vyajana tālavṛnta barhi barha muktā ātapatra asi dhūpa dīpa dhāribhiḥ su alaṅkṛtaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ ca puratas yāna ārūḍhena sa añjalinā dhvaja ārūḍhena tārkṣyeṇa pṛṣṭhatas ca kanaka śibikām ārūḍhena vetra hastena viriñca ādīn samutsārayatā praṇamatā viṣvaksenena ca kanaka pātre pāduke samāropya

original: purataḥ dhārayadbhiḥ vipraiśca rājacihnai anyaiḥ sakalavedaśāstrāgamajñaiḥ parasparajigīṣubhiḥ vādanipuṇaiḥ vipraiḥ gadyapadya miśrāṇi stotrāni paṭhadbhiḥ vandibhiśca nṛtyatā gāyatāgāṇikyena ca anyaiḥ tattadvidyāviśāradaiśca sākaṃ ānaddha, tata, suṣira, dhanādi caturvidha vādyaghoṣaiḥ ca āvaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ parikramya|
analyzed: puratas dhārayadbhiḥ vipraiḥ ca anyaiḥ sakala veda śāstra āgama jñaiḥ paraspara jigīṣubhiḥ vāda nipuṇaiḥ vipraiḥ gadya padya miśrāṇi stotrāni paṭhadbhiḥ vandibhiḥ ca nṛtyatā gāyatā gāṇikyena ca anyaiḥ tad tad vidyā viśāradaiḥ ca sākam ānaddha tata suṣira dhanādi caturvidha vādya ghoṣaiḥ ca āvaraṇam sarvam parikramya

original: bahiḥ tathā vīthikāśca pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya| praveśasamayepi prākāravalayaṃ prādakṣiṇyena gatvā| maṇḍapālayaṃ antaḥ praveśya| tatra yānāt āsane devaṃ avaropya|
analyzed: bahis tathā vīthikāḥ ca pradakṣiṇam parikramya praveśa samaye api prākāra valayam prādakṣiṇyena gatvā maṇḍapa ālayam antar praveśya tatra yānāt āsane devam avaropya

original: baliberaṃmandire cakraṃ yāgasadane bahisthite balipīṭhe ca annarmūīṃta niveśya|dhruvaberaṃ nityaiḥ dviguṇaiḥ vastubhiḥ arcayet pratyahaṃ devasya vīthikāparyaṭanānantaraṃ yathāvidhi snapanakarma kuryāt| ekabera vidhāne tu mūlabiṃbe, bahubere tu utsavakautukaṃ vā snapanakautukaṃ vā yathāśakti yathāvastu snapanaṃ kuryāt|
analyzed: cakram yāga sadane bahi sthite bali pīṭhe ca niveśya dhruva beram nityaiḥ dviguṇaiḥ vastubhiḥ arcayet pratyaham devasya vīthikā paryaṭana anantaram yathāvidhi snapana karma kuryāt eka bera vidhāne tu mūla biṃbe bahu bere tu utsava kautukam vā snapana kautukam vā yathāśakti yathāvastu snapanam kuryāt

original: maṇḍape siṃhaviṣṭare devaṃ niveśya| dehaśuddhipurassaraṃ arcayitvā| snapanakarmasamāpya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya| maṇḍanālayaṃ āsādya| devaṃ bhūṣaṇādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya| bimbe tatra sthite deśikaḥ yāgamaṇḍapaṃ prāpya| dvāratoraṇa kumbhamahākubha upakumbha maṇḍalārādhanaṃ kṛtvā| yathoditaṃ nivedya| pūrvavat hutvā|
analyzed: maṇḍape siṃha viṣṭare devam niveśya deha śuddhi purassaram arcayitvā snapana karma samāpya mahāhaviḥ nivedya maṇḍana ālayam āsādya devam bhūṣaṇa ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya bimbe tatra sthite deśikaḥ yāga maṇḍapam prāpya dvāra toraṇa kumbha mahākubha upakumbha maṇḍala ārādhanam kṛtvā yathā uditam nivedya pūrvavat hutvā

original: yathāvidhipūrvavat balyarcādi bimbayutaṃ balikarmakṛtvā| tadanu utsavārcāṃ alaṅkṛtya, yānaṃ āropya| pūrvavat sarvālaṅkārasahitaṃ grāmadhāmādi prādakṣiṇyena nītvā| tatra sthāne sthāne samāhṛta tāṃbūla,vīṭikāḥ, pṛthukādīni, bhakṣyāṇi, nālikeraphalāni, pānīyācamanādīni yathāvidhi akhilaṃ naivedyaṃ ca astramantreṇa adbhiḥprokṣya nivedayet|
analyzed: yathāvidhi pūrvavat bali arcā ādi bimba yutam bali karma kṛtvā tadanu utsava arcām alaṅkṛtya yānam āropya pūrvavat sarva alaṅkāra sahitam grāma dhāma ādi prādakṣiṇyena nītvā tatra sthāne sthāne tāṃbūla vīṭikāḥ pṛthuka ādīni bhakṣyāṇi nālikera phalāni pānīya ācamana ādīni yathāvidhi akhilam naivedyam ca astramantreṇa adbhiḥ prokṣya nivedayet

original: pakvaṃ phalaṃ tūṣṇīṃ pradarśayet puṣpābharaṇādikaṃ pathi samāgataṃ sarvamantreṇa prokṣya devāṅge niyojayet| evaṃ grāmaṃ dhāmaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā| dhāmaṃpraveśya| devaṃ yānāt śibikāṃ āropya| maṇḍapaṃ praveśya,tatra pūrvavat sarvopacārasahitaṃ arcayet|
analyzed: pakvam phalam tūṣṇīm pradarśayet puṣpa ābharaṇa ādikam pathi samāgatam sarva mantreṇa prokṣya deva aṅge niyojayet evam grāmam dhāmam ca pradakṣiṇam nītvā dhāmam praveśya devam yānāt śibikām āropya maṇḍapam praveśya tatra pūrvavat sarva upacāra sahitam arcayet

original: evaṃ apūrvābharaṇa,mālāmbara,yānodyānādyaiḥ tīrthadināvadhi pratidinaṃ yathākautūhalaṃ tathā devaṃ toṣayet| grāmādau nityaṃ devasya śrībhūmibhyāṃ saha vinā vā mahotsavaṃ kuryāt| ṣaṣṭe ahani snānabimbasahitaṃ yātrākautukaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ āropya| tasya purataḥ dhānyarāśau kumbhān saṃsthāpya, saṃpūjya|
analyzed: evam apūrva ābharaṇa mālā ambara yāna udyāna ādyaiḥ tīrtha dina avadhi pratidinam yathākautūhalam tathā devam toṣayet grāma ādau nityam devasya śrī bhūmibhyām saha vinā vā mahā utsavam kuryāt ṣaṣṭe ahani snāna bimba sahitam yātrā kautukam bhadrāsanam āropya tasya puratas dhānya rāśau kumbhān saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya

original: devaṃ mantrāsanādi snānāsanāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| kalaśaiḥ saṃsnāpya| vastrādidīpāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya| ekaberaviṣaye mūlabere sarvamevaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu kṣālitaṃ ulūkhalaṃ vastrādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya| taṇḍulapīṭhe saṃsthapya| śrīsūktena lakṣmīṃ dhyāyan mantritaṃ arcitaṃ kṛtvā| mūlamantreṇa musalaṃ prakṣālya| abhimantya|
analyzed: devam mantra āsana ādi snāna āsana antaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya kalaśaiḥ saṃsnāpya vastra ādi dīpa antaiḥ upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya eka bera viṣaye mūlabere sarvam evam kṛtvā tadanu kṣālitam ulūkhalam vastra ādibhiḥ alaṅkṛtya taṇḍula pīṭhe saṃsthapya śrīsūktena lakṣmīm dhyāyan mantritam arcitam kṛtvā mūlamantreṇa musalam prakṣālya abhimantya

original: mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ guruḥ ulūkhale niśācūrṇaṃ nikṣipya| musalaṃ ādāya devadāsīṣu maṅgalaṃ paṭhatsu niśācūrṇaṃ yathāsūkṣmataraṃ bhavettathā musalena kṛtvā| tadādāya| veṣṭitavāsasi kumbhe nikṣipya| sakūrcamallaka vastraṃ kumbhaṃ sthaṇḍilapīṭhe saṃsthāpya| mūlamantreṇa gandhādibhiḥabhyarcya| kumbhaṃ uddhṛtya| taiḥ cūrṇaiḥ śrīsūktena devamabhiṣicya|
analyzed: mūrtipaiḥ sārdham guruḥ ulūkhale niśā cūrṇam nikṣipya musalam ādāya deva dāsīṣu maṅgalam paṭhatsu niśā cūrṇam yathā sūkṣmataram bhavet tathā musalena kṛtvā tat ādāya veṣṭita vāsasi kumbhe nikṣipya sa kūrca mallaka vastram kumbham sthaṇḍila pīṭhe saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa gandha ādibhiḥ abhyarcya kumbham uddhṛtya taiḥ cūrṇaiḥ śrīsūktena devam abhiṣicya

original: mūrtipaiḥ saha guruḥ devaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā| aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya| puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīrya| stotraiḥ stutvā| sarvālaṅkārayutaṃ utsavaṃ kuryāt| saptame divase rathaṃ puṇyāhajalena prokṣya|
analyzed: mūrtipaiḥ saha guruḥ devam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya puṣpa añjalim vikīrya stotraiḥ stutvā sarva alaṅkāra yutam utsavam kuryāt saptame divase ratham puṇyāha jalena prokṣya

original: śikhare brahmāṇaṃ, ayane haṃsaṃ, dvitīyatale anantaṃ, upakaṃṇṭhe vāsudevaṃ,prathamatale takṣakaṃ, mahāpīṭhe garuḍaṃ, madhyapīṭhe indrādīn ca,cakreṣu vāyuṃ, rathe vainateyaṃ ca āvāhya abhyarcya| haviḥ nivedya| indrādikumudādibhyaḥ baliṃ datvā| devaṃ rathaṃ āropya| pūrvavat utsavaṃ kuryāt| tadanu devasya prātaḥ utsavaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: śikhare brahmāṇam ayane haṃsam dvitīya tale anantam upakaṃṇṭhe vāsudevam prathama tale takṣakam mahā pīṭhe garuḍam madhya pīṭhe indra ādīn vāyum rathe vainateyam ca āvāhya abhyarcya haviḥ nivedya indra ādi kumuda ādibhyaḥ balim da tvā devam ratham āropya pūrvavat utsavam kuryāt tadanu devasya prātar utsavam kṛtvā

original: aparāhne devasya jaladroṇyāṃ avagāhanaṃ kuryāt|jaladroṇīṃ kaṭāhaṃ vā sarasi sopānadeśe sauvarṇaṃ dhānyarāśau nidhāya| gandhodakena āpūrya| paritaḥ akṣatāni vikīrya| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| paristīrya, tajjalaṃ śoṣaṇādīni kṛtvā| tatragaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya| jalaṃ abliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ abhimantya| devaṃ prārthayet|
analyzed: aparāhne devasya jala droṇyām avagāhanam kuryāt jala droṇīm kaṭāham vā sarasi sopāna deśe sauvarṇam dhānya rāśau nidhāya gandha udakena āpūrya paritas akṣatāni vikīrya puṇyāham vācayitvā paristīrya tat jalam śoṣaṇa ādīni kṛtvā tatra gaṅgā ādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya jalam abliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ abhimantya devam prārthayet

original: bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala| asminnahani kartavyā jalakrīḍā tvayā vibho| śuddhaye sarvalokānāṃ devānāṃ prītaye vibho| yātrā tadarthaṃ kartavyā madanugrahakāmyayā| iti vijñāpya| devaṃ praṇamya| mantrāsanādisnānāṃtaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| vādyaghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu vāruṇasūktādyabliṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ tatra devaṃ avagāhya|
analyzed: bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇa āgata vatsala asmin ahani kartavyā jala krīḍā tvayā vibho śuddhaye sarva lokānām devānām prītaye vibho yātrā tad artham kartavyā mad anugraha kāmyayā iti vijñāpya devam praṇamya mantra āsana ādi snāna aṃtaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya vādya ghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu vāruṇa sūkta ādi ap liṅgaiḥ mantraiḥ tatra devam avagāhya

original: tadanu yānaṃ āropya anyaṃ maṇṭapaṃ ānīya| tatrāpi devaṃ havirantaṃ abhyarcayet| yadvā aṣṭame ahani vā prātarutsavaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu mṛgayākarma,tadanu jaladroṇyavagāhanaṃ vā kuryāt| tasmin dine devaṃ mṛgayānuguṇāyudhālaṅkāra sannāhaiḥ saha gaje vā kṛtrimāśve vā āropya|
analyzed: tadanu yānam āropya anyam maṇṭapam ānīya tatra api devam haviḥ antam abhyarcayet yat vā aṣṭame ahani vā prātar utsavam kṛtvā tadanu mṛgayā karma tadanu jala droṇī avagāhanam vā kuryāt tasmin dine devam mṛgayā anuguṇa āyudha alaṅkāra sannāhaiḥ saha gaje vā kṛtrima aśve vā āropya

original: devībhyāṃ saha vinā vā hastyādibhiḥ sainyaiḥ saha grāmasīmādīn prādakṣiṇyena nītvā| devaṃ udyānamaṇḍapaṃ prāpayya| tatra madhye sauvarṇaviṣṭare viniveśya| snānapūrvaṃ abhyarcya| anyasmin āsane viniveśya| mahāhaviḥ nivedya|yānaṃ āropya| tadrātrau mandirāntarbhuvaṃ nītvā| tadanu nityotsavaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: devībhyām saha vinā vā hasti ādibhiḥ sainyaiḥ saha grāma sīmā ādīn prādakṣiṇyena nītvā devam udyāna maṇḍapam prāpayya tatra madhye sauvarṇa viṣṭare viniveśya snāna pūrvam abhyarcya anyasmin āsane viniveśya mahāhaviḥ nivedya yānam āropya tad rātrau mandira antar bhuvam nītvā tadanu nitya utsavam kṛtvā

original: apararātribhāge tīrthārthaṃ aṅkurārpaṇaṃ kariṣye, iti saṅkalpya| arāvāpanaṃ yathā vidhi kṛtvā|devaṃ saṃpūjya| imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| tīrthayātrā tvayā deva śvaḥ kartavyā sureśvara| tatra pratisarāraṃbhaṃ tvamanujñātumarhasi| iti vijñāpya| mūlāt tīrthabimbe samāvāhya|
analyzed: apararātri bhāge tīrtha artham aṅkura arpaṇam kariṣye iti saṅkalpya arāvāpanam yathā vidhi kṛtvā devam saṃpūjya imām gāthām udīrayet tīrtha yātrā tvayā deva śvas kartavyā sureśvara tatra pratisara āraṃbham tvam anujñātum arhasi iti vijñāpya mūlāt tīrtha bimbe samāvāhya

original: tīrthabimbe pratisaraṃ tadabhāve nityotsavabimbe tasyāpi abhāve snānārcāyāṃ, tadabhāve ca utsavabimbe vā baddhvā| dhānyarāśau pūrvavat yathāvidhi adhivāsya| tataḥ prātaḥ utsavaṃ kṛtvā| tadanu śāyitaṃ biṃbamutthāpya,snānamaṇḍape snānapīṭhikāyāṃ taṃ niveśya| yāgamaṇḍapa bhūmiṣu sthāpitān kumbhān ādāya| dhāmaprādakṣiṇyena vedaghoṣaiḥ saha nītvā|
analyzed: tīrtha bimbe pratisaram tad abhāve nitya utsava bimbe tasya api abhāve snāna arcāyām tad abhāve ca utsava bimbe vā baddhvā dhānya rāśau pūrvavat yathāvidhi adhivāsya tatas prātar utsavam kṛtvā tadanu śāyitam biṃbam utthāpya snāna maṇḍape snāna pīṭhikāyām tam niveśya yāga maṇḍapa bhūmiṣu sthāpitān kumbhān ādāya dhāma prādakṣiṇyena veda ghoṣaiḥ saha nītvā

original: tīrthabimbasya sannidhau dhānyarāśau saṃsthāpya| devaṃ mantrāsanapūrvakaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya| tadanu sumuhūrte guruḥ sthāpitaiḥ kumbhaiḥ mūlamantreṇa pūrvādi madhyakumbhāntaiḥ vedaghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu abhiṣicya| vastrādi dīpāntaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya| ekaberavidhāne tu sarvaṃ etat mūlabiṃbe kṛtvā| tadanu pūrvavat devasya cūrṇasnānaṃ yathāvidhi kṛtvā|
analyzed: tīrtha bimbasya sannidhau dhānya rāśau saṃsthāpya devam mantra āsana pūrvakam pūrvam saṃsnāpya tadanu su muhūrte guruḥ sthāpitaiḥ kumbhaiḥ mūlamantreṇa pūrva ādi madhya kumbha antaiḥ veda ghoṣeṣu pravartiteṣu abhiṣicya vastra ādi dīpa antaiḥ upacāraiḥ upacarya ekabera vidhāne tu sarvam etat mūla biṃbe kṛtvā tadanu pūrvavat devasya cūrṇa snānam yathāvidhi kṛtvā

original: devaṃ stutvā| pradakṣiṇīkṛtya| aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya puṣpāñjaliṃ vikīrya| tadanu kalyāṇakautukaṃ yānaṃ āropya| tīrthabiṃbapurassaraṃ cakreṇa saha chatradhvajacāmara dīpavādyaghoṣa sahitaṃ samudraṃ nadīṃ taṭākaṃ vā prāpayya| tatra tīre prapāyāṃ viṣṭare viniveśya|
analyzed: devam stutvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya aṣṭāṅga praṇipātena praṇipatya puṣpa añjalim vikīrya tadanu kalyāṇa kautukam yānam āropya tīrtha biṃba purassaram cakreṇa saha chatra dhvaja cāmara dīpa vādya ghoṣa sahitam samudram nadīm taṭākam vā prāpayya tatra tīre prapāyām viṣṭare viniveśya

original: agrataḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ, saptadaśa, yadvā kalaśān nava yathāvidhi tattaddravyayutān saṃsthāpya| saṃpūjya|nadyādijalānāṃ śoṣaṇādikṛtvā| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā|prokṣya| tatra gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya nivedya| tīrthabimbaṃ mantrāsanapūrvakaṃ saṃpūjya|kalaśaḥ yathāvidhi saṃsnāpya|
analyzed: agratas pañcaviṃśatiḥ saptadaśa yat vā kalaśān nava yathāvidhi tad tad dravya yutān saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya nadī ādi jalānām śoṣaṇa ādi kṛtvā puṇyāham vācayitvā prokṣya tatra gaṅgā ādyāḥ saritaḥ āvāhya abhyarcya nivedya tīrtha bimbam mantra āsana pūrvakam saṃpūjya kalaśaḥ yathāvidhi saṃsnāpya
