analyzed: puṇyāham vācayitvā śoṣaṇa ādibhiḥ pavitrāṇi saṃśodhya gandha dravyaiḥ dhūpayitvā kastūrikā ādi kardamaiḥ ālipya puṣpāṇi vikīrya tāni pavitra pāṇiḥ nava vāsasā saṃveṣṭya cakra mudrām pradarśya astramantreṇa saṃpūjya maṇḍape aiśānī diśam ārabhya sūtraiḥ astramantreṇa saṃveṣṭya maṇḍapasya upari cakram ca bhūmau padmam dvāreṣu gadām ca dhyātvā

original: tatra digvidikṣu māṣodanena baliṃ datvā| bahubere tu kalyāṇakautukaṃ bahiḥ snānāsane sthāpayitvā| vidhivat saṃsnāpya| upavītāntaṃ upacarya vedikāyāṃ cakrābjaṃ vartayitvā|samabhyarcya kalyaṇakautukaṃ cakrābje saṃsthāpya| haviḥ nivedya| maṇḍape dhānyarāśau sakarakaṃ sopakumbhāṣṭakaṃ mahākumbhaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ saṃsthāpya|
analyzed: tatra diś vidikṣu māṣa udanena balim da tvā bahu bere tu kalyāṇa kautukam bahis snāna āsane sthāpayitvā vidhivat saṃsnāpya upavīta antam upacarya vedikāyām cakra abjam vartayitvā samabhyarcya kalyaṇa kautukam cakra abje saṃsthāpya haviḥ nivedya maṇḍape dhānya rāśau sa karakam sa upakumbha aṣṭakam mahākumbham sa lakṣaṇam saṃsthāpya

original: teṣu madhyama kumbhe mūlarmūīṃta, karake sudarśanaṃ, pūrvādyāśāgateṣu vāsudevādīn koṇastheṣu puruṣādīn ca pīṭhaṃ saṃkalpya| āvāhya abhyarcya| saṃpūjya| kuṇḍe agniṃ upasamidhya| yathāvidhi samidājya carubhiḥ adhivāsa homaṃ kṛtvā| saṃpātaṃ saṃgṛhya| pavitrapātreṣu sparśamantreṇa secayitvā|
analyzed: teṣu madhyama kumbhe sudarśanam pūrva ādi āśā gateṣu vāsudeva ādīn koṇa stheṣu puruṣa ādīn ca pīṭham saṃkalpya āvāhya abhyarcya saṃpūjya kuṇḍe agnim upasamidhya yathāvidhi samidh ājya carubhiḥ adhivāsa homam kṛtvā saṃpātam saṃgṛhya pavitra pātreṣu sparśamantreṇa secayitvā

original: ekabere tu kalyāṇakautukaṃ vinā mūlabiṃbe snapanādikaṃ kṛtvā| pūrvaṃ pavitrāṇi āropya| bahubere tu pūrvaṃ kalyāṇakautukaṃ kumbhakarakāgni cakrābjamaṇḍaleṣu ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti pavitrāṇi āropya| sarvamaṅgalaiḥ saha mūlamandiraṃ praviśya| mūlabimbaṃ arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya| pūrvoktamantreṇa pavitrāṇi āropya| sarvārcāsu ca tathā kṛtvā|
analyzed: eka bere tu kalyāṇa kautukam vinā mūla biṃbe snapana ādikam kṛtvā pūrvam pavitrāṇi āropya bahu bere tu pūrvam kalyāṇa kautukam kumbha karaka agni cakra abja maṇḍaleṣu idam viṣṇuḥ iti pavitrāṇi āropya sarva maṅgalaiḥ saha mūlamandiram praviśya mūla bimbam arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya pūrva ukta mantreṇa pavitrāṇi āropya sarva arcāsu ca tathā kṛtvā

original: prāsādaṃ ca veṣṭayitvā| vedaghoṣaiḥ vādyaghoṣaiḥsaha tatraiva tāṃ rātriṃ jāgareṇa nītvā| aparedyuḥ maṇḍalasthaṃ devaṃ snānāsane samāropya| saṃsnāpya| alaṅkṛtya| śodhite maṇḍape pūrvavat cakrābjaṃ vartayitvā| dvārādiyajanaṃ kṛtvā| cakrapaṅkajaṃ abhyarcya| tasmin kalyāṇabimbaṃ pūrvavat saṃsthāpya| arghyādibhiḥ abhyarcya|
analyzed: prāsādam ca veṣṭayitvā veda ghoṣaiḥ vādya ghoṣaiḥ saha tatra eva tām rātrim jāgareṇa nītvā aparedyus maṇḍala stham devam snāna āsane samāropya saṃsnāpya alaṅkṛtya śodhite maṇḍape pūrvavat cakra abjam vartayitvā dvāra ādi yajanam kṛtvā cakra paṅkajam abhyarcya tasmin kalyāṇa bimbam pūrvavat saṃsthāpya arghya ādibhiḥ abhyarcya

original: kumbhādikaṃ ca saṃpūjya|caturvidhamannaṃ nivedya| agnau pāyasādicaturvidhaiḥ annaiḥ puruṣasūktena ca vrīhi veṇu tila lāja puṣpa agaru ghṛtasamidbhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottara śataṃ āhutīnāṃ hutvā|
analyzed: kumbha ādikam ca saṃpūjya caturvidham annam nivedya agnau pāyasa ādi caturvidhaiḥ annaiḥ puruṣasūktena ca vrīhi veṇu tila lāja puṣpa agaru ghṛta samidbhiḥ mūlamantreṇa pṛthak aṣṭottaraśatam āhutīnām hutvā

original: ācāryaḥ sumuhūrte pavitrāṇi ādāya cakrābjaṃ sāṅgaṃ pṛthak ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti bhūṣayitvā tadanu kumbhakaraka kuṇḍāgnitoraṇa dvārakumbhādīnāṃ pātrāṇāṃ ca pavitrāṇi āropya|tataḥ maṇḍalasthaṃ devaṃ ca tadanu pradakṣiṇī kṛtya| sarvamaṅgala saṃvṛtaṃ mandiraṃ antaḥ praviśya| mūlabimbe snapanādinā pūjite haviḥ nivedya|
analyzed: ācāryaḥ su muhūrte pavitrāṇi ādāya cakra abjam sa aṅgam pṛthak idam viṣṇuḥ iti bhūṣayitvā tadanu kumbha karaka kuṇḍa agni toraṇa dvāra kumbha ādīnām pātrāṇām ca pavitrāṇi āropya tatas maṇḍala stham devam ca tadanu pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sarva maṅgala saṃvṛtam mandiram antar praviśya mūla bimbe snapana ādinā pūjite haviḥ nivedya

original: tatrastha devānāṃ śriyādīnāṃ ca tathā kṛtvā| mūlaberaṃ samārabhya pūrvoktamantreṇa pavitraiḥ bhūṣayitvā| svatantrāṇāṃ asvatantrāṇāṃ ca bimbānāṃ evaṃ kṛtvā|tadanu caṇḍādi balipīṭhāntaṃ ca,brahmādi devatānāṃ tārkṣyaseneśayoḥ anyeṣāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ viṣṇugāyatryā ‘idaṃ viṣṇuḥ’ iti vā aṣṭākṣareṇa dvādaśārṇena vā pavitrāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā|
analyzed: tatrastha devānām śriya ādīnām ca tathā kṛtvā mūlaberam samārabhya pūrva ukta mantreṇa pavitraiḥ bhūṣayitvā svatantrāṇām asvatantrāṇām ca bimbānām evam kṛtvā tadanu caṇḍa ādi balipīṭha antam ca brahma ādi devatānām tārkṣyasena īśayoḥ anyeṣām viṣṇu bhaktānām viṣṇugāyatryā idam viṣṇuḥ iti vā aṣṭa akṣareṇa dvādaśa arṇena vā pavitra āropaṇam kṛtvā

original: tadanu ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ yajamānena ca saha mandiraṃ antaḥ praviśya| syāñjaliṃ ratnaiḥ hemapuṣpaiḥ kevalaiḥ vā prasūnaiḥ āpūrya| devaṃ stotraiḥ stutvā| añjalisthāni devapādamūle vikīrya| manuṣyārthaṃ kṛtāni pavitrāṇi kṣaumādīni puṣpavat devapādayoḥ vinyasya| devaṃ vijñāpya|
analyzed: tadanu ācāryaḥ mūrtipaiḥ yajamānena ca saha mandiram antar praviśya ratnaiḥ hemapuṣpaiḥ kevalaiḥ vā prasūnaiḥ āpūrya devam stotraiḥ stutvā añjali sthāni deva pāda mūle vikīrya manuṣya artham kṛtāni pavitrāṇi kṣauma ādīni puṣpa vat deva pādayoḥ vinyasya devam vijñāpya

original: svayaṃ ātmanaḥ kṛtaṃ kṣaumādipavitraṃ ca pūrvaṃ gṛhītvā|tadanu pūjakamukhyānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ sahakāriṇāṃ anyeṣāṃ rājñāṃ tadupajīvināṃ vaiśyādīnāṃ ca pavitrāṇi vitīrya| devasya ānanaṃ avalokya| pādau spṛṣṭvā|janāntike nyūnātireka śāntyarthaṃ imāṃ gāthāṃ udīrayet| bhagavan devadeveśa śaṅkha cakra gadādhara| saṃvatsarāpacārāṇāṃ pūraṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā|
analyzed: svayam ātmanaḥ kṛtam kṣauma ādi pavitram ca pūrvam gṛhītvā tadanu pūjaka mukhyānām ṛtvijām sahakāriṇām anyeṣām rājñām tad upajīvinām vaiśya ādīnām ca pavitrāṇi vitīrya devasya ānanam avalokya pādau spṛṣṭvā ajana antike nyūna atireka śānti artham imām gāthām udīrayet bhagavan devadeveśa śaṅkha cakra gadādhara saṃvatsara apacārāṇām pūraṇa artham kṛtam mayā

original: ārādhanaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā| nāhaṃ svatantraḥ kiñcicca karomi vihitaṃ hitaṃ| kintu tvatpreritaḥ sarvaṃ karomi na vaśaḥ svayam| tat kṣantavyaṃ aśeṣeṇa kriyālopādi anuṣṭitam| iti vijñāpya|
analyzed: ārādhanam gṛhāṇa tvam bhaktānām hita kāmyayā na aham svatantraḥ kiñcid ca karomi vihitam hitam kintu tvad preritaḥ sarvam karomi na vaśaḥ svayam tat kṣantavyam aśeṣeṇa kriyā lopa ādi anuṣṭitam iti vijñāpya

original: aparāhne devaṃ yānādikaṃ āropya|alaṅkṛtya|grāma pradakṣiṇa pūrvakaṃ sarvopacāraiḥ saha mahotsavaṃ kuryāt|pratyahaṃ pavitrāṇi pūjākāle prokṣya āropayet|evaṃ divasān caturdaśa vā ekaviṃśatiḥ sapta vā trirātraṃ ekarātraṃ vā nityameva dvārayajanādi sahitaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā| samāptidivase tattaddevatāśca udvāsya|
analyzed: aparāhne devam yāna ādikam āropya alaṅkṛtya grāma pradakṣiṇa pūrvakam sarva upacāraiḥ saha mahā utsavam kuryāt pratyaham pavitrāṇi pūjā kāle prokṣya āropayet evam divasān caturdaśa vā ekaviṃśatiḥ sapta vā tri rātram eka rātram vā nityam eva dvāra yajana ādi sahitam mahā utsavam kṛtvā samāpti divase tad tad devatāḥ ca udvāsya

original: pauruṣeṇa sūktena rathantareṇa vā trisuparṇena mūlamantreṇa vā pavitrāṇi avaropya|devasyasnapana karma kṛtvā| saṃpūjya|pūrvaṃ gurave tadanu bhaktānāṃ pavitrāṇi dāpayet| yajamāno’pi guruṃ jīvājīvatmakaiḥ dhanaiḥ toṣayitvā| praṇamya| taṃ yānaṃ āropya|sarvamaṅgala sahitaṃ tanmandiraṃ nayet|
analyzed: pauruṣeṇa sūktena rathantareṇa vā trisuparṇena mūlamantreṇa vā pavitrāṇi avaropya devasya snapana karma kṛtvā saṃpūjya pūrvam gurave tadanu bhaktānām pavitrāṇi dāpayet yajamānaḥ api gurum dhanaiḥ toṣayitvā praṇamya tam yānam āropya sarva maṅgala sahitam tat mandiram nayet

original: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyāṃ kriyākairava candrikāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇa mahotsava vidhiḥ nāma saptatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptoyaṃ kriyākairava candrikā |
analyzed: iti śrī varāhaguruṇā viracitāyām kriyākairava candrikāyām pavitrāropaṇa mahotsava vidhiḥ nāma saptatriṃśaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptā iyam kriyākairava candrikā
